messages.en: Would you like to go for a walk there with me tomorrow?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 愿意，我们上午去吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's go in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“马耳他—拉巴特—塔尔维尔图”三级位置关系记忆，把 Tal-Virtù 放进拉巴特的地图框内；抄写时留意结尾的 ù。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say that one is sorry for a mistake, an offence, or something that has caused inconvenience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因错误、冒犯或给别人带来不便而表示歉意；此处短语表示已经道了歉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Esprima dispjaċir għal żball, offiża jew inkonvenjent li kkawża lil xi ħadd u talab li jiġi maħfur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为自己的错误、冒犯或造成的不便向别人道歉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qal lil xi ħadd li jiddispjaċih għal dak li għamel jew għall-inkonvenjent li kkawża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you apologize, you tell someone that you are sorry for something you have done.

formal.mt: Il-maniġer talab skuża lill-klijenti għall-iżball fil-kont u wiegħed li jirranġah minnufih.
formal.en: The manager apologized to the customers for the error in the bill and promised to correct it immediately.
formal.zh: 经理为账单上的错误向顾客道歉，并承诺立即更正。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark talab skuża talli wasal tard? Luqa: Iva, talab skuża malli daħal.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark apologize for arriving late? Luqa: Yes, he apologized as soon as he came in.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为迟到道歉了吗？卢卡：道了，他一进来就道歉了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark talab skuża talli wasal tard?
messages.mt_standard: Mark talab skuża talli wasal tard?
messages.zh: 马克为迟到道歉了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark apologize for arriving late?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 道了，他一进来就道歉了。
messages.en: Yes, he apologized as soon as he came in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象迟到的人进门后先道歉，把 talab skuża 与“已经道了歉”绑定；再用 għad-dewmien 记道歉原因，用 lill-klijent 记道歉对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A window set into a roof to bring daylight into the space below.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嵌在屋顶中、为下方室内空间引入日光的窗户。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieqa fis-saqaf li ddaħħal id-dawl tal-jum fl-ispazju ta' taħtha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天窗；安装在屋顶上、让日光照入室内的窗户。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieqa li tkun fis-saqaf ta' bini u li minnha jidħol id-dawl tal-jum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A skylight is a roof window that allows daylight to reach the room beneath it.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda t-tindif tat-tambocc biex jidħol aktar dawl fl-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The report recommends cleaning the skylight to let more light into the office.
formal.zh: 报告建议清洁天窗，以便让更多光线进入办公室。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex din il-kamra għandha daqshekk dawl? Mark: Għax għandha tambocc kbir.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does this room have so much light? Mark: Because it has a large skylight.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个房间为什么这么明亮？马克：因为它有一扇大天窗。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din il-kamra għandha daqshekk dawl?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din il-kamra għandha daqshekk dawl?
messages.zh: 这个房间为什么这么明亮？
messages.en: Why does this room have so much light?

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.zh: 因为它有一扇大天窗。
messages.en: Because it has a large skylight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tambocc，就想象日光从头顶的一扇窗落到书桌上；用“头顶采光窗”的画面记住“天窗”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A window in a roof that lets natural light into a room.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安装在屋顶上、让自然光进入室内的窗户。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieqa fis-saqaf li tħalli d-dawl naturali jidħol fil-kamra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天窗；设在屋顶上、用于引入自然光的窗户。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieqa magħmula fis-saqaf ta' bini biex id-dawl naturali jidħol ġewwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A skylight is a window in a roof through which natural light enters a building.

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-bini jinkludi tamboċċ biex jidħol aktar dawl naturali fil-kamra.
formal.en: The building plan includes a skylight to let more natural light into the room.
formal.zh: 建筑方案包括一扇天窗，以便让更多自然光进入房间。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Minn fejn ġej dan id-dawl kollu? Pawlu: Mit-tamboċċ fis-saqaf.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where is all this light coming from? Pawlu: From the skylight in the roof.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这么多光是从哪里来的？保罗：从屋顶上的天窗进来的。

messages.speaker: Marta (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġej dan id-dawl kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġej dan id-dawl kollu?
messages.zh: 这么多光是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is all this light coming from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (屋主)
messages.zh: 从屋顶上的天窗进来的。
messages.en: From the skylight in the roof.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tamboċċ 放进“抬头看屋顶，阳光穿窗进来”的画面中，用屋顶、窗户和光线三个线索记住“天窗”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet fruit of the date palm, eaten fresh or dried.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海枣树结的一颗甜果实，可鲜食或晒干后食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta ħelwa tal-palma tat-tamal li tittiekel friska jew imnixxfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一颗椰枣或海枣，指海枣树的甜果实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frotta waħda tal-palma tat-tamal, b'togħma ħelwa, li tista' tittiekel friska jew imnixxfa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A date is a sweet fruit from a date palm that can be eaten fresh or dried.

formal.mt: Kull mistieden irċieva tamla fuq platt żgħir.
formal.en: Each guest received a date on a small plate.
formal.zh: 每位客人都收到一个小盘子，里面放着一颗椰枣。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tamla mal-kafè? David: Iva, grazzi. Waħda biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like a date with your coffee? David: Yes, thank you. One is enough.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想吃颗椰枣配咖啡吗？戴维：想，谢谢。一颗就够了。

messages.speaker: Lara (主人)
messages.zh: 你想吃颗椰枣配咖啡吗？
messages.en: Would you like a date with your coffee?

messages.speaker: David (客人)
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。一颗就够了。
messages.en: Yes, thank you. One is enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tamla 和小盘子里的一颗甜椰枣连起来记；本条英文 date 指可以吃的果实，不是日历日期。

gloss_zh: 同龄的；表示与某人同龄

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used with pronominal suffixes to describe someone of the same age as the person indicated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与代词后缀连用，形容某人与该后缀所指的人年龄相同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża b'suffissi pronominali biex tiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li għandu l-istess età bħall-persuna indikata.

sense_translations.en_definition: of the same age (used with pronominal suffixes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 同龄的；与代词后缀连用，表示与后缀所指的人年龄相同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi persuna li għandha l-istess età bħal persuna oħra indikata permezz ta' suffiss pronominali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone is described as tampar with a pronominal suffix, they are the same age as the person indicated by that suffix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示与另一人同龄，即年龄相同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża bħala avverbju biex tindika li persuna għandha l-istess età bħal persuna oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Used adverbially, this word indicates that a person is the same age as someone else.

collocations.en: a person the same age as me
collocations.zh: 一个与我年龄相同的人

formal.mt: Għall-intervista għażilt persuna tampari biex niddiskutu l-esperjenzi tagħna fl-istess età.
formal.en: For the interview, I chose a person my age so that we could discuss our experiences at the same age.
formal.zh: 我为访谈选择了一位与我同龄的人，以便讨论我们在相同年龄阶段的经历。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Marija tampari? Sara: Iva, it-tnejn għandkom għoxrin sena.
colloquial.en: Luca: Is Marija the same age as me? Sara: Yes, you are both twenty.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：玛丽亚和我同龄吗？萨拉：是的，你们两个都二十岁。

messages.speaker: Luca (学生)
messages.zh: 玛丽亚和我同龄吗？
messages.en: Is Marija the same age as me?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，你们两个都二十岁。
messages.en: Yes, you are both twenty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tampar 想成两张年龄卡上的数字相同；再把 tampari 整体记作“和我同龄”，留意代词后缀说明与谁比较。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the same age as another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一个人年龄相同的；同龄的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandhom l-istess età bħal xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年龄相同的；同龄的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandhom l-istess età bħal xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: People who are tampari are the same age as each other.

collocations.en: two children of the same age

formal.mt: Għalkemm iż-żewġ studenti huma tampari, għandhom interessi differenti.
formal.en: Although the two students are the same age, they have different interests.
formal.zh: 虽然这两名学生同龄，但他们的兴趣不同。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int u Pawlu tampari? Lara: Iva, it-tnejn għandna għoxrin sena.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you and Pawlu the same age? Lara: Yes, we are both twenty.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你和Pawlu同龄吗？Lara：是的，我们都二十岁。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你和Pawlu同龄吗？
messages.en: Are you and Pawlu the same age?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我们都二十岁。
messages.en: Yes, we are both twenty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个孩子的生日蛋糕上插着同样数量的蜡烛，把 tampari 和“同龄”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An absorbent menstrual product, referring either to an internally worn tampon or to an externally worn sanitary napkin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吸收经血的卫生用品，可指置于阴道内的卫生棉条，也可指固定在内裤上的卫生巾；具体所指须结合语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li jassorbi d-demm waqt il-mestrwazzjoni, li jista' jkun wieħed li jitqiegħed fil-vaġina jew wieħed li jintlibes fil-ħwejjeġ ta' taħt, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卫生棉条：经期置于阴道内、用于吸收经血的卫生用品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott assorbenti li jitqiegħed fil-vaġina biex jassorbi d-demm waqt il-mestrwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tampon is an absorbent menstrual product worn inside the vagina to absorb menstrual blood.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卫生巾：经期固定在内裤上、用于吸收经血的卫生用品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott assorbenti li jintlibes fil-ħwejjeġ ta' taħt biex jassorbi d-demm waqt il-mestrwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sanitary napkin is an absorbent pad worn in underwear to collect menstrual blood.

collocations.zh: 经期用的吸收性卫生用品

collocations.en: a pack of menstrual absorbent products
collocations.zh: 一包经期吸收性卫生用品

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-prodott għandha tiċċara jekk il-kelma "tampun" tirreferix għal prodott intern jew għal wieħed li jintlibes fil-ħwejjeġ ta' taħt.
formal.en: The product description should clarify whether the word "tampun" refers to an internal product or one worn in underwear.
formal.zh: 产品说明应明确，tampun 一词指的是内置用品，还是固定在内裤上的用品。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Meta tgħid tampun, qed tirreferi għal prodott intern? Sara: Le, qed infisser dak li jintlibes fil-ħwejjeġ ta' taħt.
colloquial.en: Rita: When you say tampun, do you mean an internal product? Sara: No, I mean the kind worn in underwear.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你说 tampun，是指内置的卫生棉条吗？Sara：不是，我指的是固定在内裤上的卫生巾。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid tampun, qed tirreferi għal prodott intern?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid tampun, qed tirreferi għal prodott intern?
messages.zh: 你说 tampun，是指内置的卫生棉条吗？
messages.en: When you say tampun, do you mean an internal product?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed infisser dak li jintlibes fil-ħwejjeġ ta' taħt.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed infisser dak li jintlibes fil-ħwejjeġ ta' taħt.
messages.zh: 不是，我指的是固定在内裤上的卫生巾。
messages.en: No, I mean the kind worn in underwear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tampun 放进“经期吸收用品”这一记忆格，再用“内置棉条、外用卫生巾”区分给定的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large container used for holding or storing liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放或储存液体的大型容器，如水箱或储液罐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontenitur kbir li jintuża biex jinżamm jew jinħażen likwidu, bħall-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储液罐；用于盛放或储存液体的大型容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontenitur kbir li jintuża biex jinżamm jew jinħażen likwidu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tank is a large container in which liquid is held or stored.

formal.mt: It-tank tal-ilma jinsab fuq il-bejt tal-bini u għandu kapaċità ta' elf litru.
formal.en: The water tank is on the roof of the building and has a capacity of one thousand litres.
formal.zh: 水箱位于楼顶，容量为一千升。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tank tal-ilma mimli? Lara: Għadu nofsu vojt; irridu nimlewh.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the water tank full? Lara: It is still half empty; we need to fill it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：水箱满了吗？Lara：还空着一半，我们得把它装满。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 水箱满了吗？
messages.en: Is the water tank full?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 还空着一半，我们得把它装满。
messages.en: It is still half empty; we need to fill it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tank 想成楼顶的大水箱，再连读 tank tal-ilma，记住这里是“储存液体的容器”。

gloss_zh: 动词，给定释义为“Tanker”，具体动作未说明

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb labelled "Tanker" in the supplied packet, whose action is not specified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给定资料将此词标为动词，释义仅写作“Tanker”，没有说明它表示的具体动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li fil-pakkett mogħti għandu t-tikketta "Tanker", iżda l-azzjoni li jesprimi mhix speċifikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给定的动词释义标签为“Tanker”；资料未提供足以确定具体动作的信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tikketta mogħtija għal dan il-verb hija "Tanker", iżda l-pakkett ma jispjegax liema azzjoni jesprimi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied packet identifies this item as a verb but does not specify what action it expresses.

collocations.en: the meaning of the verb labelled "Tanker"
the use of the verb labelled "Tanker" in a sentence
collocations.zh: 标为“Tanker”的动词在句子中的用法

formal.mt: Il-pakkett jikklassifika "Tanker" bħala verb, iżda ma jipprovdix definizzjoni tal-azzjoni; għalhekk l-użu tiegħu jeħtieġ aktar kuntest.
formal.en: The packet classifies "Tanker" as a verb but provides no definition of its action, so its use requires further context.
formal.zh: 资料将“Tanker”归为动词，但没有定义它表示的动作，因此需要更多语境才能说明其用法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser il-verb "Tanker" hawn? Mark: Il-pakkett ma jispjegahx; għandna bżonn aktar kuntest.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the verb "Tanker" mean here? Mark: The packet does not explain it; we need more context.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的动词“Tanker”是什么意思？Mark：资料没有解释，我们需要更多语境。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的动词“Tanker”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the verb "Tanker" mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pakkett ma jispjegahx; għandna bżonn aktar kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pakkett ma jispjegahx; għandna bżonn aktar kuntest.
messages.zh: 资料没有解释，我们需要更多语境。
messages.en: The packet does not explain it; we need more context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tanker 贴上“动词，动作待明确”的学习便签；先记住资料中的词性，等有完整语境再记具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To such a great degree or in such a large amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示程度很高或数量很大，相当于“这么”“那么”或“如此多”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juri grad għoli jew kwantità kbira ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 这么多；那么多；达到如此高的程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sa grad għoli jew fi kwantità kbira, skont dak li jkun qed jingħad.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use tant to emphasize how great an amount or degree is.

formal.mt: Il-proġett kien tant importanti li l-kumitat iddeċieda li jagħtih prijorità.
formal.en: The project was so important that the committee decided to give it priority.
formal.zh: 这个项目如此重要，委员会决定优先处理。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex int tant għajjien illum? Pawlu: Kelli tant xogħol li lanqas waqaft għall-ikel.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you so tired today? Pawlu: I had so much work that I did not even stop to eat.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你今天为什么这么累？Pawlu：我的工作太多了，连停下来吃饭的时间都没有。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天为什么这么累？
messages.en: Why are you so tired today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli tant xogħol li lanqas waqaft għall-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli tant xogħol li lanqas waqaft għall-ikel.
messages.zh: 我的工作太多了，连停下来吃饭的时间都没有。
messages.en: I had so much work that I did not even stop to eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tant 想成调高程度的旋钮：放在 xogħol 前表示“这么多工作”，放在 tajjeb 前表示“这么好”。

gloss_zh: 那么多；达到……那么多的程度

teaching_sense.en_definition: So much, with the amount or degree specified by the clause that follows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示达到后续分句所说明的数量或程度，常可理解为“有……那么多”或“达到……的程度”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi kwantità jew sa grad li jiġu speċifikati mill-kliem li jiġi wara kemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 那么多；其数量或程度由后续内容加以说明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fi kwantità jew sa grad li wieħed jifhem mill-frażi jew mis-sentenza li tiġi wara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use tant kemm to express an amount or degree specified by what follows.

collocations.zh: 你需要那么多；按你所需的量
尽你所能；达到你能做到的程度

formal.mt: Ħadd ma ħadem tant kemm ħadmet Marija biex il-proġett jitlesta fil-ħin.
formal.en: Nobody worked as much as Marija did to ensure that the project was completed on time.
formal.zh: 为了让项目按时完成，没有人像 Marija 那样付出那么多劳动。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nista' nieħu ftit karti oħra? Ben: Iva, ħu tant kemm għandek bżonn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can I take a few more sheets of paper? Ben: Yes, take as many as you need.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我可以再拿几张纸吗？Ben：可以，你需要多少就拿多少。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 我可以再拿几张纸吗？
messages.en: Can I take a few more sheets of paper?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu tant kemm għandek bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu tant kemm għandek bżonn.
messages.zh: 可以，你需要多少就拿多少。
messages.en: Yes, take as many as you need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tant kemm 连成“有……那么多”来记：先想到数量，再看后面的分句用什么标准说明这个数量。

gloss_zh: Tantix（名称；具体所指依语境确定）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name Tantix, whose specific referent is determined by context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名称“Tantix”；现有释义未说明其具体所指，理解时须结合上下文。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem Tantix, li dak li jirreferi għalih irid jinftiehem mill-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名称“Tantix”；具体指称对象须由语境确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem miktub Tantix; il-kuntest irid juri għal min jew għal xiex qed jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tantix is a name whose specific referent depends on the context in which it appears.

collocations.en: the spelling of the name Tantix

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, ikteb l-isem Tantix kif jidher fit-test.
formal.en: In this exercise, write the name Tantix as it appears in the text.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，请按照课文中的写法写出 Tantix 这个名称。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif jinkiteb l-isem Tantix? Mark: Jinkiteb T-a-n-t-i-x, b'T kbira fil-bidu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do you spell the name Tantix? Mark: It is spelled T-a-n-t-i-x, with a capital T at the beginning.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Tantix 这个名称怎么拼？Mark：拼作 T-a-n-t-i-x，开头的 T 要大写。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: Tantix 这个名称怎么拼？
messages.en: How do you spell the name Tantix?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 拼作 T-a-n-t-i-x，开头的 T 要大写。
messages.en: It is spelled T-a-n-t-i-x, with a capital T at the beginning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Tantix 当作一张名称卡整体记忆，注意首字母大写；具体指什么，要回到上下文确认。

gloss_zh: 家具软包工；家具包覆工

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is fitting or repairing the padding and coverings of furniture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以安装或修理家具的软垫、填充物及表面包覆材料为职业的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tagħmel jew issewwi l-mili u l-kisi ta' għamara bħal siġġijiet u sufani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家具软包工，负责为椅子、沙发等家具安装或修理软垫及包覆材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaddiem tas-sengħa li jagħmel, ibiddel jew isewwi l-mili u l-kisi ta' siġġijiet, sufani u għamara oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An upholsterer is someone whose job is to fit or repair the padding and coverings on furniture.

collocations.zh: 手艺娴熟的家具软包工

collocations.en: to take the chair to the upholsterer
collocations.zh: 把椅子送到家具软包工那里

formal.mt: It-tapezzar ġedded il-kisi tas-siġġijiet qabel ma tqiegħdu fis-sala.
formal.en: The upholsterer renewed the chairs' coverings before they were placed in the hall.
formal.zh: 家具软包工翻新了椅子的包覆面料，随后这些椅子被放进大厅。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-kisi tas-sufan tqatta'. Taf lil xi tapezzar tajjeb? Ġorġ: Iva, naf wieħed li jista' jbiddel il-kisi u l-mili.
colloquial.en: Rita: The sofa covering has torn. Do you know a good upholsterer? Ġorġ: Yes, I know someone who can replace the covering and the padding.
colloquial.zh: Rita：沙发的面料破了。你认识手艺好的家具软包工吗？Ġorġ：认识，我知道一位能更换面料和填充物的师傅。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kisi tas-sufan tqatta'. Taf lil xi tapezzar tajjeb?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kisi tas-sufan tqatta'. Taf lil xi tapezzar tajjeb?
messages.zh: 沙发的面料破了。你认识手艺好的家具软包工吗？
messages.en: The sofa covering has torn. Do you know a good upholsterer?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naf wieħed li jista' jbiddel il-kisi u l-mili.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naf wieħed li jista' jbiddel il-kisi u l-mili.
messages.zh: 认识，我知道一位能更换面料和填充物的师傅。
messages.en: Yes, I know someone who can replace the covering and the padding.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tapezzar 时想象师傅给旧沙发换面料、补软垫的画面，把这个词与“家具软包工”这一职业绑定。

gloss_zh: 挂毯；家具软包与包覆面料

teaching_sense.en_definition: Decorative woven fabric used as a tapestry, or the fabric and padding covering upholstered furniture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指带有装饰图案的织物挂毯，也可指家具上的包覆面料与衬垫软包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp minsuġ b'disinji jew stampi li jintuża bħala tiżjin, jew id-drapp u l-materjal artab li jiksu għamara bħal siġġijiet u sufani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 织有图案或图像、用于装饰的挂毯。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Drapp minsuġ b'disinji jew stampi li jintuża bħala tiżjin, speċjalment meta jiddendel mal-ħajt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tapestry is a piece of fabric with woven pictures or patterns, often hung on a wall for decoration.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙发、椅子等家具上的包覆面料及衬垫软包。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-drapp u l-materjal artab li jintużaw biex jiksu u jagħmlu komda għamara bħal siġġijiet u sufani.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Upholstery is the fabric and padding that cover furniture such as chairs and sofas.

collocations.en: a tapestry hanging on the wall

collocations.zh: 沙发的软包面料与衬垫

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi tapizzerija mdendla mal-ħajt tas-sala u jirrakkomanda t-tindif tat-tapizzerija tas-siġġijiet.
formal.en: The report describes a tapestry hanging on the hall wall and recommends cleaning the upholstery of the chairs.
formal.zh: 报告描述了大厅墙上悬挂的一幅挂毯，并建议清洁椅子的软包面料与衬垫。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tħobb it-tapizzerija l-ġdida tas-sufan? Pawlu: Iva, il-kulur sabiħ u d-drapp artab ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you like the sofa's new upholstery? Pawlu: Yes, the colour is lovely and the fabric is very soft.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你喜欢沙发新换的软包吗？Pawlu：喜欢，颜色好看，布料也很柔软。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢沙发新换的软包吗？
messages.en: Do you like the sofa's new upholstery?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kulur sabiħ u d-drapp artab ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kulur sabiħ u d-drapp artab ħafna.
messages.zh: 喜欢，颜色好看，布料也很柔软。
messages.en: Yes, the colour is lovely and the fabric is very soft.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记 tapizzerija：抬头看墙上是“挂毯”，低头摸沙发是“软包”；结合所修饰的物件判断词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cap or stopper with a screw thread that closes an opening when twisted into place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有螺纹、通过旋拧固定以封闭瓶口或其他开口的盖子或塞子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għatu jew tapp b'ħajt tal-kamin li jingħalaq billi jiddawwar biex jagħlaq il-bokka ta' flixkun jew fetħa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过螺纹旋紧在容器口上的盖子；螺旋盖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għatu b'ħajt tal-kamin li jiddawwar biex jingħalaq fuq il-bokka ta' kontenitur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A screw cap is a lid that closes a container by being twisted onto a matching thread.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过螺纹旋拧固定、用来封闭开口的塞子；螺纹塞。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tapp b'ħajt tal-kamin li jiddawwar u jitwaħħal biex jagħlaq fetħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A screw stopper is a threaded closure that seals an opening when it is screwed into place.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采用螺纹旋拧方式固定的塞子；螺旋式塞子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' tapp li juża ħajt tal-kamin biex jitwaħħal u jagħlaq fetħa billi jiddawwar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A screw type stopper is a stopper designed to fasten by turning along a screw thread.

collocations.en: a bottle with a screw cap

formal.mt: Wara li timla l-flixkun, issikka t-tapp bil-kamin biex il-likwidu ma jnixxix.
formal.en: After filling the bottle, tighten the screw cap to prevent the liquid from leaking.
formal.zh: 将瓶子装满后，拧紧螺旋盖，以防液体渗漏。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif niftaħ dan il-flixkun? Pawlu: Għandu tapp bil-kamin. Dawwar it-tapp lejn ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do I open this bottle? Pawlu: It has a screw cap. Turn the cap to the left.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个瓶子怎么打开？Pawlu：它用的是螺旋盖。把盖子向左拧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个瓶子怎么打开？
messages.en: How do I open this bottle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu tapp bil-kamin. Dawwar it-tapp lejn ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu tapp bil-kamin. Dawwar it-tapp lejn ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 它用的是螺旋盖。把盖子向左拧。
messages.en: It has a screw cap. Turn the cap to the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tapp bil-kamin 时做一个拧瓶盖的动作：盖子靠螺纹旋转固定，便能同时联想到“螺旋盖”和“螺纹塞”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cap that closes a bottle or container by being screwed onto its opening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过旋拧固定在瓶口或容器开口上的盖子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tapp li jagħlaq flixkun jew reċipjent billi jiddawwar fuq il-kamin tal-fetħa tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依靠螺纹旋紧或旋开的瓶盖或容器盖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tapp li jitwaħħal mal-fetħa ta' flixkun jew reċipjent permezz ta' kamin u li jinfetaħ u jingħalaq billi jiddawwar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A screw cap is a lid that you turn to fasten it onto a bottle or container.

formal.mt: Wara l-użu, issikka t-tapp tal-kamin biex il-flixkun jibqa' magħluq sew.
formal.en: After use, tighten the screw cap so that the bottle remains securely closed.
formal.zh: 使用后请拧紧螺旋盖，确保瓶子保持密闭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma nistax niftaħ dan il-flixkun. Tista' tgħinni? Pawlu: Iva, għaddihuli. It-tapp tal-kamin issikkat wisq.
colloquial.en: Maja: I can't open this bottle. Can you help me? Pawlu: Yes, pass it to me. The screw cap is too tight.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我打不开这个瓶子。你能帮我吗？Pawlu：可以，递给我吧。螺旋盖拧得太紧了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax niftaħ dan il-flixkun. Tista' tgħinni?
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax niftaħ dan il-flixkun. Tista' tgħinni?
messages.zh: 我打不开这个瓶子。你能帮我吗？
messages.en: I can't open this bottle. Can you help me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għaddihuli. It-tapp tal-kamin issikkat wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għaddihuli. It-tapp tal-kamin issikkat wisq.
messages.zh: 可以，递给我吧。螺旋盖拧得太紧了。
messages.en: Yes, pass it to me. The screw cap is too tight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开水瓶时先转动瓶盖，把 tapp tal-kamin 与“旋拧才能开合的盖子”这一动作画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light touch or blow made by tapping someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻轻敲击或拍触某人、某物的一下动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa ħafifa mogħtija lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa, spiss biex tiġbed l-attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻轻的一下敲击或拍触。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Daqqa żgħira u ħafifa fuq persuna jew fuq oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tap is a light touch or blow that you give someone or something.

formal.mt: L-għalliem ta taptipa fuq il-mejda biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The teacher gave the table a tap to attract the students' attention.
formal.zh: 老师轻敲了一下桌子，以引起学生们的注意。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se nġibek tħares lejja jekk ma tismax leħni? Mark: Agħtini taptipa fuq l-ispalla.
colloquial.en: Sara: How will I get you to look at me if you can't hear my voice? Mark: Give me a tap on the shoulder.
colloquial.zh: Sara：如果你听不见我的声音，我怎么让你转头看我？Mark：轻拍一下我的肩膀就行。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nġibek tħares lejja jekk ma tismax leħni?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nġibek tħares lejja jekk ma tismax leħni?
messages.zh: 如果你听不见我的声音，我怎么让你转头看我？
messages.en: How will I get you to look at me if you can't hear my voice?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 轻拍一下我的肩膀就行。
messages.en: Give me a tap on the shoulder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 taptipa 时想象指尖轻轻点一下桌面，用“轻敲一下”的动作帮助记忆，不要联想成猛烈敲打。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A usually short piece of verse containing words that rhyme.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常篇幅较短、运用押韵词语写成的一段诗或韵文。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Poeżija jew silta qasira bil-versi li fiha kliem li jaqbel fil-ħoss fit-tmiem tal-versi.

sense_translations.en_definition: rhyme (typically a short rhyme in verse)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 押韵的诗或韵文，通常指一首短小的押韵诗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kitba bil-versi, ġeneralment qasira, li fiha t-truf ta' ċerti versi jaqblu fil-ħoss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rhyme is a usually short poem in which words at the ends of lines have matching sounds.

formal.mt: Għal din l-attività, kull student għandu jikteb taqbila ta' erba' versi u jaqraha quddiem il-klassi.
formal.en: For this activity, each student should write a four-line rhyme and read it to the class.
formal.zh: 在这项活动中，每位学生应写一首四行的押韵短诗，并在全班面前朗读。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qed titgħallem bl-amment? Ben: Taqbila qasira għall-iskola. Trid tismagħha? Nina: Iva, aqrahieli!
colloquial.en: Nina: What are you learning by heart? Ben: A short rhyme for school. Do you want to hear it? Nina: Yes, read it to me!
colloquial.zh: Nina：你在背什么？Ben：一首学校要用的押韵短诗。你想听吗？Nina：想，读给我听吧！

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你在背什么？
messages.en: What are you learning by heart?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 一首学校要用的押韵短诗。你想听吗？
messages.en: A short rhyme for school. Do you want to hear it?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 想，读给我听吧！
messages.en: Yes, read it to me!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqbila 与“四行短诗，句尾声音相呼应”的画面相连；学习时圈出句尾的押韵词，帮助记住它指一段韵文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A disturbance that disrupts the usual stability or functioning of a market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使市场原有的稳定状态或正常运作受到干扰的动荡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni ta' instabbiltà jew ta' tfixkil li taffettwa l-andament normali tas-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市场正常秩序或稳定状态受到干扰的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqlib li jfixkel l-istabbiltà jew il-mod kif jaħdem normalment is-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A market disturbance is a disruption that affects the normal stability or operation of a market.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi perjodu ta' taqlib fis-suq u l-effetti tiegħu fuq in-negozji żgħar.
formal.en: The report describes a period of market disturbance and its effects on small businesses.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一段市场动荡期及其对小企业的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-prezzijiet qed jinbidlu daqshekk? Mark: Hemm taqlib fis-suq, u diffiċli tkun taf x'se jiġri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are prices changing so much? Mark: There is market disturbance, and it is hard to know what will happen.
colloquial.zh: Maja：价格为什么变化这么大？Mark：市场正在动荡，很难知道接下来会怎样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 价格为什么变化这么大？
messages.en: Why are prices changing so much?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm taqlib fis-suq, u diffiċli tkun taf x'se jiġri.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm taqlib fis-suq, u diffiċli tkun taf x'se jiġri.
messages.zh: 市场正在动荡，很难知道接下来会怎样。
messages.en: There is market disturbance, and it is hard to know what will happen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成市场价格忽上忽下的画面，整体记住“市场动荡”，不要只记成一般的市场变化。

gloss_zh: 提出为对方剪发的提议

teaching_sense.en_definition: An offer to cut someone's hair, as represented by this entry in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料中表示提出为对方剪发这一提议的条目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata li fil-materjal mogħti tirrappreżenta offerta biex wieħed jaqta' xagħar persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提出为对方剪头发。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta biex wieħed jaqta' xagħar il-persuna li jkun qed ikellem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry describes an offer someone makes to cut your hair.

formal.mt: Fil-materjal mogħti, l-entrata 'taqtalha' tirrappreżenta offerta biex wieħed jaqta' xagħar persuna oħra.
formal.en: In the supplied material, the entry 'taqtalha' represents an offer to cut another person's hair.
formal.zh: 在所给材料中，词条“taqtalha”表示提出为他人剪发的提议。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'taqtalha' f'din il-lista? Pawlu: Hawnhekk tfisser offerta biex taqta' xagħar xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'taqtalha' mean in this list? Pawlu: Here it means an offer to cut someone's hair.
colloquial.zh: Lina：这份列表里的“taqtalha”是什么意思？Pawlu：这里表示提出给某人剪头发。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这份列表里的“taqtalha”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'taqtalha' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk tfisser offerta biex taqta' xagħar xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk tfisser offerta biex taqta' xagħar xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 这里表示提出给某人剪头发。
messages.en: Here it means an offer to cut someone's hair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人拿着梳子提出“我来帮你剪头发”，用这个场景记住所给释义；名词标签沿用材料，不据此推断词形变化。

gloss_zh: 标注为“H”的条目（具体词义未提供）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled 'H' in the supplied material, with no specific meaning explained.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料中仅以“H”标注、尚未说明具体含义的条目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata li fil-materjal mogħti hija mmarkata biss b''H', mingħajr spjegazzjoni tat-tifsira speċifika tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 材料仅给出标记“H”，未提供可确定的具体词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal jagħti biss il-marka 'H' u ma jispeċifikax it-tifsira tal-entrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied label is 'H', which does not establish a specific meaning for this entry.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'Tarapewtiku' għandha l-marka 'H', iżda l-materjal mogħti ma jispjegax it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The entry 'Tarapewtiku' has the label 'H', but the supplied material does not explain its meaning.
formal.zh: 词条“Tarapewtiku”标有“H”，但所给材料没有解释其含义。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser 'Tarapewtiku' hawn? David: Ma nafux mill-materjal; ħdejha hemm biss 'H'.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'Tarapewtiku' mean here? David: We cannot tell from the material; it only has 'H' beside it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里的“Tarapewtiku”是什么意思？David：从材料里看不出来；旁边只有一个“H”。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“Tarapewtiku”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Tarapewtiku' mean here?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafux mill-materjal; ħdejha hemm biss 'H'.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafux mill-materjal; ħdejha hemm biss 'H'.
messages.zh: 从材料里看不出来；旁边只有一个“H”。
messages.en: We cannot tell from the material; it only has 'H' beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词想成夹着“H”书签的待释义卡片：先记拼写与材料标记，具体含义留空，避免凭外形猜义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A goal or intended result that someone directs their efforts towards achieving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或团体投入努力、打算达到的目标或预期结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mira jew riżultat mixtieq li persuna jew grupp jaħdem biex jilħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行动或努力所指向、希望达到的目标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mira li lejha jkunu diretti l-isforzi jew l-azzjonijiet ta' persuna jew ta' grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A target is a particular goal or result that you try to achieve.

formal.mt: It-tim stabbilixxa targit ċar għax-xahar li ġej u ħejja pjan biex jilħqu.
formal.en: The team set a clear target for the coming month and prepared a plan to achieve it.
formal.zh: 团队为下个月设定了明确目标，并制订了实现目标的计划。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu t-targit tagħna għal-lum? Mark: Biex inlestu dawn il-ħames paġni qabel il-ħamsa.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is our target for today? Mark: To finish these five pages before five o'clock.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们今天的目标是什么？Mark：五点之前完成这五页。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 我们今天的目标是什么？
messages.en: What is our target for today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inlestu dawn il-ħames paġni qabel il-ħamsa.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inlestu dawn il-ħames paġni qabel il-ħamsa.
messages.zh: 五点之前完成这五页。
messages.en: To finish these five pages before five o'clock.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 targit 写在每日任务卡顶端，下面写“今天完成五页”，将它与明确、可达到的目标一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 关税；交通票价；收费标准

teaching_sense.en_definition: A charge or charging rate, such as a customs duty, a transport fare, or a price set for a service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定的税费或收费标准，可指关税、交通票价或服务费率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas jew rata ta' ħlas stabbilita, bħal dazju fuq l-importazzjoni, prezz għal vjaġġ jew ħlas għal servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对进出口货物征收的关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dazju li jiġi impost fuq merkanzija li tidħol f'pajjiż jew toħroġ minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tariff is a tax charged on goods when they enter or leave a country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乘坐公共交通工具或出租车等所支付的票价或车费。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prezz li passiġġier iħallas biex jivvjaġġa b'mezz tat-trasport, bħal xarabank jew taxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fare is the amount you pay for a journey on public transport or in a taxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按一定单位计算的收费标准或费率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammont ta' flus stabbilit għal kull unità ta' servizz, użu jew ħin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rate is a fixed amount charged for each unit of a service, use, or time.

formal.mt: It-tariffa għal dan is-servizz hija ta' għoxrin ewro fis-siegħa u għandha tiġi indikata fil-kuntratt.
formal.en: The rate for this service is twenty euros per hour and must be stated in the contract.
formal.zh: 这项服务的收费标准为每小时二十欧元，须在合同中注明。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm hi t-tariffa għal dan il-vjaġġ? Rita: Ħames ewro għal kull persuna.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much is the fare for this journey? Rita: Five euros per person.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这趟行程的票价是多少？Rita：每人五欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi t-tariffa għal dan il-vjaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi t-tariffa għal dan il-vjaġġ?
messages.zh: 这趟行程的票价是多少？
messages.en: How much is the fare for this journey?

messages.speaker: Rita (售票员)
messages.zh: 每人五欧元。
messages.en: Five euros per person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tariffa 放进三个收费场景记忆：海关看关税，乘车看票价，服务看费率。

gloss_zh: 约束关税；承诺的关税上限

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tariff ceiling that a country commits to observing under a trade agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一国在贸易协定中承诺遵守的关税上限，不一定等于实际征收的税率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Limitu massimu ta' dazju li pajjiż jintrabat li josserva skont ftehim kummerċjali, u li jista' jkun ogħla mir-rata applikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约束关税，即一国通过贸易承诺确定的关税上限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rata massima ta' dazju li pajjiż ikun intrabat li ma jaqbiżx skont l-impenji kummerċjali tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bound tariff is a maximum tariff level that a country commits to under a trade agreement.

collocations.en: a reduction in the bound tariff

collocations.mt: id-differenza bejn it-tariffa kkonsolidata u t-tariffa applikata
collocations.en: the difference between the bound tariff and the applied tariff
collocations.zh: 约束关税与实际适用关税之间的差额

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, it-tariffa kkonsolidata hija ta' għaxra fil-mija, filwaqt li t-tariffa applikata hija ta' sitta fil-mija.
formal.en: In this example, the bound tariff is ten percent, while the applied tariff is six percent.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，约束关税为百分之十，实际适用关税为百分之六。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tariffa kkonsolidata hija dejjem dik li nħallsu? Pawlu: Le, hija l-limitu miftiehem; it-tariffa applikata tista' tkun aktar baxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the bound tariff always what we pay? Pawlu: No, it is the agreed ceiling; the applied tariff can be lower.
colloquial.zh: Maja：约束关税总是我们实际缴纳的税率吗？Pawlu：不是，它是约定的上限；实际适用关税可以更低。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tariffa kkonsolidata hija dejjem dik li nħallsu?
messages.mt_standard: It-tariffa kkonsolidata hija dejjem dik li nħallsu?
messages.zh: 约束关税总是我们实际缴纳的税率吗？
messages.en: Is the bound tariff always what we pay?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hija l-limitu miftiehem; it-tariffa applikata tista' tkun aktar baxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hija l-limitu miftiehem; it-tariffa applikata tista' tkun aktar baxxa.
messages.zh: 不是，它是约定的上限；实际适用关税可以更低。
messages.en: No, it is the agreed ceiling; the applied tariff can be lower.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把约束关税想成房间的天花板：承诺规定最高位置，实际税率可以站在更低的位置。

gloss_zh: 最惠国关税税率；最惠国税率

teaching_sense.en_definition: The customs duty rate applied to imports from trading partners receiving most-favoured-nation treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对享有最惠国待遇的贸易伙伴的进口货物适用的关税税率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-rata tad-dazju applikata għal merkanzija importata minn sħab kummerċjali li jingħataw it-trattament tan-nazzjon l-aktar favorit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最惠国关税税率，即对享有最惠国待遇的进口货物适用的海关税率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rata tad-dazju doganali li tapplika għal importazzjonijiet minn sħab kummerċjali li jibbenefikaw mit-trattament tan-nazzjon l-aktar favorit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An MFN customs duty rate is the customs tax rate applied to imports eligible for most-favoured-nation treatment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最惠国税率；在此关税语境中，指按最惠国待遇适用的税率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'dan il-kuntest doganali, din hija r-rata ta' dazju applikata skont it-trattament tan-nazzjon l-aktar favorit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An MFN rate is the tariff rate used for goods receiving most-favoured-nation treatment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最惠国关税，即对享有最惠国待遇的贸易伙伴适用的关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dazju fuq l-importazzjoni applikat għal merkanzija minn sħab kummerċjali li jingħataw it-trattament tan-nazzjon l-aktar favorit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An MFN tariff is an import duty applied to goods from trading partners granted most-favoured-nation treatment.

sense_translations.en_definition: most favoured nation customs duty rate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 最惠国关税税率，即享有最惠国待遇的进口货物所适用的海关征税比率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rata li biha jiġi kkalkolat id-dazju doganali fuq merkanzija importata li tkun eliġibbli għat-trattament tan-nazzjon l-aktar favorit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A most favoured nation customs duty rate determines the customs tax on imports qualifying for that treatment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最惠国税率，在此指给予享有最惠国待遇的贸易伙伴的关税税率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rata tad-dazju mogħtija lil merkanzija minn sħab kummerċjali li jgawdu t-trattament tan-nazzjon l-aktar favorit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A most favoured nation rate is the tariff rate applied to imports benefiting from most-favoured-nation treatment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最惠国关税，指按最惠国待遇对有关进口货物征收的关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dazju impost fuq merkanzija importata skont it-trattament tan-nazzjon l-aktar favorit mogħti lill-pajjiż minn fejn tiġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A most-favoured-nation tariff is a customs duty charged on imports covered by most-favoured-nation treatment.

collocations.en: a reduction in the most-favoured-nation tariff

collocations.mt: it-tariffa tal-pajjiż l-aktar favorit għal dan il-prodott
collocations.en: the most-favoured-nation tariff for this product
collocations.zh: 该产品的最惠国关税税率

formal.mt: It-tabella turi t-tariffa tal-pajjiż l-aktar favorit għal kull prodott u tqabbilha mar-rata preferenzjali rilevanti.
formal.en: The table shows the most-favoured-nation tariff for each product and compares it with the relevant preferential rate.
formal.zh: 该表列出各产品的最惠国关税税率，并将其与相关优惠税率进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn insib it-tariffa tal-pajjiż l-aktar favorit għal dan il-prodott? David: Ara l-kolonna MFN fit-tabella; hemmhekk issib ir-rata.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I find the most-favoured-nation tariff for this product? David: Look at the MFN column in the table; you will find the rate there.
colloquial.zh: Lara：在哪里能查到这个产品的最惠国关税税率？David：看表里的 MFN 栏，那里列着税率。

messages.speaker: Lara (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn insib it-tariffa tal-pajjiż l-aktar favorit għal dan il-prodott?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn insib it-tariffa tal-pajjiż l-aktar favorit għal dan il-prodott?
messages.zh: 在哪里能查到这个产品的最惠国关税税率？
messages.en: Where can I find the most-favoured-nation tariff for this product?

messages.speaker: David (报关顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara l-kolonna MFN fit-tabella; hemmhekk issib ir-rata.
messages.mt_standard: Ara l-kolonna MFN fit-tabella; hemmhekk issib ir-rata.
messages.zh: 看表里的 MFN 栏，那里列着税率。
messages.en: Look at the MFN column in the table; you will find the rate there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整词组与税率表中的 MFN 栏绑定记忆：最惠国待遇对应一类适用税率，不必理解成只给某一个国家的特别优惠。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of throwing away an object that is no longer wanted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把不再需要的物品扔掉的行为，即丢弃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitfa' oġġett li ma jkunx għadu jrid iżomm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丢弃；把不再需要的东西扔掉这一行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jeħles minn xi ħaġa li ma jkunx għadu jrid billi jitfagħha jew jarmiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Throwing away is the act of discarding something that is no longer wanted.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扔；投掷；用手或手臂的动作使物体抛向空中或某个方向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tibgħat oġġett fl-arja jew lejn direzzjoni billi ċċaqlaq idek jew driegħek u tħallih jitlaq minn idek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you throw something, you send it through the air with a movement of your hand or arm.

collocations.en: throw the paper into the rubbish bin

formal.mt: Qabel ma tarmi dokument, iċċekkja jekk għandux jinżamm fl-arkivju.
formal.en: Before you throw away a document, check whether it should be kept in the archive.
formal.zh: 丢弃文件之前，请检查它是否应当归档保存。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tarmi din il-kaxxa? Mark: Le, għadni nużaha biex inżomm il-kotba fiha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to throw away this box? Mark: No, I still use it to keep my books in.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要把这个箱子扔掉吗？Mark：不，我还用它装书呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你要把这个箱子扔掉吗？
messages.en: Are you going to throw away this box?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadni nużaha biex inżomm il-kotba fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadni nużaha biex inżomm il-kotba fiha.
messages.zh: 不，我还用它装书呢。
messages.en: No, I still use it to keep my books in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动作画面区分意义：tarmi l-ballun 是把球扔出去，tarmi l-iskart 是把垃圾丢掉；是否丢弃要看宾语和场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tartana is a type of fishing boat known in English as a tartan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为塔尔坦式渔船的捕鱼船。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tartana hija tip ta' dgħajsa li tintuża għas-sajd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塔尔坦式渔船，一种用于捕鱼的船。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tartana hija dgħajsa tas-sajd ta' tip partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tartana is a particular type of boat used for fishing.

collocations.zh: 在那艘塔尔坦式渔船上

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi tartana li tintuża għas-sajd qrib il-kosta.
formal.en: The report describes a tartan fishing boat used for fishing near the coast.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一艘用于近岸捕鱼的塔尔坦式渔船。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik it-tartana ta' min hi? Pawlu: Hi ta' ziju. Jużaha għas-sajd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Whose tartan fishing boat is that? Pawlu: It belongs to my uncle. He uses it for fishing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那艘塔尔坦式渔船是谁的？保罗：我叔叔的。他用它捕鱼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那艘塔尔坦式渔船是谁的？
messages.en: Whose tartan fishing boat is that?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我叔叔的。他用它捕鱼。
messages.en: It belongs to my uncle. He uses it for fishing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tartana 和一艘载着渔网的小船画在同一张词卡上，借捕鱼场景记住船名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tartru is tartar on teeth or sediment deposited by a liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指牙齿表面的牙结石，也可指液体留下的沉淀物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tartru huwa depożitu iebes fuq is-snien jew materjal li jinġabar fil-qiegħ ta' likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牙结石，附着在牙齿表面的硬质沉积物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tartru huwa depożitu iebes li jifforma fuq il-wiċċ tas-snien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tartar is a hard deposit that forms on the surface of your teeth.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沉淀物，从液体中沉降并积聚在容器底部的物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tartru huwa materjal solidu li jissepara minn likwidu u jinġabar fil-qiegħ tal-kontenitur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sediment is solid material that settles at the bottom of a liquid.

collocations.en: sediment at the bottom of the bottle

formal.mt: Id-dentist innota tartru fuq is-snien waqt l-eżami.
formal.en: The dentist noted tartar on the teeth during the examination.
formal.zh: 牙医在检查时发现牙齿上有牙结石。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm fil-qiegħ tal-flixkun? Mark: Hemm ftit tartru. Ferra' bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's at the bottom of the bottle? Mark: There's a little sediment. Pour slowly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：瓶底有什么？马克：有一点沉淀物。慢慢倒。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 瓶底有什么？
messages.en: What's at the bottom of the bottle?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有一点沉淀物。慢慢倒。
messages.en: There's a little sediment. Pour slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅沉积图记 tartru：一幅画牙齿上的硬垢，一幅画瓶底的沉淀，再靠上下文区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something described as tas-suf is made of wool.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于说明衣物或其他物品由羊毛制成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-espressjoni tas-suf tiddeskrivi oġġett magħmul mis-suf, bħal ġerżì jew kutra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羊毛制的，指用羊毛纤维制成的衣物、织物或其他物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta oġġett ikun tas-suf, ikun magħmul minn fibri tas-suf.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is woolen is made from wool fibers.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jinkludi kutra tas-suf adattata għall-iljieli kesħin.
formal.en: The catalogue includes a woolen blanket suitable for cold nights.
formal.zh: 商品目录中有一条适合寒冷夜晚使用的羊毛毯。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ġerżì tas-suf? Rita: Iva, tas-suf. Trid tippruvah?
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this sweater made of wool? Rita: Yes, it's woolen. Would you like to try it on?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这件毛衣是羊毛制的吗？丽塔：是的，是羊毛的。你想试穿吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件毛衣是羊毛制的吗？
messages.en: Is this sweater made of wool?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，是羊毛的。你想试穿吗？
messages.en: Yes, it's woolen. Would you like to try it on?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tas-suf 当作回答材质问题的小标签，贴在羊毛衫和羊毛毯的图片旁，记住它表示羊毛制的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tasida is a mess in which things are untidy or badly organized.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物品杂乱无章或事情缺乏条理的混乱状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tasida hija stat ta' taħwid jew nuqqas ta' ordni fl-affarijiet jew f'sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂乱、混乱，指东西没有收拾好或事情缺乏秩序的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tasida hija taħwida li fiha l-affarijiet ma jkunux f'posthom jew ma jkunux organizzati sew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mess is a state in which things are untidy or poorly organized.

formal.mt: Wara ċ-ċaqliq tal-għamara, l-uffiċċju kien tasida sħiħa.
formal.en: After the furniture was moved, the office was a complete mess.
formal.zh: 家具搬动之后，办公室里一片混乱。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hemm din it-tasida kollha fuq il-mejda? Ben: Kont qed infittex iċ-ċwievet. Issa nirranġa kollox.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is there such a mess on the table? Ben: I was looking for the keys. I'll tidy everything up now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：桌上怎么这么乱？本：我刚才在找钥匙。我现在就收拾好。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm din it-tasida kollha fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm din it-tasida kollha fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 桌上怎么这么乱？
messages.en: Why is there such a mess on the table?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont qed infittex iċ-ċwievet. Issa nirranġa kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Kont qed infittex iċ-ċwievet. Issa nirranġa kollox.
messages.zh: 我刚才在找钥匙。我现在就收拾好。
messages.en: I was looking for the keys. I'll tidy everything up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象找钥匙时把整桌东西翻乱的画面，将 tasida 与眼前乱糟糟的状态一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 所给释义含混，具体中文义待语境确认

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression supplied with the unclear gloss 'she gave in her head', whose intended meaning requires context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料中释作“she gave in her head”的表达；这一英文释义不够明确，无法单凭它确定具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li fil-materjal mogħti għandha l-ispjegazzjoni 'she gave in her head'; din l-ispjegazzjoni mhijiex ċara biżżejjed biex it-tifsira tiġi stabbilita mingħajr kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给英文释义含混，尚不能确定对应的具体中文含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal jagħti din l-ispjegazzjoni għall-espressjoni 'tatha rasha', iżda jeħtieġ kuntest biex ikun ċar x'tfisser.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression has an unclear supplied gloss, so its intended meaning cannot be established without context.

formal.mt: Biex tiġi spjegata l-espressjoni 'tatha rasha', għandha tingħata s-sentenza sħiħa li fiha tidher.
formal.en: To explain the expression 'tatha rasha', the complete sentence in which it appears should be provided.
formal.zh: 要解释“tatha rasha”这一表达，应提供它所在的完整句子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'tatha rasha' hawn? Pawlu: Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha biex nifhmuha aħjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'tatha rasha' mean here? Pawlu: Let's read the whole sentence to understand it better.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的“tatha rasha”是什么意思？保罗：我们把整句话读一下，好理解得更清楚。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“tatha rasha”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tatha rasha' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha biex nifhmuha aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha biex nifhmuha aħjar.
messages.zh: 我们把整句话读一下，好理解得更清楚。
messages.en: Let's read the whole sentence to understand it better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 tatha rasha 作为完整表达记下，并配上完整例句；所给释义含混时，不靠拆词猜出固定中文义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A method or plan chosen to achieve a particular result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为取得某种结果而采用的方法或计划，可指具体战术，也可指较整体的策略。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Metodu jew pjan magħżul biex jintlaħaq għan partikolari, kemm f'azzjoni speċifika kif ukoll fl-organizzazzjoni ta' diversi azzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 战术；为达到某一具体目的而采取的办法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod speċifiku ta' kif wieħed jaġixxi biex jikseb riżultat mixtieq f'sitwazzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tactic is a particular method you use to achieve something in a specific situation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 策略；为实现目标而安排各项行动的总体办法或计划。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjan jew mod ġenerali ta' kif jiġu organizzati l-azzjonijiet biex jintlaħaq għan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A strategy is a general plan that guides your actions towards a particular goal.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat adotta tattika ġdida biex iżid il-parteċipazzjoni: bagħat stedina personali lil kull membru.
formal.en: The committee adopted a new tactic to increase participation: it sent a personal invitation to each member.
formal.zh: 委员会采用了一项提高参与度的新策略：向每位成员发送个人邀请。

colloquial.mt: Marta: It-tattika tagħna mhix qed taħdem; għadna nitilfu l-ballun. Ġanni: Mela nibdluha u ngħaddu l-ballun aktar malajr.
colloquial.en: Marta: Our tactic isn't working; we keep losing the ball. Ġanni: Then let's change it and pass the ball more quickly.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们的战术不管用，还是老丢球。詹尼：那就换个办法，传球再快一点。

messages.speaker: Marta (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tattika tagħna mhix qed taħdem; għadna nitilfu l-ballun.
messages.mt_standard: It-tattika tagħna mhix qed taħdem; għadna nitilfu l-ballun.
messages.zh: 我们的战术不管用，还是老丢球。
messages.en: Our tactic isn't working; we keep losing the ball.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nibdluha u ngħaddu l-ballun aktar malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nibdluha u ngħaddu l-ballun aktar malajr.
messages.zh: 那就换个办法，传球再快一点。
messages.en: Then let's change it and pass the ball more quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tattika 记成比赛前画出的行动方案：具体一招是“战术”，统筹多步是“策略”，两者都围绕如何达成目标。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to methods or decisions intended to achieve a particular objective.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与实现某一目标所采用的战术、方法或策略安排有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-metodi jew mad-deċiżjonijiet magħżula biex jintlaħaq għan partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 战术上的；策略性的，指服务于特定目标的方法或行动安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-għażla u l-użu ta' metodi jew azzjonijiet biex jinkiseb riżultat mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tactical decision or action is chosen because it helps you achieve a particular objective.

formal.mt: Il-pjan tattiku tat-tim kien li jżomm il-ballun u jistenna l-mument xieraq biex jattakka.
formal.en: The team's tactical plan was to keep possession of the ball and wait for the right moment to attack.
formal.zh: 球队的战术计划是控制球权，等待合适的时机进攻。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex biddilt il-pożizzjoni tiegħek? Mark: Kien pass tattiku biex ikolli aktar spazju.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you change your position? Mark: It was a tactical move to give me more space.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么换了位置？马克：这是个战术调整，好让我有更多空间。

messages.speaker: Nina (队友)
messages.zh: 你为什么换了位置？
messages.en: Why did you change your position?

messages.speaker: Mark (球员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien pass tattiku biex ikolli aktar spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Kien pass tattiku biex ikolli aktar spazju.
messages.zh: 这是个战术调整，好让我有更多空间。
messages.en: It was a tactical move to give me more space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tattiku 放进 pjan tattiku 一起记：计划回答“怎么行动”，tattiku 则说明这个计划具有战术目的。

gloss_zh: 营业额税；按营业收入总额征收的税

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tax calculated on a business's turnover, meaning its total sales revenue rather than its profit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以企业的营业收入总额或销售总额为计税依据的税，而不是按利润计算的税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din hija taxxa kkalkulata fuq id-dħul totali mill-bejgħ ta' negozju, mhux fuq il-profitt tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 营业额税，即以企业营业收入总额为计税依据的税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taxxa fuq id-dħul minn negozju hija taxxa li tiġi kkalkulata fuq il-valur totali tal-bejgħ tan-negozju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A turnover tax is a tax based on a business's total sales revenue.

collocations.mt: jikkalkula t-taxxa fuq id-dħul minn negozju
ir-rata tat-taxxa fuq id-dħul minn negozju

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, it-taxxa fuq id-dħul minn negozju tiġi kkalkulata fuq il-bejgħ totali, mhux fuq il-profitt.
formal.en: In this example, turnover tax is calculated on total sales rather than profit.
formal.zh: 在本例中，营业额税按销售总额计算，而不是按利润计算。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, it-taxxa fuq id-dħul minn negozju tiġi kkalkulata fuq il-profitt? Mark: Le, fuq il-bejgħ totali, qabel ma jitnaqqsu l-ispejjeż.
colloquial.en: Maja: In this exercise, is turnover tax calculated on profit? Mark: No, on total sales before expenses are deducted.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这道练习里的营业额税是按利润计算的吗？Mark：不是，是按扣除费用前的销售总额计算的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, it-taxxa fuq id-dħul minn negozju tiġi kkalkulata fuq il-profitt?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, it-taxxa fuq id-dħul minn negozju tiġi kkalkulata fuq il-profitt?
messages.zh: 这道练习里的营业额税是按利润计算的吗？
messages.en: In this exercise, is turnover tax calculated on profit?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fuq il-bejgħ totali, qabel ma jitnaqqsu l-ispejjeż.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fuq il-bejgħ totali, qabel ma jitnaqqsu l-ispejjeż.
messages.zh: 不是，是按扣除费用前的销售总额计算的。
messages.en: No, on total sales before expenses are deducted.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记：taxxa“税”、fuq id-dħul“按收入”、minn negozju“来自经营”。本词条对应 turnover tax，重点记住营业总额这个计税概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tax charged on goods brought into a country from another country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对从其他国家输入本国的货物征收的税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taxxa tal-importazzjoni hija taxxa imposta fuq merkanzija li tiddaħħal f'pajjiż minn pajjiż ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口关税，即对进口货物征收的海关税款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din hija taxxa doganali imposta fuq merkanzija li tidħol fil-pajjiż minn barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs duty on imports is a tax charged on goods entering a country from abroad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口关税，对输入本国的货物征收的税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taxxa tal-importazzjoni hija ħlas fiskali impost fuq oġġetti importati minn pajjiż ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An import duty is a tax that a country charges on goods imported from elsewhere.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口税，针对从国外输入的货物征收的税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din hija taxxa li tiġi imposta fuq oġġetti meta jiġu importati fil-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An import tax is a tax imposed on goods brought into a country from abroad.

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-kalkolu, l-ispiża totali tinkludi l-prezz tal-merkanzija, it-trasport u t-taxxa tal-importazzjoni.
formal.en: In the calculation example, the total cost includes the price of the goods, transport, and import duty.
formal.zh: 在这道计算例题中，总成本包括货价、运输费和进口关税。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-prezz jinkludi t-taxxa tal-importazzjoni? Mark: Le, trid iżżidha biex issib l-ispiża totali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this price include import duty? Mark: No, you need to add it to find the total cost.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个价格包含进口关税吗？Mark：不包含，你得把它加上才能算出总成本。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个价格包含进口关税吗？
messages.en: Does this price include import duty?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, trid iżżidha biex issib l-ispiża totali.
messages.mt_standard: Le, trid iżżidha biex issib l-ispiża totali.
messages.zh: 不包含，你得把它加上才能算出总成本。
messages.en: No, you need to add it to find the total cost.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taxxa“税”和 importazzjoni“进口”连起来，想象进口货物旁有一张税款单；再用 iħallas it-taxxa tal-importazzjoni“缴纳进口税”巩固搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official court notice requiring someone to appear, or a legal prosecution against someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求某人出庭的正式法院通知；也可指对某人提起的刑事起诉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avviż uffiċjali tal-qorti li jitlob lil xi ħadd jidher quddiemha, jew proċedura legali kontra persuna akkużata b'reat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法院发出的、要求某人在指定时间出庭的正式传票。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali maħruġ mill-qorti li jordna lil persuna tidher quddiemha f'ħin stabbilit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A court summons is an official document requiring a person to appear in court at a specified time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就涉嫌犯罪的行为对某人提起的刑事起诉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura legali li biha persuna tiġi akkużata b'reat u titressaq quddiem il-qorti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prosecution is a legal proceeding in which someone is formally accused of committing a crime.

formal.mt: Ix-xhud irċieva taħrika biex jidher quddiem il-qorti nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The witness received a summons to appear in court on Monday.
formal.zh: 证人收到传票，须于星期一出庭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien hemm fl-ittra? Mark: Taħrika tal-qorti. Irrid nidher bħala xhud nhar it-Tnejn. Maja: Ara li tiċċekkja l-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was in the letter? Mark: A court summons. I have to appear as a witness on Monday. Maja: Make sure you check the time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：信里是什么？Mark：法院传票。我星期一得作为证人出庭。Maja：记得核对时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 信里是什么？
messages.en: What was in the letter?

messages.speaker: Mark (证人)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħrika tal-qorti. Irrid nidher bħala xhud nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Taħrika tal-qorti. Irrid nidher bħala xhud nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.zh: 法院传票。我星期一得作为证人出庭。
messages.en: A court summons. I have to appear as a witness on Monday.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 记得核对时间。
messages.en: Make sure you check the time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“收到法院信件、核对出庭时间”的画面中记忆；再用“传票是文件，起诉是程序”区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 受苦；痛苦（本条按所给名词词性处理）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suffering or distress, treated as a noun in this packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承受疼痛、困难或不幸的痛苦状态；本条依照所给词性作为名词学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' uġigħ, tbatija jew dwejjaq; f'dan il-pakkett il-kelma hija mniżżla bħala nom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受苦或承受痛苦；原英文释义采用动词形式，但本义项标注为名词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' min jgħaddi minn uġigħ jew tbatija; il-kelma hija ttrattata bħala nom skont it-tikketta mogħtija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry presents suffering as a noun, although its supplied English gloss uses a verb.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tbagħti tal-pazjent u jenfasizza l-ħtieġa ta' kura xierqa.
formal.en: The report describes the patient's suffering and emphasizes the need for appropriate care.
formal.zh: 报告描述了患者的痛苦，并强调提供适当照护的必要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiddeskrivi dan ir-rapport? Mark: It-tbagħti tal-pazjent u l-għajnuna li għandu bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this report describe? Mark: The patient's suffering and the help he needs.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份报告描述了什么？马克：患者的痛苦，以及他需要的帮助。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这份报告描述了什么？
messages.en: What does this report describe?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tbagħti tal-pazjent u l-għajnuna li għandu bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: It-tbagħti tal-pazjent u l-għajnuna li għandu bżonn.
messages.zh: 患者的痛苦，以及他需要的帮助。
messages.en: The patient's suffering and the help he needs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词卡与“患者承受痛苦”的画面联系起来；本包标为名词，记成“痛苦这一状态”，同时留意英文原释义的词性差异。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enjoy oneself enthusiastically, especially while celebrating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在庆祝或娱乐活动中尽情享乐，表现得十分欢快。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeverti ħafna u jieħu gost b'ħeġġa, speċjalment waqt festa jew ċelebrazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尽情欢乐，尤指在庆祝活动中纵情玩乐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jieħu gost ħafna u jiddeverti b'entużjażmu waqt festa jew attività ta' divertiment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone revels, they enjoy themselves enthusiastically, especially at a celebration.

collocations.zh: 在庆祝活动中尽情欢乐

formal.mt: Wara t-tmiem tal-eżamijiet, Pawlu tbaħrad mal-ħbieb tiegħu waqt iċ-ċelebrazzjoni.
formal.en: After the exams ended, Pawlu revelled with his friends during the celebration.
formal.zh: 考试结束后，保罗在庆祝活动中与朋友们尽情欢乐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ħa gost fil-festa lbieraħ? Rita: U kif! Tbaħrad mal-ħbieb sa tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu enjoy the party yesterday? Rita: He certainly did! He revelled with his friends until late.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗昨天聚会玩得开心吗？丽塔：可开心了！他和朋友们一直尽兴玩到很晚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗昨天聚会玩得开心吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu enjoy the party yesterday?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: U kif! Tbaħrad mal-ħbieb sa tard.
messages.mt_standard: U kif! Tbaħrad mal-ħbieb sa tard.
messages.zh: 可开心了！他和朋友们一直尽兴玩到很晚。
messages.en: He certainly did! He revelled with his friends until late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象考完试后与朋友尽情庆祝的场面，把 tbaħrad 与“玩得非常尽兴”相连；这是情境记忆，不是词源拆解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not established by the supplied packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给资料将此词标为名词，但没有提供可确定的词义；目前只能学习其拼写和词性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex stabbilita fil-pakkett mogħti, għax il-glossa hija mmarkata b'żewġ punti ta' mistoqsija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 释义未知；资料仅给出名词词性，无法据此确定具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhijiex mogħtija; iż-żewġ punti ta' mistoqsija jindikaw li l-glossa għadha mhux magħrufa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry identifies a noun but does not establish what it means.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'tbaħrit' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda l-materjal mogħti ma jispeċifikax it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'tbaħrit' is listed as a noun, but the supplied material does not specify its meaning.
formal.zh: “tbaħrit”被列为名词，但所给材料没有说明它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'tbaħrit'? Mark: Hawn m'hemmx tifsira ċara; nafu biss li hija mniżżla bħala nom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'tbaħrit' mean? Mark: There is no clear definition here; we only know that it is listed as a noun.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“tbaħrit”是什么意思？马克：这里没有明确释义；我们只知道它被列为名词。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “tbaħrit”是什么意思？

messages.mt_standard: Hawn m'hemmx tifsira ċara; nafu biss li hija mniżżla bħala nom.
messages.zh: 这里没有明确释义；我们只知道它被列为名词。

gloss_zh: 染上跳蚤；变得有跳蚤寄生

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become infested with fleas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原先没有或未明显出现跳蚤的人或动物等，变得有跳蚤寄生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir infestat bil-briegħed, jiġifieri jibda jkollu l-briegħed fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 染上跳蚤，进入有跳蚤寄生的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibda jkollu l-briegħed fuqu u b'hekk isir infestat bihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an animal becomes infested with fleas, fleas begin living on its body.

collocations.en: the dog became infested with fleas
the cat became infested with fleas

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-kelb tbergħed waqt li kien jgħix fit-triq.
formal.en: The report indicates that the dog became infested with fleas while it was living on the street.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这只狗在街头流浪期间染上了跳蚤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kelb qed jitħakkek daqshekk? Mark: Tbergħed. Se nieħdu għand il-veterinarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the dog scratching so much? Mark: He has become infested with fleas. I'm taking him to the vet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只狗怎么一直抓痒？马克：它染上跳蚤了。我要带它去看兽医。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这只狗怎么一直抓痒？
messages.en: Why is the dog scratching so much?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.zh: 它染上跳蚤了。我要带它去看兽医。
messages.en: He has become infested with fleas. I'm taking him to the vet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只原本安静的小狗突然不停抓痒，用这个变化记住 tbergħed：重点是“染上跳蚤、变得有跳蚤”，而不只是一般发痒。

gloss_zh: 词义未明确；原释义为“Manafx”（不知道）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun entry written as 'Tchaikovsky', whose meaning is not established by the supplied definition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写作“Tchaikovsky”的名词条目；所给释义不足以确定其具体所指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata miktuba 'Tchaikovsky' u kklassifikata bħala nom, iżda li t-tifsira tagħha mhijiex iċċarata mid-definizzjoni mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义表示“不知道”，因此此处无法确定该名词的具体词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma 'Manafx' fid-definizzjoni mogħtija tesprimi nuqqas ta' għarfien u ma tispeċifikax it-tifsira ta' dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied definition expresses uncertainty and does not establish what this noun refers to.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'Tchaikovsky' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda d-definizzjoni 'Manafx' ma tagħtix tifsira li tista' tintuża fit-tagħlim.
formal.en: The entry 'Tchaikovsky' is listed as a noun, but the definition 'Manafx' does not provide a meaning that can be used for teaching.
formal.zh: “Tchaikovsky”词条被列为名词，但“Manafx”这一释义没有提供可供教学使用的词义。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser 'Tchaikovsky' f'din il-lista? Mark: Il-lista ma tiċċarax it-tifsira; aħjar inħalluha bħala mhux magħrufa.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does 'Tchaikovsky' mean in this list? Mark: The list does not clarify the meaning; we should leave it marked as unknown.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这份词表里的“Tchaikovsky”是什么意思？马克：词表没有说明清楚，我们先把它标为词义未知吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这份词表里的“Tchaikovsky”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Tchaikovsky' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lista ma tiċċarax it-tifsira; aħjar inħalluha bħala mhux magħrufa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-lista ma tiċċarax it-tifsira; aħjar inħalluha bħala mhux magħrufa.
messages.zh: 词表没有说明清楚，我们先把它标为词义未知吧。
messages.en: The list does not clarify the meaning; we should leave it marked as unknown.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“待确认词义”卡片：先记拼写，不凭熟悉感补上材料未给的含义。

gloss_zh: 夸大；夸张地描述（按所给动词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the supplied verb sense, to describe something as greater, more serious, or more dramatic than it really is.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按所给动词义，指把某事描述得比实际更大、更严重或更富戏剧性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fis-sens verbali mogħti, tfisser li tippreżenta xi ħaġa bħala akbar, aktar serja jew aktar drammatika milli hi fir-realtà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夸大；将事物的程度、规模或严重性描述得超过实际情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tippreżenta jew tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa b'mod li jagħmilha tidher akbar, aktar importanti jew aktar serja milli tassew hi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone exaggerates something, they describe it as greater or more serious than it really is.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'teatrin' tingħata fis-sens verbali ta' 'tesaġera': tiddeskrivi problema żgħira bħallikieku kienet diżastru.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'teatrin' is given the verb sense 'exaggerate': describing a small problem as though it were a disaster.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“teatrin”按动词“夸大”理解：把一个小问题描述得仿佛是一场灾难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġifieri 'teatrin' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Lara: Hawn tfisser 'tesaġera', bħal meta tgħid li stennejt siegħa u fil-fatt kienu ħames minuti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'teatrin' mean in this exercise? Lara: Here it means 'exaggerate', like saying you waited an hour when it was actually five minutes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习里的“teatrin”是什么意思？拉拉：这里是“夸大”的意思，比如实际上只等了五分钟，却说自己等了一个小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的“teatrin”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'teatrin' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser 'tesaġera', bħal meta tgħid li stennejt siegħa u fil-fatt kienu ħames minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser 'tesaġera', bħal meta tgħid li stennejt siegħa u fil-fatt kienu ħames minuti.
messages.zh: 这里是“夸大”的意思，比如实际上只等了五分钟，却说自己等了一个小时。
messages.en: Here it means 'exaggerate', like saying you waited an hour when it was actually five minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“五分钟说成一小时”的画面记住所给动词义：描述超过事实，就是夸大；不据此推断词形变化。

gloss_zh: 棺材制作工；制作棺材的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is making coffins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以制作棺材为工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha huwa li tagħmel it-twiebet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作棺材的工匠或从业者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li timmanifattura t-twiebet li jintużaw għad-dfin tal-mejtin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coffin maker is someone whose job is to make coffins for the dead.

collocations.zh: 技艺熟练的棺材制作工

formal.mt: It-tebutier ħejja t-tebut skont il-qisien mitluba u ċċekkja li kien magħmul sew.
formal.en: The coffin maker prepared the coffin to the requested dimensions and checked that it was well made.
formal.zh: 棺材制作工按照要求的尺寸制作了棺材，并检查了制作质量。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jagħmel it-tebut? Rita: It-tebutier tal-lokal; se nkellmu llum dwar il-qisien.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is going to make the coffin? Rita: The local coffin maker; we will speak to him today about the dimensions.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁来制作棺材？丽塔：本地的棺材制作工；我们今天会跟他谈尺寸。

messages.speaker: Mark (家属)
messages.zh: 谁来制作棺材？
messages.en: Who is going to make the coffin?

messages.speaker: Rita (家属)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tebutier tal-lokal; se nkellmu llum dwar il-qisien.
messages.mt_standard: It-tebutier tal-lokal; se nkellmu llum dwar il-qisien.
messages.zh: 本地的棺材制作工；我们今天会跟他谈尺寸。
messages.en: The local coffin maker; we will speak to him today about the dimensions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词卡配上“工匠量尺寸、制作棺材”的画面，记住它指制作棺材的人，而不是棺材本身。

gloss_zh: 刺激物；令人烦扰的人或事物（按所给名词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the supplied noun sense, a substance that causes irritation, or a person or thing that causes annoyance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按所给名词义，指引起身体刺激的物质，或使人烦恼的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fis-sens nominali mogħti, tindika sustanza li tikkawża irritazzjoni, jew persuna jew ħaġa li tqajjem dwejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺激物；引起身体刺激的物质，或引起烦扰的人、事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza li tikkawża irritazzjoni fil-ġisem, jew persuna jew ħaġa li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss dwejjaq jew irritazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An irritant is a substance that causes physical irritation, or someone or something that causes annoyance.

collocations.en: 'tedjanti' in the sense of 'an irritating substance'
'tedjanti' in the sense of 'a source of annoyance'

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, 'tedjanti' tintuża bħala nom għal xi ħaġa li tqajjem dwejjaq; l-eżempju huwa ħoss kontinwu li jfixkel il-konċentrazzjoni.
formal.en: In this text, 'tedjanti' is used as a noun for something that causes annoyance; the example is a continuous noise that disrupts concentration.
formal.zh: 在本文中，“tedjanti”按名词使用，指令人烦扰的事物；例子是持续干扰注意力的噪声。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'tindika 'tedjanti' hawn? Pawlu: Xi ħaġa li ddejqek, bħal dak il-ħoss li ma jieqaf qatt.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does 'tedjanti' refer to here? Pawlu: Something that annoys you, like that noise that never stops.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这里的“tedjanti”指什么？保罗：让你烦恼的东西，比如那个一直不停的噪声。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“tedjanti”指什么？
messages.en: What does 'tedjanti' refer to here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħaġa li ddejqek, bħal dak il-ħoss li ma jieqaf qatt.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħaġa li ddejqek, bħal dak il-ħoss li ma jieqaf qatt.
messages.zh: 让你烦恼的东西，比如那个一直不停的噪声。
messages.en: Something that annoys you, like that noise that never stops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记住所给名词义：刺激皮肤的物质，以及一直响的烦人噪声；共同点都是引起刺激或烦扰的来源。

gloss_zh: 冗长乏味的；令人厌烦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Boring or tiring because something continues too long or involves too much repetition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因持续时间过长或重复过多而使人感到乏味、厌烦或疲倦的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jdejjaq jew jgħejji għax idum wisq jew jinvolvi ħafna ripetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冗长乏味的；因耗时或重复而令人感到无聊的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jdejjaq minħabba t-tul tiegħu jew minħabba li l-istess ħaġa tibqa' tirrepeti ruħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something tedious makes you feel bored because it takes a long time or involves repeated actions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人厌烦或疲倦的；使人逐渐失去耐心的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil dak li jkun jiddejjaq, jegħja jew jitlef il-paċenzja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something tiresome annoys or wearies you and makes it difficult to remain patient.

formal.mt: Il-proċess tal-ikkupjar bl-idejn kien tedjuż minħabba l-ħafna ripetizzjoni.
formal.en: The process of copying by hand was tedious because it involved so much repetition.
formal.zh: 手工抄写的过程包含大量重复操作，因此十分乏味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-eżerċizzju huwa tedjuż; kull mistoqsija hija bħall-oħra. Mark: Ejja nieħdu pawża qasira, imbagħad inkomplu.
colloquial.en: Maja: This exercise is tedious; every question is like the previous one. Mark: Let's take a short break and then carry on.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个练习真乏味，每道题都跟上一道差不多。马克：我们先休息一会儿，然后继续。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-eżerċizzju huwa tedjuż; kull mistoqsija hija bħall-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-eżerċizzju huwa tedjuż; kull mistoqsija hija bħall-oħra.
messages.zh: 这个练习真乏味，每道题都跟上一道差不多。
messages.en: This exercise is tedious; every question is like the previous one.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieħdu pawża qasira, imbagħad inkomplu.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieħdu pawża qasira, imbagħad inkomplu.
messages.zh: 我们先休息一会儿，然后继续。
messages.en: Let's take a short break and then carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象反复抄写同一句话，越写越无聊：用 tedjuż 形容这种冗长乏味、令人厌烦的感觉。

gloss_zh: 没有投掷这件事；未发生扔掷的情况

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fact that someone did not throw something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人没有实施投掷动作这一事实或情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li persuna ma waddbitx xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 没有扔出某物这一事实；未实施投掷的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li ma seħħet ebda azzjoni ta' tfigħ minn persuna f'sitwazzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This refers to the fact that someone did not perform an act of throwing.

formal.mt: L-osservatur irreġistra li ma sar ebda tfigħ tal-ballun matul l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: The observer recorded that no throwing of the ball took place during the exercise.
formal.zh: 观察员记录了练习期间未发生投球行为这一情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tefa' l-ballun? Nina: Le, żammu f'idu l-ħin kollu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did he throw the ball? Nina: No, he kept it in his hand the whole time.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他把球扔出去了吗？妮娜：没有，他一直把球拿在手里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他把球扔出去了吗？
messages.en: Did he throw the ball?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，他一直把球拿在手里。
messages.en: No, he kept it in his hand the whole time.
