cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面记住“没有扔”这件事：球始终留在手里，没有飞出去；把整个未发生投掷的情况作为记忆单位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something move through the air by releasing it with a movement of the hand or arm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过手或手臂的动作将物体送出，使其在空中移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twaddab xi ħaġa fl-arja billi ċċaqlaq idek jew driegħek u titlaqha minn idek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扔；投掷；用手或手臂的动作将物体抛出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Twaddab oġġett minn idek sabiex jimxi fl-arja lejn post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you throw something, you use your hand or arm to send it through the air.

collocations.en: she threw the paper into the bin

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenta tefgħet il-ballun lejn il-mira.
formal.en: During the exercise, the student threw the ball towards the target.
formal.zh: 练习时，那名女学生把球投向了目标。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi l-karta li kienet fuq il-mejda? Nina: Marta tefgħet il-karta fil-basket.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the paper that was on the table? Nina: Marta threw the paper into the bin.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：刚才桌上的那张纸在哪里？妮娜：玛尔塔把纸扔进垃圾桶了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-karta li kienet fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-karta li kienet fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 刚才桌上的那张纸在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the paper that was on the table?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 玛尔塔把纸扔进垃圾桶了。
messages.en: Marta threw the paper into the bin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tefghet 与“挥动手臂、物体离手飞出”的连续画面联系起来，再用投球和扔纸两个场景巩固“扔”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tape is a long, narrow strip of material used for sticking things together or for recording sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于粘合、固定物件的长条带状材料，也可指用于录音的磁带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tejp huwa strixxa twila u dejqa ta' materjal li tintuża biex twaħħal affarijiet flimkien jew biex tirrekordja l-ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胶带；也可指用于录制、储存声音的磁带。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tejp huwa materjal f'forma ta' strixxa twila u dejqa, użat biex jitwaħħlu affarijiet jew biex jiġi rrekordjat il-ħoss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tape is a narrow strip of material that you use to stick things together or to record sound.

formal.mt: Il-pakkett għandu jingħalaq sew b'tejp adeżiv qabel jintbagħat.
formal.en: The package should be securely sealed with adhesive tape before it is sent.
formal.zh: 包裹寄出前，应使用胶带封牢。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek ftit tejp? Għandi bżonn nagħlaq din il-kaxxa. Mark: Iva, hawn ir-romblu. Trid ukoll l-imqass?
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you got some tape? I need to close this box. Mark: Yes, here's the roll. Do you need the scissors too?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有胶带吗？我得把这个箱子封起来。马克：有，这卷给你。你还需要剪刀吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ftit tejp? Għandi bżonn nagħlaq din il-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ftit tejp? Għandi bżonn nagħlaq din il-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 你有胶带吗？我得把这个箱子封起来。
messages.en: Have you got some tape? I need to close this box.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn ir-romblu. Trid ukoll l-imqass?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn ir-romblu. Trid ukoll l-imqass?
messages.zh: 有，这卷给你。你还需要剪刀吗？
messages.en: Yes, here's the roll. Do you need the scissors too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tejp 配上一卷胶带的画面记忆；遇到 adeżiv 想到粘贴，遇到 awdjo 想到录音。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tape recorder is a machine that records sound on magnetic tape and plays it back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用磁带录制声音，并能播放所录声音的机器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tejp rikorder huwa apparat li jirrekordja l-ħoss fuq tejp manjetiku u jista' jdoqq il-ħoss irrekordjat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磁带录音机，即利用磁带录制和播放声音的设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tejp rikorder huwa magna li tintuża biex tirrekordja l-vuċi jew ħsejjes oħra fuq tejp manjetiku u biex terġa' ddoqqhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tape recorder is a machine that allows you to record sounds on magnetic tape and listen to them again.

collocations.en: to switch on the tape recorder
to record with a tape recorder

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur uża tejp rikorder biex jirrekordja l-intervista bil-permess tal-parteċipant.
formal.en: The researcher used a tape recorder to record the interview with the participant's permission.
formal.zh: 研究人员经参与者同意，使用磁带录音机录下了访谈。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-tejp rikorder għadu jaħdem? Pawlu: Iva, daħħal it-tejp u agħfas il-buttuna biex tisma' r-reġistrazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this tape recorder still work? Pawlu: Yes, put in the tape and press the button to listen to the recording.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这台磁带录音机还能用吗？保罗：能，把磁带放进去，再按按钮就能听录音。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 这台磁带录音机还能用吗？
messages.en: Does this tape recorder still work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, daħħal it-tejp u agħfas il-buttuna biex tisma' r-reġistrazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, daħħal it-tejp u agħfas il-buttuna biex tisma' r-reġistrazzjoni.
messages.zh: 能，把磁带放进去，再按按钮就能听录音。
messages.en: Yes, put in the tape and press the button to listen to the recording.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tejp rikorder 和“放入磁带、按键录音”的动作一起记，整组对应磁带录音机。

gloss_zh: 跟踪与追溯系统；跟踪与追溯技术

teaching_sense.en_definition: Track and trace technology enables users to monitor an item's movement and look up its recorded journey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于跟踪物品流转情况，并查询其已记录流转路径的技术，也可指运用这种技术的系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-teknoloġija ta' traċċar u rintraċċar tippermetti li jiġi segwit il-moviment ta' oġġett u li tiġi ċċekkjata r-rotta tiegħu permezz tar-rekords.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跟踪与追溯系统，用于监测物品流转情况，并查询其已记录的流转路径。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema ta' traċċar u rintraċċar hija sistema li tirreġistra l-moviment ta' oġġett u tippermetti li jiġu ċċekkjati l-postijiet li għadda minnhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A track and trace system records an item's movements so that you can check its progress and review its journey.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跟踪与追溯技术，用于获取、记录和查询物品的位置与流转路径。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-teknoloġija ta' traċċar u rintraċċar hija t-teknoloġija użata biex jinġabru u jiġu kkonsultati rekords dwar il-post u l-moviment ta' oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Track and trace technology allows you to follow an item's movements and consult records of where it has been.

collocations.mt: l-użu tat-teknoloġija ta' traċċar u rintraċċar
collocations.en: the use of track and trace technology
collocations.zh: 跟踪与追溯技术的使用

collocations.mt: tintroduċi teknoloġija ta' traċċar u rintraċċar
collocations.en: to introduce track and trace technology

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija introduċiet teknoloġija ta' traċċar u rintraċċar biex issegwi l-vjeġġi u tivverifika r-rotta ta' kull pakkett.
formal.en: The company introduced track and trace technology to monitor shipments and verify the route of each package.
formal.zh: 公司引入了跟踪与追溯技术，以监测货物运输情况并核查每个包裹的流转路径。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif nista' nara minn fejn għadda l-pakkett tiegħi? David: Nużaw teknoloġija ta' traċċar u rintraċċar. Daħħal in-numru tal-pakkett fis-sit tagħna u tara r-rekords.
colloquial.en: Nina: How can I see where my package has been? David: We use track and trace technology. Enter the package number on our website and you'll see the records.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我怎么查看包裹经过了哪些地方？戴维：我们使用跟踪与追溯技术。在我们的网站上输入包裹编号，就能看到记录。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' nara minn fejn għadda l-pakkett tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' nara minn fejn għadda l-pakkett tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我怎么查看包裹经过了哪些地方？
messages.en: How can I see where my package has been?

messages.speaker: David (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nużaw teknoloġija ta' traċċar u rintraċċar. Daħħal in-numru tal-pakkett fis-sit tagħna u tara r-rekords.
messages.mt_standard: Nużaw teknoloġija ta' traċċar u rintraċċar. Daħħal in-numru tal-pakkett fis-sit tagħna u tara r-rekords.
messages.zh: 我们使用跟踪与追溯技术。在我们的网站上输入包裹编号，就能看到记录。
messages.en: We use track and trace technology. Enter the package number on our website and you'll see the records.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用包裹查询画面记整组词：一边查看运输进度，一边回看经过地点，对应“跟踪与追溯”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tick is a short, sharp sound such as one made by a clock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钟表等发出的短促、清脆的一声滴答。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tektika hija ħoss qasir u ċar bħal dak li jagħmel arloġġ meta jimxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滴答声，尤指钟表运转时发出的短促声响。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tektika hija ħoss qasir bħal wieħed mill-ħsejjes regolari li jagħmel arloġġ waqt li jkun miexi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tick is one of the short, sharp sounds that a clock makes as it runs.

formal.mt: Fil-kamra siekta, kull tektika tal-arloġġ kienet tinstema' b'mod ċar.
formal.en: In the silent room, every tick of the clock could be heard clearly.
formal.zh: 寂静的房间里，钟表的每一声滴答都清晰可闻。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt dik it-tektika? Ben: Iva, ġejja mill-arloġġ fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you hear that tick? Ben: Yes, it's coming from the clock on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听到那声滴答了吗？本：听到了，是架子上的钟发出的。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你听到那声滴答了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that tick?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 听到了，是架子上的钟发出的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the clock on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象安静房间里钟表响了一声“滴答”，把这一声短响与 tektika 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To release gas from the bowels through the anus; this informal expression is in the past tense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 口语表达，表示某人放了个屁；所给形式为过去时。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni informali fil-passat li tfisser li persuna ħarġet gass mill-imsaren minn wara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放屁，即从肛门排出肠道气体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Toħroġ gass mill-imsaren minn wara; l-espressjoni mogħtija tintuża b'mod informali fil-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone farts, they release gas from their bowels through their anus.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, wieħed mill-parteċipanti telaq waħda u talab skuża.
formal.en: During the meeting, one of the participants farted and apologized.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一名与会者放了个屁，随后道了歉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min telaq waħda? Pawlu: Jien, skużani. Ma għamiltx apposta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who farted? Pawlu: Me, sorry. I didn't do it on purpose.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁放屁了？保罗：我，对不起。我不是故意的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁放屁了？
messages.en: Who farted?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我，对不起。我不是故意的。
messages.en: Me, sorry. I didn't do it on purpose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语连同场景记忆：有人突然放屁后说对不起；telaq waħda 对应“放了个屁”，不要逐词硬译。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An occasion when someone contacts another person by telephone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电话联系他人的一次行为，指一通电话或一次通话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' kuntatt jew komunikazzjoni ma' persuna oħra permezz tat-telefown.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话联系；一通电话，此处指通过电话进行的联系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntatt ma' persuna oħra permezz tat-telefown, pereżempju biex titlob informazzjoni jew twassal messaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A call is an occasion when you contact someone by telephone.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话通话；通过电话进行的一次联系或交谈。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Komunikazzjoni jew konverżazzjoni ma' persuna oħra li ssir permezz tat-telefown.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A telephone call is a conversation or an attempt to communicate with someone using a telephone.

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju rċieva telefonata mingħand il-klijent biex jikkonferma l-appuntament.
formal.en: The office received a telephone call from the client to confirm the appointment.
formal.zh: 办公室接到了客户打来确认预约的电话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi nagħmel telefonata lil ommi. Mark: Ċemplilha issa, għad għandna ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: I need to make a call to my mother. Mark: Call her now; we still have time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我得给妈妈打个电话。马克：现在打吧，我们还有时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我得给妈妈打个电话。
messages.en: I need to make a call to my mother.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 现在打吧，我们还有时间。
messages.en: Call her now; we still have time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 telefonata 记成“一通电话这件事”：搭配 tagħmel 表示打电话，搭配 tirċievi 表示接到电话。

gloss_zh: 电话通信技术；电话通信业务

teaching_sense.en_definition: The technology and services used to transmit voice communication by telephone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用电话传输语音的技术及相关通信服务，统称电话通信。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-teknoloġija u s-servizzi li jippermettu komunikazzjoni bil-vuċi permezz tat-telefown.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话通信，指通过电话传输语音所涉及的技术、系统和业务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qasam tat-teknoloġija, tas-sistemi u tas-servizzi li jintużaw biex il-vuċi tiġi trażmessa permezz tat-telefown.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Telephony is the technology and provision of services that allow people to communicate by telephone.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tipprovdi servizzi ta' telefonija fissa u mobbli lill-klijenti tagħha.
formal.en: The company provides fixed-line and mobile telephony services to its customers.
formal.zh: 该公司向客户提供固定电话和移动电话通信服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-pakkett jinkludi servizzi ta' telefonija mobbli? Daniel: Iva, jinkludi telefonati u messaġġi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this package include mobile telephony services? Daniel: Yes, it includes calls and text messages.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个套餐包含移动电话通信服务吗？丹尼尔：包含，有通话和短信。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-pakkett jinkludi servizzi ta' telefonija mobbli?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-pakkett jinkludi servizzi ta' telefonija mobbli?
messages.zh: 这个套餐包含移动电话通信服务吗？
messages.en: Does this package include mobile telephony services?

messages.speaker: Daniel (店员)
messages.zh: 包含，有通话和短信。
messages.en: Yes, it includes calls and text messages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象运营商的服务目录：telefonija 指电话通信这个领域；配 fissa 看固定电话，配 mobbli 看移动电话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to speak to someone at a distance through a communications network.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 借助通信网络与远处的人进行语音交谈的设备，即电话或电话机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex titkellem ma' persuna li tinsab f'post ieħor permezz ta' netwerk ta' komunikazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话机；用于通过通信网络与他人远距离通话的设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat għall-komunikazzjoni bil-vuċi li jippermetti lil persuni f'postijiet differenti jitkellmu ma' xulxin permezz ta' netwerk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A telephone is a device that allows you to speak to someone who is in another place.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom iżommu t-telefown mitfi waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: Students should keep their phones switched off during the lesson.
formal.zh: 学生在上课期间应将电话保持关机状态。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn ħallejt it-telefown? Omm: Fuq il-mejda tal-kċina.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did I leave the phone? Mum: On the kitchen table.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我把电话放哪儿了？妈妈：在厨房的桌子上。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我把电话放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did I leave the phone?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 在厨房的桌子上。
messages.en: On the kitchen table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用实物帮助区分：手里拿的是 telefown，打出去的一通电话是 telefonata，提供通信技术和业务的是 telefonija。

gloss_zh: 电报；通过电缆传送的电报

teaching_sense.en_definition: A written message sent by telegraph and delivered to its recipient.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电报系统传送并交给收件人的书面消息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Messaġġ miktub li jintbagħat bit-telegrafu u jitwassal lir-riċevitur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电报；通过电报系统发送并交付收件人的书面消息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Messaġġ miktub li jintbagħat permezz tat-telegrafu u jitwassal lill-persuna li jkun indirizzat lilha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A telegram is a written message that is sent by telegraph and delivered to the person it addresses.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电缆电报；通过电报电缆传送的消息，此处不是指电缆本身。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Messaġġ telegrafiku mibgħut permezz ta' kejbil tat-telegrafu, aktar milli l-kejbil innifsu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cable is a telegram transmitted through a telegraph cable, rather than the cable itself.

formal.mt: It-telegramm fl-arkivju jikkonferma d-data tal-wasla tal-vapur.
formal.en: The telegram in the archive confirms the date of the ship's arrival.
formal.zh: 档案中的电报确认了船只抵达的日期。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-karta fil-kaxxa? Pawlu: Huwa telegramm li n-nannu rċieva mingħand ħuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that piece of paper in the box? Pawlu: It's a telegram that Grandpa received from his brother.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：盒子里的那张纸是什么？保罗：那是爷爷收到的他兄弟发来的电报。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 盒子里的那张纸是什么？
messages.en: What's that piece of paper in the box?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa telegramm li n-nannu rċieva mingħand ħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa telegramm li n-nannu rċieva mingħand ħuh.
messages.zh: 那是爷爷收到的他兄弟发来的电报。
messages.en: It's a telegram that Grandpa received from his brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 telegramm 配上“收到一张电报纸”的画面记忆；搭配 tibgħat 是发送，搭配 tirċievi 是收到。这里的 cable 也指电报消息。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The transmission of information over a distance by electronic means.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子手段在相隔一定距离的地点之间传递信息的通信活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-trażmissjoni ta' informazzjoni bejn postijiet imbiegħda permezz ta' mezzi elettroniċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电信；利用有线、无线等电子手段进行的远距离信息传输。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-komunikazzjoni fuq distanza permezz ta' mezzi elettroniċi, li jistgħu jużaw wajers, mewġ tar-radju jew mezzi oħra biex jittrażmettu informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Telecommunication is the transmission of information over a distance using electronic systems, including wired and wireless connections.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-kwalità tas-servizzi ta' telekomunikazzjoni fiż-żoni rurali.
formal.en: The report examines the quality of telecommunication services in rural areas.
formal.zh: 该报告考察了农村地区电信服务的质量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tistudja fl-università? Mark: Nistudja t-telekomunikazzjoni, jiġifieri kif l-informazzjoni tintbagħat fuq distanza b'mezzi elettroniċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do you study at university? Mark: I study telecommunication, meaning how information is sent over a distance by electronic means.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在大学学什么？马克：我学电信，也就是研究怎样通过电子手段远距离传送信息。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在大学学什么？
messages.en: What do you study at university?

messages.speaker: Mark (大学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistudja t-telekomunikazzjoni, jiġifieri kif l-informazzjoni tintbagħat fuq distanza b'mezzi elettroniċi.
messages.mt_standard: Nistudja t-telekomunikazzjoni, jiġifieri kif l-informazzjoni tintbagħat fuq distanza b'mezzi elettroniċi.
messages.zh: 我学电信，也就是研究怎样通过电子手段远距离传送信息。
messages.en: I study telecommunication, meaning how information is sent over a distance by electronic means.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“两个相隔很远的人通过电子设备交换信息”的画面记住 telekomunikazzjoni，再连读“电信服务、网络、系统”三个搭配来巩固。

gloss_zh: 电传；用户电报通信系统

teaching_sense.en_definition: A communication system that sends written messages between connected teleprinters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过相互连接的电传打字机发送和接收书面消息的通信系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' komunikazzjoni li tibgħat u tirċievi messaġġi miktuba bejn magni tat-teletajp imqabbda ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电传；利用电传打字机网络传送并打印文字消息的通信系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li biha messaġġi miktuba jiġu trażmessi fuq netwerk bejn magni tat-teletajp, u l-magna li tirċievi l-messaġġ tipprintjah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Telex is a communication system in which connected teleprinters transmit written messages and print them at the receiving end.

collocations.en: to send a message by telex

formal.mt: Il-korrispondenza fl-arkivju turi li l-kumpanija bagħtet il-konferma tal-ordni bit-teleks.
formal.en: The correspondence in the archive shows that the company sent the order confirmation by telex.
formal.zh: 档案中的往来函件表明，该公司通过电传发送了订单确认信息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hemm numru tat-teleks fuq din l-ittra? David: Dak in-numru kien jintuża biex jintbagħtu messaġġi bil-magna tat-teletajp.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is there a telex number on this letter? David: That number was used to send messages with a teleprinter.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这封信上为什么有一个电传号码？戴维：那个号码是用来通过电传打字机发送消息的。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm numru tat-teleks fuq din l-ittra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm numru tat-teleks fuq din l-ittra?
messages.zh: 这封信上为什么有一个电传号码？
messages.en: Why is there a telex number on this letter?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak in-numru kien jintuża biex jintbagħtu messaġġi bil-magna tat-teletajp.
messages.mt_standard: Dak in-numru kien jintuża biex jintbagħtu messaġġi bil-magna tat-teletajp.
messages.zh: 那个号码是用来通过电传打字机发送消息的。
messages.en: That number was used to send messages with a teleprinter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一端敲字、另一端机器打印文字的画面来记住 teleks；把 numru tat-teleks 记成机器通信所用的电传号码。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The promotion or sale of products or services through telephone calls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过拨打电话向潜在顾客介绍、推广或销售产品与服务的营销活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li biha prodotti jew servizzi jiġu promossi jew mibjugħa permezz ta' telefonati lil klijenti potenzjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话营销；通过电话联系潜在顾客并推广产品或服务的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività ta' kummerċjalizzazzjoni li tuża t-telefon biex tikkuntattja klijenti potenzjali u tippreżentalhom prodotti jew servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Phone marketing is the activity of contacting potential customers by telephone to promote products or services.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话营销；以电话沟通为手段，向潜在顾客推广或销售产品及服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-promozzjoni jew il-bejgħ ta' prodotti u servizzi permezz ta' konversazzjonijiet bit-telefon ma' klijenti potenzjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Telemarketing is a method of promoting or selling products and services through telephone conversations with potential customers.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija qed tħejji kampanja ta' telekummerċjalizzazzjoni biex tippreżenta s-servizz il-ġdid lil klijenti potenzjali.
formal.en: The company is preparing a telemarketing campaign to introduce its new service to potential customers.
formal.zh: 该公司正在筹备一项电话营销活动，向潜在顾客介绍其新服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ċempillek? Ġorġ: Aġent tat-telekummerċjalizzazzjoni. Ried joffrili pakkett ġdid tal-internet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who called you? Ġorġ: A telemarketing agent. He wanted to offer me a new internet package.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁给你打电话了？乔治：一个电话营销人员。他想向我推销一个新的上网套餐。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给你打电话了？
messages.en: Who called you?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Aġent tat-telekummerċjalizzazzjoni. Ried joffrili pakkett ġdid tal-internet.
messages.mt_standard: Aġent tat-telekummerċjalizzazzjoni. Ried joffrili pakkett ġdid tal-internet.
messages.zh: 一个电话营销人员。他想向我推销一个新的上网套餐。
messages.en: A telemarketing agent. He wanted to offer me a new internet package.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 telekummerċjalizzazzjoni 放进“电话响起，对方介绍产品”的完整场景中记忆；再用“营销活动、营销人员、推销来电”三个搭配反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The promotion of products or services through telephone calls to potential customers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过给潜在顾客打电话来介绍、推广或推销商品及服务的营销活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-promozzjoni ta' prodotti jew servizzi permezz ta' telefonati lil klijenti potenzjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过电话联系潜在顾客，推广商品或服务的营销方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod ta' kif jiġu promossi prodotti jew servizzi billi jsiru telefonati lil klijenti potenzjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Phone marketing is the practice of contacting potential customers by telephone to promote products or services.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以电话为主要联系渠道，向顾客介绍并推销商品或服务的商业活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività kummerċjali li tuża t-telefon biex tippreżenta u tbigħ prodotti jew servizzi lill-klijenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Telemarketing involves calling people to introduce products or services and encourage them to make a purchase.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija nediet kampanja ta' telepromozzjoni biex tinforma lill-klijenti dwar is-servizz il-ġdid tagħha.
formal.en: The company launched a telemarketing campaign to inform customers about its new service.
formal.zh: 该公司开展了一项电话营销活动，向顾客介绍其新服务。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min ċempillek? Pawlu: Kienet sejħa ta' telepromozzjoni. Riedu jbigħuli pakkett tal-internet. Marija: U x'għedtilhom? Pawlu: Għedtilhom li ma kontx interessat.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who called you? Pawlu: It was a telemarketing call. They wanted to sell me an internet package. Marija: And what did you tell them? Pawlu: I told them I wasn't interested.
colloquial.zh: Marija：谁给你打电话了？Pawlu：电话推销，想卖给我一个上网套餐。Marija：那你怎么回答的？Pawlu：我说我没兴趣。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给你打电话了？
messages.en: Who called you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet sejħa ta' telepromozzjoni. Riedu jbigħuli pakkett tal-internet.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet sejħa ta' telepromozzjoni. Riedu jbigħuli pakkett tal-internet.
messages.zh: 电话推销，想卖给我一个上网套餐。
messages.en: It was a telemarketing call. They wanted to sell me an internet package.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 那你怎么回答的？
messages.en: And what did you tell them?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我说我没兴趣。
messages.en: I told them I wasn't interested.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“电话响起，对方开始介绍套餐”的画面绑定记忆，重点记住它表示电话营销活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who watches a television programme or broadcast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 观看电视节目或电视播出的观众。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tara programm jew xandira fuq it-televiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 观看电视节目或电视播出内容的人；电视观众。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ssegwi programmi jew xandiriet fuq it-televiżjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A television viewer is someone who watches programmes or broadcasts on television.

formal.mt: Kull telespettatur jista' jibgħat il-kummenti tiegħu dwar il-programm permezz tal-posta elettronika.
formal.en: Every television viewer can send their comments about the programme by email.
formal.zh: 每位电视观众都可以通过电子邮件发送对该节目的意见。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int telespettatur regolari ta' dan il-programm? Mark: Iva, narah kull ġimgħa. Lara: Allura tista' tgħidli x'ġara fl-aħħar episodju? Mark: Żgur, imma se nikxiflek is-sorpriża!
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you a regular viewer of this programme? Mark: Yes, I watch it every week. Lara: Then can you tell me what happened in the last episode? Mark: Of course, but I'll spoil the surprise!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你经常看这个节目吗？Mark：是啊，我每周都看。Lara：那你能告诉我上一集发生了什么吗？Mark：当然，不过这样就把惊喜提前告诉你了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int telespettatur regolari ta' dan il-programm?
messages.mt_standard: Int telespettatur regolari ta' dan il-programm?
messages.zh: 你经常看这个节目吗？
messages.en: Are you a regular viewer of this programme?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我每周都看。
messages.en: Yes, I watch it every week.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura tista' tgħidli x'ġara fl-aħħar episodju?
messages.mt_standard: Allura tista' tgħidli x'ġara fl-aħħar episodju?
messages.zh: 那你能告诉我上一集发生了什么吗？
messages.en: Then can you tell me what happened in the last episode?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 当然，不过这样就把惊喜提前告诉你了！
messages.en: Of course, but I'll spoil the surprise!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个拿着遥控器、每周准时追节目的观众，把 telespettatur 和这个“看电视的人”联系起来。

gloss_zh: 电视播出的；与电视有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Broadcast on television, or connected with television and its programmes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电视播出的，或与电视及电视节目有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixxandar fuq it-televiżjoni jew li għandu x'jaqsam mat-televiżjoni u l-programmi tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过电视播放或转播的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jintwera jew jixxandar fuq it-televiżjoni biex ikun jista' jarah il-pubbliku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An event or discussion that is televised is broadcast on television for people to watch.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与电视这一媒介、电视节目或电视行业有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-televiżjoni bħala mezz ta' komunikazzjoni, mal-programmi tagħha jew mal-industrija tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described this way is connected with television, its programmes, or the industry that produces them.

formal.mt: Id-dibattitu televiżiv se jixxandar il-Ħamis filgħaxija u se jiffoka fuq it-trasport pubbliku.
formal.en: The televised debate will be broadcast on Thursday evening and will focus on public transport.
formal.zh: 这场电视辩论将于星期四晚间播出，重点讨论公共交通。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Rajt id-dibattitu televiżiv tal-bieraħ? David: Iva, rajtu wara l-aħbarijiet. Anna: Kien interessanti? David: Iva, speċjalment meta tkellmu dwar il-karozzi tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you watch yesterday's televised debate? David: Yes, I watched it after the news. Anna: Was it interesting? David: Yes, especially when they talked about buses.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你看了昨天电视播出的辩论吗？David：看了，新闻之后看的。Anna：有意思吗？David：有，尤其是他们谈公交车的时候。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看了昨天电视播出的辩论吗？
messages.en: Did you watch yesterday's televised debate?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 看了，新闻之后看的。
messages.en: Yes, I watched it after the news.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 有意思吗？
messages.en: Was it interesting?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment meta tkellmu dwar il-karozzi tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment meta tkellmu dwar il-karozzi tal-linja.
messages.zh: 有，尤其是他们谈公交车的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially when they talked about buses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张画面记两个义项：屏幕正在播辩论，对应“电视播出的”；电视台大楼，对应“与电视有关的”。

gloss_zh: 电话投票；通常在电视节目中进行的公众电话投票

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system in which members of the public vote by telephone, often during a television programme.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公众通过电话表达选择或投票的方式，常用于电视节目中的观众投票。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema li biha l-membri tal-pubbliku jivvutaw permezz tat-telefon, spiss waqt programm televiżiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公众通过电话参与的投票，尤其指电视节目中的观众投票。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Votazzjoni li fiha l-pubbliku jesprimi l-għażla tiegħu permezz tat-telefon, speċjalment waqt programm televiżiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Televoting allows members of the public to register their choices by telephone, often while watching a television programme.

sense_translations.en_definition: poll conducted among members of the public by phone, typically on a television program
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以公众为参与对象、通过电话收集投票或选择结果的调查，通常在电视节目中进行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stħarriġ li jiġbor il-voti jew l-għażliet tal-membri tal-pubbliku permezz tat-telefon, normalment waqt programm televiżiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This type of poll collects the public's choices by telephone and is usually conducted as part of a television programme.

formal.mt: Il-preżentatur ħabbar li r-riżultati tat-televotazzjoni kienu se jidhru fi tmiem il-programm.
formal.en: The presenter announced that the televoting results would be shown at the end of the programme.
formal.zh: 主持人宣布，电话投票结果将在节目结束时公布。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħadt sehem fit-televotazzjoni? Ġużeppi: Iva, ċempilt biex nivvota għall-kantanta favorita tiegħi. Sara: Meta se jħabbru r-riżultat? Ġużeppi: Fi tmiem il-programm.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you take part in the televoting? Ġużeppi: Yes, I called to vote for my favourite singer. Sara: When will they announce the result? Ġużeppi: At the end of the programme.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你参加电话投票了吗？Ġużeppi：参加了，我打电话给最喜欢的女歌手投了一票。Sara：什么时候公布结果？Ġużeppi：节目结束的时候。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你参加电话投票了吗？
messages.en: Did you take part in the televoting?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ċempilt biex nivvota għall-kantanta favorita tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ċempilt biex nivvota għall-kantanta favorita tiegħi.
messages.zh: 参加了，我打电话给最喜欢的女歌手投了一票。
messages.en: Yes, I called to vote for my favourite singer.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 什么时候公布结果？
messages.en: When will they announce the result?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.zh: 节目结束的时候。
messages.en: At the end of the programme.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象你一边看歌唱节目，一边拨电话支持喜欢的选手；把 televotazzjoni 和“观众电话投票”整幅画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A loss that is permitted or considered acceptable under specified conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在规定条件或限度内，可以接受或获准发生的损失。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Telf li jitħalla jew jitqies aċċettabbli skont kundizzjonijiet jew limiti stabbiliti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 根据规定可以接受的损失或损耗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Telf li huwa permess jew aċċettat għax jibqa' fil-limiti stabbiliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An allowable loss is a loss that is accepted within specified limits or conditions.

collocations.mt: it-telf li jista' jingħata waqt it-trasport
collocations.zh: 运输过程中的允许损耗

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jistabbilixxi li t-telf li jista' jingħata waqt it-trasport ma għandux jaqbeż żewġ kilogrammi għal kull kunsinna.
formal.en: The report specifies that the allowable loss during transport must not exceed two kilograms per delivery.
formal.zh: 报告规定，每批交付货物在运输过程中的允许损耗不得超过两公斤。

colloquial.mt: Mara: Kemm hu t-telf li jista' jingħata għal din il-kunsinna? Pawlu: Sa żewġ kilogrammi; aktar minn hekk irridu ninvestigaw.
colloquial.en: Mara: How much loss is allowed for this delivery? Pawlu: Up to two kilograms; beyond that, we need to investigate.
colloquial.zh: 玛拉：这批货允许损耗多少？保罗：最多两公斤；超过这个数量，我们就得调查。

messages.speaker: Mara (仓库主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu t-telf li jista' jingħata għal din il-kunsinna?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu t-telf li jista' jingħata għal din il-kunsinna?
messages.zh: 这批货允许损耗多少？
messages.en: How much loss is allowed for this delivery?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (仓库员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Sa żewġ kilogrammi; aktar minn hekk irridu ninvestigaw.
messages.mt_standard: Sa żewġ kilogrammi; aktar minn hekk irridu ninvestigaw.
messages.zh: 最多两公斤；超过这个数量，我们就得调查。
messages.en: Up to two kilograms; beyond that, we need to investigate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成损耗表里的“允许额度”：看到损失，再问它是否仍在可接受的范围内。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To raise one's shoulders briefly to show uncertainty, indifference, or lack of knowledge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短暂抬起肩膀，以表示不确定、不在意或不知道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għolla spallejh għal ftit biex juri li ma jafx, li mhuwiex ċert jew li ma jimpurtahx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耸起肩膀，通常表示不知道、不确定或无所谓。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għolla spallejh bħala ġest li juri nuqqas ta' għarfien, inċertezza jew indifferenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone shrugs, they briefly raise their shoulders to show uncertainty, indifference, or lack of knowledge.

formal.mt: Meta mistoqsi dwar ir-raġuni tad-dewmien, ir-raġel tella' spallejh u ma ta ebda spjegazzjoni.
formal.en: When asked about the reason for the delay, the man shrugged and offered no explanation.
formal.zh: 当被问及延误原因时，那名男子耸了耸肩，没有作出任何解释。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qal Mark meta staqsejtu fejn huma ċ-ċwievet? Nina: Ma qal xejn, tella' spallejh biss.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Mark say when you asked him where the keys were? Nina: He said nothing; he just shrugged.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你问马克钥匙在哪里时，他怎么说？妮娜：他什么也没说，只是耸了耸肩。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qal Mark meta staqsejtu fejn huma ċ-ċwievet?
messages.mt_standard: X'qal Mark meta staqsejtu fejn huma ċ-ċwievet?
messages.zh: 你问马克钥匙在哪里时，他怎么说？
messages.en: What did Mark say when you asked him where the keys were?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma qal xejn, tella' spallejh biss.
messages.mt_standard: Ma qal xejn, tella' spallejh biss.
messages.zh: 他什么也没说，只是耸了耸肩。
messages.en: He said nothing; he just shrugged.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时做一次耸肩动作，再配上“不知道”的表情，把整个短语与肩膀短暂抬起的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work food repeatedly between the teeth before swallowing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吞咽之前，用牙齿反复咬动并嚼碎口中的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tomgħod l-ikel billi ċċaqlaq ix-xedaq ripetutament u tfarrku bis-snien qabel tibilgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用牙齿反复咬碎或磨碎食物；咀嚼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tomgħod billi tfarrak l-ikel bis-snien u ċċaqlaq ix-xedaq qabel tibla'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone chews, they repeatedly bite and crush food with their teeth before swallowing it.

formal.mt: It-tifel tella' u niżżel il-biċċa ħobż bil-mod qabel belagħha.
formal.en: The boy chewed the piece of bread slowly before swallowing it.
formal.zh: 男孩慢慢嚼碎那块面包，然后才咽下。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex dam daqshekk biex kiel dik il-biċċa laħam? Ben: Kienet iebsa; tella' u niżżel għal ħin twil qabel belagħha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did he take so long to eat that piece of meat? Ben: It was tough; he chewed for a long time before swallowing it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：他怎么吃那块肉吃了那么久？本：肉很韧，他嚼了好久才咽下去。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dam daqshekk biex kiel dik il-biċċa laħam?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dam daqshekk biex kiel dik il-biċċa laħam?
messages.zh: 他怎么吃那块肉吃了那么久？
messages.en: Why did he take so long to eat that piece of meat?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet iebsa; tella' u niżżel għal ħin twil qabel belagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet iebsa; tella' u niżżel għal ħin twil qabel belagħha.
messages.zh: 肉很韧，他嚼了好久才咽下去。
messages.en: It was tough; he chewed for a long time before swallowing it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语配上嘴巴反复咀嚼的动作来记：先嚼碎口中的食物，再完成吞咽。

gloss_zh: 石鸻（一种鸟）；话匣子，喋喋不休的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stone curlew; figuratively, a person who talks incessantly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 石鸻，一种叫声尖厉的鸟；也比喻说话不停、喋喋不休的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur b'għajta qawwija u penetranti; b'mod figurattiv, persuna li titkellem bla waqfien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石鸻，一种鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ stone curlew u li għandha għajta penetranti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stone curlew is a bird known for its piercing call.

sense_translations.en_definition: a chatterbox, one who speaks incessantly (fig. based on the piercing cry of the stone curlew)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 话匣子；说起话来没完没了的人。此比喻义与石鸻尖厉的叫声相联系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem bla waqfien, imsejħa hekk b'mod figurattiv b'rabta mal-għajta penetranti tal-għasfur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you call someone a chatterbox, you mean that they talk incessantly.

collocations.mt: tellerita li ma tieqaf qatt titkellem
collocations.en: a chatterbox who never stops talking
collocations.zh: 一个说起话来永远没完的人

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti semgħu l-għajta penetranti ta' tellerita u kitbu dwarha fin-noti tagħhom.
formal.en: During the birdwatching session, the students heard the piercing call of a stone curlew and wrote about it in their notes.
formal.zh: 在观鸟活动中，学生们听见了一只石鸻尖厉的叫声，并把它记在了笔记里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħija huwa tellerita; ilu jitkellem minn meta wasal! Rita: Veru, għadu lanqas tani ċans ngħid kelma.
colloquial.en: Maja: My brother is a chatterbox; he has been talking since he arrived! Rita: True, he has not even given me a chance to say a word yet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我哥哥真是个话匣子，从到这里就一直说个不停！丽塔：确实，他到现在连让我说句话的机会都没给。

messages.speaker: Maja (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija huwa tellerita; ilu jitkellem minn meta wasal!
messages.mt_standard: Ħija huwa tellerita; ilu jitkellem minn meta wasal!
messages.zh: 我哥哥真是个话匣子，从到这里就一直说个不停！
messages.en: My brother is a chatterbox; he has been talking since he arrived!

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, għadu lanqas tani ċans ngħid kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, għadu lanqas tani ċans ngħid kelma.
messages.zh: 确实，他到现在连让我说句话的机会都没给。
messages.en: True, he has not even given me a chance to say a word yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面分别记义：观鸟笔记里是石鸻，朋友聊天时是话匣子；借鸟的尖厉叫声联系喋喋不休的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A usual inclination to behave in a particular way, or a general direction in which something develops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人经常以某种方式行动或作出反应的倾向，也指事物发展的总体趋势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inklinazzjoni li persuna taġixxi jew tirreaġixxi b'ċertu mod, jew direzzjoni ġenerali li fiha tiżviluppa xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常出现某种行为、反应或结果的倾向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Inklinazzjoni li persuna tagħmel xi ħaġa jew li xi ħaġa sseħħ b'mod ripetut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tendency is an inclination to behave in a particular way or for something to happen repeatedly.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性情中使人较容易产生某种感受或行为的倾向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Inklinazzjoni fil-karattru ta' persuna li tagħmilha aktar lesta li tħoss jew taġixxi b'ċertu mod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A disposition is an inclination in someone's character that influences how they usually feel or behave.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事物在一段时期内发展或变化的总体方向；趋势。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-direzzjoni ġenerali li fiha tiżviluppa jew tinbidel xi ħaġa matul perjodu ta' żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trend is a general direction of change or development over a period of time.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri tendenza ta' żieda fl-użu tat-trasport pubbliku matul l-aħħar sena.
formal.en: The report shows an upward trend in the use of public transport over the past year.
formal.zh: 报告显示，过去一年公共交通的使用呈上升趋势。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi tendenza li ninkwieta qabel kull eżami. Mark: Ipprova tistrieħ ftit; diġà studjajt ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: I tend to worry before every exam. Mark: Try to get some rest; you've already studied a lot.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我每次考试前都容易担心。Mark：试着休息一下吧，你已经学了很多了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi tendenza li ninkwieta qabel kull eżami.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi tendenza li ninkwieta qabel kull eżami.
messages.zh: 我每次考试前都容易担心。
messages.en: I tend to worry before every exam.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova tistrieħ ftit; diġà studjajt ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova tistrieħ ftit; diġà studjajt ħafna.
messages.zh: 试着休息一下吧，你已经学了很多了。
messages.en: Try to get some rest; you've already studied a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tendenza 想成一支表示方向的箭头：指向个人行为时是倾向，指向性情时是禀性倾向，指向长期变化时是趋势。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sport in which two players or two pairs use rackets to hit a ball over a net into the opposing court.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由两名球员或两对球员用球拍将球击过球网、打入对方场地的运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sport li fih żewġ plejers jew żewġ pari jużaw rakketti biex jolqtu ballun minn fuq xibka għal ġol-parti tal-kort tal-avversarji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 网球：两名球员或两对球员隔网用球拍击球的运动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Logħba sportiva bejn żewġ plejers jew żewġ pari li jolqtu ballun bir-rakketti minn fuq xibka, bil-għan li l-avversarju ma jirnexxilux jirritornah skont ir-regoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tennis is a sport in which opposing players use rackets to hit a ball back and forth over a net.

formal.mt: Il-klabb se jorganizza kors tat-tennis għal dawk li jibdew, b'żewġ lezzjonijiet fil-ġimgħa.
formal.en: The club will organise a tennis course for beginners, with two lessons a week.
formal.zh: 俱乐部将开设网球入门课程，每周上两次课。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tilgħab it-tennis għada? Pawlu: Iva, imma għadni qed nitgħallem. Sara: Ma jimpurtax, nistgħu nipprattikaw flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to play tennis tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes, but I'm still learning. Sara: That's all right; we can practise together.
colloquial.zh: Sara：明天想打网球吗？Pawlu：想，不过我还在学。Sara：没关系，我们可以一起练习。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天想打网球吗？
messages.en: Do you want to play tennis tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，不过我还在学。
messages.en: Yes, but I'm still learning.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 没关系，我们可以一起练习。
messages.en: That's all right; we can practise together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tennis 就联想球拍、球网和来回击球的画面，再整句记住 nilgħab it-tennis，意思是“我打网球”。

gloss_zh: 神权政治的；神权统治的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a system of government in which religious authorities rule or political authority is based on religious authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与宗教权威掌握统治权，或政治权力建立在宗教权威之上的政体有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' sistema ta' gvern li fiha jmexxu l-awtoritajiet reliġjużi jew is-setgħa politika tkun ibbażata fuq l-awtorità reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神权政治的，指宗教权威直接统治或构成政治权力基础的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda tmexxija politika li fiha l-awtorità reliġjuża għandha s-setgħa li tiggverna jew tagħti l-bażi għas-setgħa tal-gvern.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A theocratic system is one in which religious authority governs the state or provides the basis for political power.

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza r-rwol tal-awtorità reliġjuża fit-teħid tad-deċiżjonijiet ta' gvern teokratiku.
formal.en: The study analyses the role of religious authority in the decision-making of a theocratic government.
formal.zh: 该研究分析宗教权威在神权政府决策中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ifisser stat teokratiku? Daniel: Stat fejn l-awtorità reliġjuża tmexxi jew tkun il-bażi tas-setgħa politika. Lara: Mela l-kelma tiddeskrivi kif jitmexxa l-istat.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does a theocratic state mean? Daniel: A state where religious authority rules or forms the basis of political power. Lara: So the word describes how the state is governed.
colloquial.zh: Lara：神权国家是什么意思？Daniel：就是由宗教权威统治，或者以宗教权威作为政治权力基础的国家。Lara：所以这个词描述的是国家的治理方式。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 神权国家是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a theocratic state mean?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Stat fejn l-awtorità reliġjuża tmexxi jew tkun il-bażi tas-setgħa politika.
messages.mt_standard: Stat fejn l-awtorità reliġjuża tmexxi jew tkun il-bażi tas-setgħa politika.
messages.zh: 就是由宗教权威统治，或者以宗教权威作为政治权力基础的国家。
messages.en: A state where religious authority rules or forms the basis of political power.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela l-kelma tiddeskrivi kif jitmexxa l-istat.
messages.mt_standard: Mela l-kelma tiddeskrivi kif jitmexxa l-istat.
messages.zh: 所以这个词描述的是国家的治理方式。
messages.en: So the word describes how the state is governed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teokratiku 放进 gvern teokratiku 一起记，脑中画出宗教权威参与国家统治的场景，锁定“神权政治的”这一含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Concerned with theories and general principles, or considered as a possibility without being established in practice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及理论和一般原理的，或仅在理论上作为可能性考虑、尚未在实践中确立的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' teoriji u prinċipji ġenerali, jew li jitqies bħala possibbiltà mingħajr ma jkun ġie stabbilit fil-prattika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理论的；以理论或一般原理为依据的，也可指仅在理论上成立或有可能的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda teoriji jew prinċipji ġenerali, jew li jkun possibbli skont it-teorija iżda mhux neċessarjament ikkonfermat fil-prattika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something theoretical is concerned with general principles or is considered possible on the basis of theory rather than practical confirmation.

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkaturi żviluppaw mudell teoretiku u mbagħad qabblu t-tbassir tiegħu mar-riżultati tal-esperiment.
formal.en: The researchers developed a theoretical model and then compared its predictions with the results of the experiment.
formal.zh: 研究人员建立了一个理论模型，随后将其预测与实验结果进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-pjan għandu vantaġġ teoretiku, imma għadu ma ġiex ippruvat. Mark: Mela nippruvawh fuq skala żgħira l-ewwel. Nina: Hekk naraw jekk jaħdimx fil-prattika.
colloquial.en: Nina: This plan has a theoretical advantage, but it hasn't been tested yet. Mark: Then let's try it on a small scale first. Nina: That way we'll see whether it works in practice.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个方案在理论上有优势，但还没有经过检验。Mark：那我们先小规模试试吧。Nina：这样就能看看它在实践中是否有效。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-pjan għandu vantaġġ teoretiku, imma għadu ma ġiex ippruvat.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-pjan għandu vantaġġ teoretiku, imma għadu ma ġiex ippruvat.
messages.zh: 这个方案在理论上有优势，但还没有经过检验。
messages.en: This plan has a theoretical advantage, but it hasn't been tested yet.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nippruvawh fuq skala żgħira l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nippruvawh fuq skala żgħira l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 那我们先小规模试试吧。
messages.en: Then let's try it on a small scale first.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 这样就能看看它在实践中是否有效。
messages.en: That way we'll see whether it works in practice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teoretiku 与纸上的模型和推导联系起来：mudell teoretiku 是理论模型，vantaġġ teoretiku 是理论上的优势，再用实际检验的画面帮助区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word or expression used to name or describe a concept, especially in a particular subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于命名或描述某个概念的词语或表达，尤指某个专业领域使用的术语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma jew espressjoni li tintuża biex issemmi jew tiddeskrivi kunċett, speċjalment f'qasam partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来称呼或表达某个事物、概念的词语或表达。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma jew espressjoni li biha wieħed isemmi jew jesprimi ħaġa jew kunċett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A term is a word or expression used to name or describe something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某个专业、行业或学科内部使用、具有专门含义的词语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma b'tifsira speċifika li tintuża fil-lingwaġġ ta' professjoni, sengħa jew qasam ta' studju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A term is a word with a particular meaning within a specialised field or profession.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, kull terminu tekniku għandu jkun akkumpanjat minn definizzjoni ċara biex il-qarrej jifhem it-test.
formal.en: In the report, each technical term should be accompanied by a clear definition so that the reader can understand the text.
formal.zh: 报告中的每个技术术语都应附有清晰的定义，以便读者理解正文。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser dan it-terminu? Daniel: Hawnhekk ifisser l-ammont ta' ilma fl-arja. Maja: Issa fhimt; se nikteb it-tifsira ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this term mean? Daniel: Here it means the amount of water in the air. Maja: Now I understand; I'll write the meaning next to it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个术语是什么意思？Daniel：这里指空气中的水分含量。Maja：现在明白了，我会在旁边写下它的意思。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个术语是什么意思？
messages.en: What does this term mean?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser l-ammont ta' ilma fl-arja.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser l-ammont ta' ilma fl-arja.
messages.zh: 这里指空气中的水分含量。
messages.en: Here it means the amount of water in the air.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa fhimt; se nikteb it-tifsira ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Issa fhimt; se nikteb it-tifsira ħdejh.
messages.zh: 现在明白了，我会在旁边写下它的意思。
messages.en: Now I understand; I'll write the meaning next to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 terminu 想成课本里被圈起来、旁边写着定义的词；普通概念可用它命名，专业概念则对应“术语”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument used to measure temperature, including the temperature of a person's body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于测量温度的仪器；测量人体温度时称为体温计。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li jintuża biex titkejjel it-temperatura, inkluża dik tal-ġisem ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 测量温度的仪器，包括测量体温的体温计。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument li jkejjel it-temperatura tal-ġisem, tal-arja jew ta' xi ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A thermometer is an instrument that measures how hot or cold something is.

collocations.en: to measure the temperature with a thermometer

formal.mt: L-istudenti użaw termometru biex ikejlu t-temperatura tal-ilma u rreġistraw ir-riżultat fit-tabella.
formal.en: The students used a thermometer to measure the temperature of the water and recorded the result in the table.
formal.zh: 学生们用温度计测量水温，并将结果记录在表格中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu t-termometru? Pawlu: Fil-kexxun ħdejn is-sodda. Lara: Tajjeb, irrid inkejjel it-temperatura tal-kamra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the thermometer? Pawlu: In the drawer next to the bed. Lara: Good, I want to measure the room temperature.
colloquial.zh: Lara：温度计在哪里？Pawlu：在床边的抽屉里。Lara：好，我想测一下室温。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 温度计在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the thermometer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 在床边的抽屉里。
messages.en: In the drawer next to the bed.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我想测一下室温。
messages.en: Good, I want to measure the room temperature.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 termometru 和“看刻度、读温度”的画面绑在一起：量水温、室温或体温，都先想到测温仪器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fine powder applied to the skin to absorb moisture and reduce friction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂撒在皮肤上、用于吸收潮气和减少摩擦的细粉，即爽身粉或滑石粉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trab fin li jitqiegħed fuq il-ġilda biex jassorbi l-umdità u jnaqqas il-frizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于皮肤吸湿、保持干爽和减少摩擦的爽身粉或滑石粉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Trab fin tat-talk li jintuża fuq il-ġilda biex jassorbi l-umdità u jnaqqas il-frizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Talcum powder is a fine powder used on the skin to absorb moisture and reduce friction.

collocations.en: to apply talcum powder to the skin

formal.mt: Fuq l-ixkaffa tal-prodotti għall-kura tal-ġisem kien hemm sapun, kremi u terra mfewħa.
formal.en: The shelf of body care products held soap, creams and scented talcum powder.
formal.zh: 身体护理用品货架上摆着肥皂、乳霜和带香味的爽身粉。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandkom terra mingħajr fwieħa? Mark: Iva, tinsab fuq dik l-ixkaffa ħdejn is-sapun. Nina: Grazzi, nieħu pakkett.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have unscented talcum powder? Mark: Yes, it's on that shelf next to the soap. Nina: Thanks, I'll take one pack.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你们有无香味的爽身粉吗？Mark：有，在那边的货架上，肥皂旁边。Nina：谢谢，我拿一包。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有无香味的爽身粉吗？
messages.en: Do you have unscented talcum powder?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tinsab fuq dik l-ixkaffa ħdejn is-sapun.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tinsab fuq dik l-ixkaffa ħdejn is-sapun.
messages.zh: 有，在那边的货架上，肥皂旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's on that shelf next to the soap.

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我拿一包。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll take one pack.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时给 terra 配上浴室货架上的爽身粉罐：细细的粉末撒在皮肤上，把词义锁定在“爽身粉”。

gloss_zh: 瓦砾；建筑碎料；碎石残渣

teaching_sense.en_definition: Broken stone, building material or similar debris left after construction, demolition or damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 施工、拆除或损坏后留下的碎石、建筑碎料等瓦砾残渣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal imkisser, bħal ġebel u fdalijiet tal-bini, li jibqa' wara xogħol ta' kostruzzjoni, twaqqigħ jew ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物拆除、损坏或施工后留下的瓦砾、碎石和其他碎料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fdalijiet ta' ġebel, bini jew materjal ieħor imkisser li jibqgħu wara twaqqigħ, ħsara jew xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Debris consists of broken pieces of stone or other material left after damage, demolition or building work.

collocations.zh: 一辆装满建筑碎料的卡车

formal.mt: Wara t-twaqqigħ tal-ħajt, il-ħaddiema neħħew it-terrapien u naddfu l-passaġġ.
formal.en: After demolishing the wall, the workers removed the debris and cleared the passage.
formal.zh: 拆除墙体后，工人们清运了瓦砾，并清理了通道。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' ngħaddi minn hawn? Toni: Stenna ftit, għad hemm it-terrapien mal-bieb. Sara: Tajjeb, ngħaddi minn wara.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I get through here? Toni: Wait a moment, there's still debris by the door. Sara: All right, I'll go round the back.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我能从这里过去吗？Toni：等一下，门边还有瓦砾。Sara：好，那我从后面绕过去。

messages.speaker: Sara (住户)
messages.zh: 我能从这里过去吗？
messages.en: Can I get through here?

messages.speaker: Toni (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit, għad hemm it-terrapien mal-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit, għad hemm it-terrapien mal-bieb.
messages.zh: 等一下，门边还有瓦砾。
messages.en: Wait a moment, there's still debris by the door.

messages.speaker: Sara (住户)
messages.zh: 好，那我从后面绕过去。
messages.en: All right, I'll go round the back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 terrapien 想成拆墙后挡住门口的一堆碎砖碎石；联想“堆起来、装上车、清运走”，就能记住瓦砾碎料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outdoor flat area beside or on a building, used for sitting, eating, or enjoying the view.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑物旁边或上方供人休息、用餐或观景的室外平坦区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona ċatta fil-miftuħ, maġenb jew fuq bini, fejn wieħed jista' joqgħod bilqiegħda, jiekol jew igawdi l-veduta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物旁或建筑物上的露天平台，通常供休息、用餐或观景。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spazju ċatt fil-miftuħ, maġenb jew fuq bini, li jintuża biex wieħed joqgħod bilqiegħda, jiekol jew igawdi l-veduta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A terrace is a flat outdoor area beside or on a building where people can sit or eat.

collocations.en: a terrace with a sea view

formal.mt: Il-lukanda għandha terrazza spazjuża fejn il-mistednin jistgħu jieklu l-kolazzjon.
formal.en: The hotel has a spacious terrace where guests can have breakfast.
formal.zh: 这家酒店有一处宽敞的露台，客人可以在那里吃早餐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid nieħdu kafè fit-terrazza? Pawlu: Iva, hemm barra għandna veduta sabiħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we have a coffee on the terrace? Pawlu: Yes, we have a lovely view out there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们去露台喝杯咖啡好吗？保罗：好呀，外面的景色很美。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去露台喝杯咖啡好吗？
messages.en: Shall we have a coffee on the terrace?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm barra għandna veduta sabiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm barra għandna veduta sabiħa.
messages.zh: 好呀，外面的景色很美。
messages.en: Yes, we have a lovely view out there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 terrazza 和“露台上摆着桌椅喝咖啡”的画面一起记；再连读 fit-terrazza，记住“在露台上”。

gloss_zh: 惨淡的；可怕的；糟糕的；邪恶的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely bad, unpleasant, frightening, or morally wicked, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容事物极其糟糕、令人难受或害怕，也可形容人或行为邪恶、残酷，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ħażin ħafna, spjaċevoli ħafna jew tal-biża', jew li juri ħażen jew krudeltà, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惨淡的；令人沮丧的，尤指情况、前景或成绩极差。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jnissel dwejjaq jew skuraġġiment minħabba kundizzjoni ħażina ħafna jew nuqqas kbir ta' suċċess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dismal situation or result is very bad and makes people feel discouraged or unhappy.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极其糟糕的；令人恐惧或痛苦的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ħażin jew spjaċevoli ħafna, jew li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss biża' jew tbatija kbira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something dreadful is extremely unpleasant or causes strong feelings of fear or distress.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 很糟糕的；严重的；可怕的，表示程度很强。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ħażin ħafna, serju ħafna jew tal-biża', b'enfasi fuq kemm il-ħaġa hija qawwija jew kerha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something terrible is very bad, very serious, or frightening to the people who experience it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邪恶的；恶毒的；残酷的，指人品或行为上的恶。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri ħażen morali jew krudeltà, speċjalment meta persuna tagħmel il-ħsara lil ħaddieħor apposta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wicked person or action is morally very bad and may deliberately cause harm to others.

collocations.zh: 一个邪恶而残酷的男人

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ħakkiem huwa raġel terribbli li jikkastiga lin-nies innoċenti mingħajr ħniena.
formal.en: In the novel, the ruler is a wicked man who mercilessly punishes innocent people.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，统治者是一个邪恶的人，毫不留情地惩罚无辜百姓。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kien it-temp waqt il-vaganza? Mark: Terribbli! Għamlet ix-xita kuljum.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was the weather like during the holiday? Mark: Terrible! It rained every day.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：度假时天气怎么样？马克：糟透了！天天下雨。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 度假时天气怎么样？
messages.en: What was the weather like during the holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 糟透了！天天下雨。
messages.en: Terrible! It rained every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四幅画记 terribbli：惨淡成绩、可怕经历、糟糕天气、邪恶人物；同一个词，跟着语境选择中文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of land belonging to or controlled by a country, group, person, or animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于某个国家、群体、个人或动物，或由其控制的地域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda ta' art li tappartjeni lil pajjiż, grupp, persuna jew annimal, jew li tkun taħt il-kontroll tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 领土、领地或辖区，即属于某一主体或由其控制的一片地域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona ta' art li tkun tappartjeni lil stat, grupp, persuna jew annimal, jew li tkun taħt l-awtorità jew il-kontroll tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A territory is an area of land that belongs to or is controlled by a particular country, group, person, or animal.

collocations.en: to defend his or its territory

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi l-fruntieri tat-territorju tal-pajjiż u l-postijiet tal-bliet ewlenin.
formal.en: The map shows the boundaries of the country's territory and the locations of its main cities.
formal.zh: 这张地图标出了该国领土的边界和主要城市的位置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dak il-qattus qed ikeċċi lill-ieħor? Toni: Qed jiddefendi t-territorju tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is that cat chasing the other one away? Toni: It is defending its territory.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那只猫为什么要赶走另一只猫？托尼：它在保卫自己的领地。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dak il-qattus qed ikeċċi lill-ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dak il-qattus qed ikeċċi lill-ieħor?
messages.zh: 那只猫为什么要赶走另一只猫？
messages.en: Why is that cat chasing the other one away?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 它在保卫自己的领地。
messages.en: It is defending its territory.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 territorju 想成地图上圈出的一块地：国家有领土，猫也有领地；抓住“归谁控制”就容易记住。

gloss_zh: 关境；海关管辖区域；本国关境

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area within which a particular system of customs rules applies to goods entering or leaving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对进出货物适用特定海关制度的一片区域，称为关境或海关管辖区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona li fiha tapplika sistema partikolari ta' regoli doganali għall-merkanzija li tidħol jew toħroġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关管辖区域，即对货物进出实施特定海关管理的地域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona ġeografika fejn l-awtoritajiet doganali japplikaw regoli partikolari għall-kontroll tal-merkanzija li tidħol jew toħroġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs area is a geographical area in which particular customs controls and rules apply to goods.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关境，即统一适用某一套海关规则和关税制度的地域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Territorju li fih tapplika sistema komuni ta' regoli doganali u dazji fuq il-merkanzija li tidħol jew toħroġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs territory is an area governed by a common system of customs rules and duties on goods.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 本国关境，即从所讨论国家的角度而言，适用其海关制度的地域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-territorju li fih tapplika s-sistema doganali tal-pajjiż li jkun qed jiġi diskuss, meqjus mill-perspettiva ta' dak il-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A domestic customs territory is the area covered by the customs system of the country being discussed.

collocations.en: the limits of the customs territory

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jitlob lill-istudenti jidentifikaw il-punt fejn il-merkanzija tidħol fit-territorju doganali.
formal.en: The exercise asks students to identify the point at which the goods enter the customs territory.
formal.zh: 这道练习要求学生指出货物在何处进入关境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser territorju doganali f'dan it-test? Daniel: Iż-żona fejn japplikaw ir-regoli doganali għall-merkanzija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does customs territory mean in this text? Daniel: The area where customs rules apply to goods.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇课文里的“关境”是什么意思？丹尼尔：就是对货物适用海关规则的区域。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇课文里的“关境”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does customs territory mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żona fejn japplikaw ir-regoli doganali għall-merkanzija.
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żona fejn japplikaw ir-regoli doganali għall-merkanzija.
messages.zh: 就是对货物适用海关规则的区域。
messages.en: The area where customs rules apply to goods.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“货物跨线，进入海关制度适用区”的画面记 territorju doganali；整组对应“关境”，再用“本国”理解国内视角。

gloss_zh: 恐怖主义的；与恐怖活动有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with terrorism or with people who carry out terrorist acts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与恐怖主义、恐怖活动或实施恐怖活动的人有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mat-terroriżmu jew ma' persuni li jwettqu atti ta' terroriżmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恐怖主义的；涉及恐怖活动或其实施者的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-terroriżmu jew ma' min iwettaq atti ta' terroriżmu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A terrorist act or activity involves violence or threats intended to frighten people for political or ideological purposes.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-effetti tal-attakk terroristiku fuq il-komunità lokali.
formal.en: The report describes the effects of the terrorist attack on the local community.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这次恐怖袭击对当地社区的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Mark: Artiklu dwar attakk terroristiku u kif għenu lill-vittmi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Mark: An article about a terrorist attack and how the victims were helped.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在读什么？马克：一篇关于恐怖袭击以及受害者如何获得帮助的文章。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Artiklu dwar attakk terroristiku u kif għenu lill-vittmi.
messages.mt_standard: Artiklu dwar attakk terroristiku u kif għenu lill-vittmi.
messages.zh: 一篇关于恐怖袭击以及受害者如何获得帮助的文章。
messages.en: An article about a terrorist attack and how the victims were helped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 attakk terroristiku 整组记成“恐怖袭击”：attakk 是被描述的袭击，terroristiku 说明其性质，帮助记住它是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of violence or threats to create fear in pursuit of political or ideological aims.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为实现政治或意识形态目的，使用暴力或威胁制造恐惧的行为或手段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu tal-vjolenza jew tat-theddid biex jinħoloq il-biża' għal skopijiet politiċi jew ideoloġiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过暴力或威胁制造恐惧，以达到政治或意识形态目的的恐怖主义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-użu ta' vjolenza jew theddid biex in-nies jitbeżżgħu u jintlaħqu għanijiet politiċi jew ideoloġiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Terrorism is the use of violence or threats to frighten people and advance political or ideological aims.

formal.mt: Il-konferenza ddiskutiet il-prevenzjoni tat-terroriżmu u l-appoġġ lill-vittmi tiegħu.
formal.en: The conference discussed the prevention of terrorism and support for its victims.
formal.zh: 会议讨论了恐怖主义的预防以及对其受害者的援助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dwar xiex kienet il-lezzjoni llum? Pawlu: Dwar it-terroriżmu u kif jolqot il-ħajja tan-nies.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was today's lesson about? Pawlu: About terrorism and how it affects people's lives.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天的课讲了什么？保罗：讲了恐怖主义，以及它如何影响人们的生活。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 今天的课讲了什么？
messages.en: What was today's lesson about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar it-terroriżmu u kif jolqot il-ħajja tan-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar it-terroriżmu u kif jolqot il-ħajja tan-nies.
messages.zh: 讲了恐怖主义，以及它如何影响人们的生活。
messages.en: About terrorism and how it affects people's lives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“讨论恐怖主义”记住名词 terroriżmu，再用“恐怖主义的袭击”联系形容词 terroristiku；一个指现象，一个描述性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fabrics or cloth materials used to make clothing, furnishings, and other products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于制作衣物、家居用品等的纺织品或布料；本词条采用复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drappijiet li jintużaw biex isiru ħwejjeġ, oġġetti għad-dar u prodotti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纺织品；用于制作衣物或其他用品的各类布料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Drappijiet ta' diversi tipi li jintużaw għall-ħjata tal-ħwejjeġ jew għall-produzzjoni ta' oġġetti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Textiles are fabrics used for making clothes, household furnishings, and a variety of other products.

formal.mt: Il-wirja tippreżenta tessuti tal-qoton u tal-ħarir u tispjega l-użi tagħhom.
formal.en: The exhibition presents cotton and silk textiles and explains their uses.
formal.zh: 展览展示了棉质和丝质纺织品，并介绍了它们的用途。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandkom tessuti tal-qoton għall-purtieri? Rita: Iva, għandna diversi kuluri. Trid tarahom?
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you have cotton fabrics for curtains? Rita: Yes, we have several colours. Would you like to see them?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你们有做窗帘用的棉布吗？丽塔：有，我们有好几种颜色。你想看看吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有做窗帘用的棉布吗？
messages.en: Do you have cotton fabrics for curtains?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna diversi kuluri. Trid tarahom?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna diversi kuluri. Trid tarahom?
messages.zh: 有，我们有好几种颜色。你想看看吗？
messages.en: Yes, we have several colours. Would you like to see them?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象布料店里一卷卷不同颜色的布，把 tessuti 与“各种纺织品”一起记；再用 tal-qoton 联想到棉质布料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A document stating a person's wishes about the distribution of their property after death.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 记载一个人去世后希望如何分配其财产的文件，即遗嘱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument li fih persuna tiddikjara kif tixtieq li jitqassam ġidha wara mewtha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗嘱；以书面形式表达本人身后财产安排意愿的文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument miktub li jesprimi x-xewqat ta' persuna dwar x'għandu jsir minn ġidha wara mewtha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A testament is a written document expressing someone's wishes about what should happen to their property after death.

sense_translations.en_definition: will (document specifying one's legacy after death)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗嘱；具体说明本人去世后遗产如何分配的文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jispeċifika kif persuna tixtieq li jitqassam il-wirt tagħha wara mewtha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A will is a document in which someone states how their estate should be distributed after their death.

formal.mt: Fit-testment tiegħu, is-Sur Vella esprima x-xewqa li l-kotba tiegħu jingħataw lill-librerija tar-raħal.
formal.en: In his will, Mr Vella expressed the wish that his books be given to the village library.
formal.zh: 维拉先生在遗嘱中表达了将自己的书籍赠予村图书馆的意愿。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn poġġejt il-kopja tat-testment? Ġużeppi: Fil-kexxun, mal-bqija tad-dokumenti importanti.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where did you put the copy of the will? Ġużeppi: In the drawer, with the rest of the important documents.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你把遗嘱副本放在哪里了？朱塞佩：在抽屉里，和其他重要文件放在一起。

messages.speaker: Marija (妻子)
messages.zh: 你把遗嘱副本放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the copy of the will?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (丈夫)
messages.zh: 在抽屉里，和其他重要文件放在一起。
messages.en: In the drawer, with the rest of the important documents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 testment 想成装在重要文件袋里的“遗嘱”，用 tagħmel testment 记“立遗嘱”，用 taqra testment 记“阅读遗嘱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of the Christian Bible before the New Testament, containing the sacred writings of ancient Israel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教《圣经》中位于《新约》之前、收录古代以色列宗教经典的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-Bibbja Nisranija li tiġi qabel it-Testment il-Ġdid u tinkludi l-kitbiet sagri ta' Iżrael tal-qedem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 《旧约》，基督教《圣经》中位于《新约》之前、收录古代以色列宗教经典的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-Testment il-Qadim huwa l-parti tal-Bibbja Nisranija li tippreċedi t-Testment il-Ġdid u tiġbor il-kitbiet sagri ta' Iżrael tal-qedem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The Old Testament is the part of the Christian Bible that contains the sacred writings of ancient Israel and precedes the New Testament.

collocations.en: a passage from the Old Testament

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jiddiskuti t-temi ewlenin ta' silta mit-Testment il-Qadim.
formal.en: This chapter discusses the main themes of a passage from the Old Testament.
formal.zh: 本章讨论《旧约》中一段经文的主要主题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn hi s-silta li rridu naqraw? Pawlu: Mit-Testment il-Qadim. Għandi l-paġna mmarkata.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the passage we need to read from? Pawlu: From the Old Testament. I've marked the page.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们要读的那段经文出自哪里？保罗：出自《旧约》。我已经标好页码了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn hi s-silta li rridu naqraw?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn hi s-silta li rridu naqraw?
messages.zh: 我们要读的那段经文出自哪里？
messages.en: Where is the passage we need to read from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 出自《旧约》。我已经标好页码了。
messages.en: From the Old Testament. I've marked the page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 il-Qadim 与“旧”联系起来，整组记作《旧约》，再与 il-Ġdid 对照练习书名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of the Christian Bible concerned with Jesus Christ and the teachings and life of the early Christian community.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 《圣经》中记述耶稣基督及早期基督徒群体生活与教导的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-Bibbja Nisranija li tirrakkonta l-ħajja ta' Ġesù Kristu u tinkludi t-tagħlim u l-ħajja tal-ewwel komunitajiet Insara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 《新约》，基督教《圣经》中记述耶稣基督及早期基督徒生活与教导的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-Testment il-Ġdid huwa l-parti tal-Bibbja Nisranija li tittratta l-ħajja ta' Ġesù Kristu u t-tagħlim u l-ħajja tal-ewwel Insara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The New Testament is the part of the Christian Bible that describes Jesus Christ and the beliefs and life of the early Christians.

collocations.en: a passage from the New Testament

formal.mt: L-istudenti qabblu żewġ siltiet mit-Testment il-Ġdid u spjegaw it-tifsira tagħhom.
formal.en: The students compared two passages from the New Testament and explained their meaning.
formal.zh: 学生们比较了《新约》中的两段经文，并解释了它们的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema ktieb qed taqra? Mark: Qed naqra t-Testment il-Ġdid għall-lezzjoni ta' għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which book are you reading? Mark: I'm reading the New Testament for tomorrow's lesson.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在读哪本书？马克：我在读《新约》，准备明天的课。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你在读哪本书？
messages.en: Which book are you reading?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naqra t-Testment il-Ġdid għall-lezzjoni ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naqra t-Testment il-Ġdid għall-lezzjoni ta' għada.
messages.zh: 我在读《新约》，准备明天的课。
messages.en: I'm reading the New Testament for tomorrow's lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个书名与《新约》绑定记忆，并和《旧约》成对复习；看到 il-Ġdid 就回想“新”的提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bacterial disease affecting the nervous system that can cause muscle stiffness and spasms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种影响神经系统、可引起肌肉僵硬和痉挛的细菌性疾病，即破伤风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda batterika li taffettwa s-sistema nervuża u tista' tikkawża ebusija u spażmi fil-muskoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破伤风，一种由细菌产生的毒素影响神经系统、可引起肌肉僵硬和痉挛的疾病。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tetanu huwa marda kkawżata minn tossina prodotta minn batterji, li taffettwa s-sistema nervuża u tista' twassal għal ebusija u spażmi fil-muskoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tetanus is a disease in which a toxin produced by bacteria affects the nervous system and can cause severe muscle stiffness and spasms.

formal.mt: Ir-rekord mediku jindika d-data tal-aħħar tilqima kontra t-tetanu.
formal.en: The medical record indicates the date of the most recent tetanus vaccination.
formal.zh: 病历注明了最近一次接种破伤风疫苗的日期。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ġibt il-karta tat-tilqim miegħek? Mark: Iva, hawn miktub meta ħadt l-aħħar tilqima kontra t-tetanu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you bring your vaccination card? Mark: Yes, it says here when I had my last tetanus vaccination.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你带接种记录卡了吗？马克：带了，这里写着我上次接种破伤风疫苗的时间。

messages.speaker: Rita (护士)
messages.zh: 你带接种记录卡了吗？
messages.en: Did you bring your vaccination card?

messages.speaker: Mark (就诊者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn miktub meta ħadt l-aħħar tilqima kontra t-tetanu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn miktub meta ħadt l-aħħar tilqima kontra t-tetanu.
messages.zh: 带了，这里写着我上次接种破伤风疫苗的时间。
messages.en: Yes, it says here when I had my last tetanus vaccination.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用接种记录卡上的“破伤风”一栏建立画面，把 tetanu 连同 tilqima kontra t-tetanu 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young dog that has not yet reached adulthood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未成年的狗，即幼犬或小狗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelb żgħir fl-età li għadu ma laħaqx l-età adulta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幼犬，指年龄尚小、还未成年的狗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tetu huwa kelb li għadu żgħir fl-età u għadu qed jikber qabel ma jsir adult.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A puppy is a young dog that is still growing and has not yet become an adult.

formal.mt: Il-familja adottat tetu u ħaditu għand il-veterinarju għal eżami.
formal.en: The family adopted a puppy and took it to the vet for an examination.
formal.zh: 这家人领养了一只幼犬，并带它去兽医那里做检查。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu t-tetu? Ben: Qiegħed jorqod fil-qoffa tiegħu wara li lagħab fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where's the puppy? Ben: He's sleeping in his basket after playing in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：小狗在哪里？本：它在花园里玩过之后，正在自己的篮子里睡觉。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 小狗在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the puppy?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed jorqod fil-qoffa tiegħu wara li lagħab fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed jorqod fil-qoffa tiegħu wara li lagħab fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 它在花园里玩过之后，正在自己的篮子里睡觉。
messages.en: He's sleeping in his basket after playing in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tetu 就想象一只在篮子里睡觉的幼犬，用“小狗还在长大”的画面记住年龄含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person responsible for managing the money and financial records of an organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责管理组织的资金、收支和财务记录的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna responsabbli mill-ġestjoni tal-flus u mir-reġistri finanzjarji ta' organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 司库；负责组织资金管理及财务记录的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu ħsieb il-flus, id-dħul, il-ħruġ u r-reġistri finanzjarji ta' organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A treasurer is someone who manages an organization's money and keeps records of its financial activities.

formal.mt: It-tezorier tal-għaqda ppreżenta rapport dwar id-dħul u l-ħruġ matul il-laqgħa annwali.
formal.en: The association's treasurer presented a report on income and expenditure during the annual meeting.
formal.zh: 协会司库在年度会议上提交了收支报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lil min nagħti l-flus tas-sħubija? Mark: Agħtihom lil Pawlu, it-tezorier tal-għaqda. Maja: Tajjeb, nitolbu rċevuta wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who should I give the membership fee to? Mark: Give it to Pawlu, the association's treasurer. Maja: All right, I'll ask him for a receipt too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：会费应该交给谁？Mark：交给Pawlu，他是协会的司库。Maja：好的，我也会向他要一张收据。

messages.speaker: Maja (会员)
messages.zh: 会费应该交给谁？
messages.en: Who should I give the membership fee to?

messages.speaker: Mark (协会同事)
messages.zh: 交给Pawlu，他是协会的司库。
messages.en: Give it to Pawlu, the association's treasurer.

messages.speaker: Maja (会员)
messages.zh: 好的，我也会向他要一张收据。
messages.en: All right, I'll ask him for a receipt too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把tezorier与“收会费、记账、出收据”的负责人画面绑定，记住它指管理组织钱款的人。

gloss_zh: 带走它们；拿走它们；带他们走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take the people or things already referred to with you or to another place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把前面提到的多个人或物带在身边，或带到另一个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieħu miegħek jew twassal f'post ieħor lill-persuni jew lill-oġġetti li diġà ssemmew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拿走或带走前文所指的它们；也可指带走他们或她们。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieħu lill-persuni jew lill-oġġetti msemmija minn qabel minn fejn ikunu, miegħek jew lejn post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you take them, you bring the people or things already mentioned with you or move them elsewhere.

collocations.zh: 把它们带在身边；带他们一起走
把它们带回去；带他们回去

formal.mt: Meta d-dokumenti jkunu lesti, tista' teħodhom fl-uffiċċju prinċipali.
formal.en: When the documents are ready, you can take them to the main office.
formal.zh: 文件准备好后，你可以把它们送到主办公室。
