colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn il-kotba għandek bżonnhom? Mark: Iva, tista' teħodhom miegħek u tagħtihomli għada?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you need these books? Mark: Yes, can you take them with you and give them to me tomorrow?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些书你需要吗？马克：需要，你能先带走，明天再给我吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这些书你需要吗？
messages.en: Do you need these books?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' teħodhom miegħek u tagħtihomli għada?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' teħodhom miegħek u tagħtihomli għada?
messages.zh: 需要，你能先带走，明天再给我吗？
messages.en: Yes, can you take them with you and give them to me tomorrow?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把桌上的几本书一起带走：teħodhom 要连着记成“带走它们”，同时记住所指对象也可以是多个人。

gloss_zh: 学位论文；理论；特定议题上的坚定主张

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substantial written study submitted for an academic qualification, or a central claim developed and defended through argument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为取得学位而提交的研究论文，也可指通过论证提出并维护的核心主张。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol ta' riċerka miktub biex tinkiseb kwalifika akkademika, jew idea ċentrali li titressaq u tiġi difiża permezz ta' argumenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为取得学位而撰写并提交的研究论文。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol ta' riċerka miktub li student jippreżenta biex jikseb grad akkademiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A thesis is a substantial piece of research writing submitted as part of an academic degree.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于解释某种现象或一组事实的理论或学说。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spjegazzjoni jew sistema ta' ideat maħsuba biex tispjega fenomenu jew ġabra ta' fatti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A theory is a developed explanation intended to account for particular facts or phenomena.

sense_translations.en_definition: point of view or strongly-held view on a specific topic
sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对某一具体议题所持的观点，尤指坚定维护的主张。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pożizzjoni jew fehma dwar suġġett partikolari li persuna tħaddan u tista' tiddefendi b'konvinzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's thesis on a particular topic is the position they put forward and may defend strongly.

collocations.en: to defend a thesis or argument
collocations.zh: 为论文或主张进行辩护

collocations.en: to put forward a thesis or claim

formal.mt: Fit-teżi tagħha, ir-riċerkatriċi teżamina kif it-tfal jitgħallmu żewġ lingwi fl-istess ħin.
formal.en: In her thesis, the researcher examines how children learn two languages at the same time.
formal.zh: 研究者在她的学位论文中探讨儿童如何同时学习两种语言。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejra bit-teżi? Lara: Kważi lestejtha; fadalli nikteb il-konklużjoni. Maja: Mela dalwaqt tkun tista' tistrieħ ftit!
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your thesis going? Lara: I've almost finished it; I still have to write the conclusion. Maja: Then you'll soon be able to get some rest!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的论文写得怎么样了？拉拉：快写完了，还剩结论要写。玛雅：那你很快就能休息一下了！

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你的论文写得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is your thesis going?

messages.speaker: Lara (研究生)
messages.zh: 快写完了，还剩结论要写。
messages.en: I've almost finished it; I still have to write the conclusion.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela dalwaqt tkun tista' tistrieħ ftit!
messages.mt_standard: Mela dalwaqt tkun tista' tistrieħ ftit!
messages.zh: 那你很快就能休息一下了！
messages.en: Then you'll soon be able to get some rest!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teżi 放进“写论文、立理论、辩观点”三个学习画面：学位语境想到论文，解释现象想到理论，讨论议题想到主张。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An actor who performs in theatrical productions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在戏剧演出中扮演角色的演员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attur li jinterpreta karattri fi produzzjonijiet teatrali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戏剧演员，尤指参与舞台戏剧演出的演员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem bħala attur u tinterpreta karattri fi produzzjonijiet teatrali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A thespian is an actor, especially one who performs in theatrical productions.

formal.mt: It-teżiku interpreta r-rwol ewlieni fid-dramm u ġibed l-attenzjoni tal-udjenza mill-ewwel xena.
formal.en: The stage actor played the leading role in the play and captured the audience's attention from the first scene.
formal.zh: 这位戏剧演员在剧中担任主角，从第一场戏开始就吸引了观众的注意。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu dak it-teżiku fuq il-palk? Pawlu: Jismu Mark. Rajtu fi dramm ieħor is-sena l-oħra. Nina: Jogħġobni kif jitkellem; kull kelma tinftiehem.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is that stage actor on the stage? Pawlu: His name is Mark. I saw him in another play last year. Nina: I like the way he speaks; you can understand every word.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：台上那位戏剧演员是谁？保罗：他叫马克。我去年看过他演另一部戏。妮娜：我喜欢他说话的方式，每个字都听得清楚。

messages.speaker: Nina (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak it-teżiku fuq il-palk?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak it-teżiku fuq il-palk?
messages.zh: 台上那位戏剧演员是谁？
messages.en: Who is that stage actor on the stage?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jismu Mark. Rajtu fi dramm ieħor is-sena l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Jismu Mark. Rajtu fi dramm ieħor is-sena l-oħra.
messages.zh: 他叫马克。我去年看过他演另一部戏。
messages.en: His name is Mark. I saw him in another play last year.

messages.speaker: Nina (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Jogħġobni kif jitkellem; kull kelma tinftiehem.
messages.mt_standard: Jogħġobni kif jitkellem; kull kelma tinftiehem.
messages.zh: 我喜欢他说话的方式，每个字都听得清楚。
messages.en: I like the way he speaks; you can understand every word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 teżiku 时想象舞台中央正在说台词的人，把“人物、角色、舞台”连成画面，就能记住戏剧演员这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A collection of valuable objects, or something regarded as especially precious.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由贵重物品组成的宝藏，也可指被视为格外珍贵的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' oġġetti prezzjużi, jew xi ħaġa li titqies ta' valur kbir ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金银、珠宝等贵重物品构成的宝藏；也可比喻极其珍贵的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' deheb, ġawhar jew oġġetti oħra ta' valur kbir, jew xi ħaġa meqjusa prezzjuża ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Treasure consists of valuable objects such as gold and jewels, or something that is considered especially precious.

formal.mt: Il-kollezzjoni ta' manuskritti antiki hija teżor kulturali li għandu jinżamm għall-ġenerazzjonijiet futuri.
formal.en: The collection of ancient manuscripts is a cultural treasure that should be preserved for future generations.
formal.zh: 这批古代手稿是应当为后代保存的文化瑰宝。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Fejn hu t-teżor fuq din il-mappa? Sara: Ħdejn is-siġra l-kbira. Ejja nfittxu hemm! Luca: Sibt il-kaxxa! Fiha muniti taċ-ċikkulata!
colloquial.en: Luca: Where is the treasure on this map? Sara: Near the big tree. Let's look there! Luca: I found the box! It has chocolate coins inside!
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：这张地图上的宝藏在哪里？萨拉：在大树旁边。我们去那里找吧！卢卡：我找到盒子了！里面有巧克力金币！

messages.speaker: Luca (参加寻宝游戏的孩子)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu t-teżor fuq din il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu t-teżor fuq din il-mappa?
messages.zh: 这张地图上的宝藏在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the treasure on this map?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn is-siġra l-kbira. Ejja nfittxu hemm!
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn is-siġra l-kbira. Ejja nfittxu hemm!
messages.zh: 在大树旁边。我们去那里找吧！
messages.en: Near the big tree. Let's look there!

messages.speaker: Luca (参加寻宝游戏的孩子)
messages.zh: 我找到盒子了！里面有巧克力金币！
messages.en: I found the box! It has chocolate coins inside!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teżor 与藏宝图和装满金币的箱子一起记，再把画面延伸到珍贵手稿，便能兼记具体宝藏和比喻性的瑰宝。

gloss_zh: 财政管理部门；国库；金库

teaching_sense.en_definition: The department that manages the money of a government or organization, or a place where funds and valuables are kept.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 管理政府或机构资金的财政部门，也可指存放资金及贵重物品的国库或金库。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dipartiment li jamministra l-flus ta' gvern jew organizzazzjoni, jew post fejn jinżammu fondi u oġġetti prezzjużi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管理政府或机构资金的财政部门；也指保管资金或贵重物品的国库、金库。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dipartiment responsabbli mill-ġestjoni tal-fondi ta' gvern jew organizzazzjoni, jew post fejn jinżammu flus u oġġetti prezzjużi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A treasury is a department that manages public or organizational funds, or a place where money and valuables are kept.

formal.mt: It-teżorerija għandha tivverifika d-dettalji bankarji qabel ma tawtorizza l-ħlas.
formal.en: The treasury must verify the bank details before authorizing payment.
formal.zh: 财政管理部门必须先核实银行账户资料，才能批准付款。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lil min għandi nċempel dwar il-ħlas? Anna: Ċempel lit-teżorerija u agħtihom in-numru tal-fattura. Mark: Tajjeb, għandi n-numru hawn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who should I call about the payment? Anna: Call the treasury and give them the invoice number. Mark: All right, I have the number here.
colloquial.zh: 马克：关于这笔付款，我该打电话给谁？安娜：打给财政管理部门，把发票号码告诉他们。马克：好的，号码就在我这里。

messages.speaker: Mark (供应商)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min għandi nċempel dwar il-ħlas?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min għandi nċempel dwar il-ħlas?
messages.zh: 关于这笔付款，我该打电话给谁？
messages.en: Who should I call about the payment?

messages.speaker: Anna (行政职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempel lit-teżorerija u agħtihom in-numru tal-fattura.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempel lit-teżorerija u agħtihom in-numru tal-fattura.
messages.zh: 打给财政管理部门，把发票号码告诉他们。
messages.en: Call the treasury and give them the invoice number.

messages.speaker: Mark (供应商)
messages.zh: 好的，号码就在我这里。
messages.en: All right, I have the number here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用场景区分：teżor 想到宝藏，teżorerija 想到管理资金的办公室或保管财物的金库；这是词义联想记忆法。

gloss_zh: 潦草书写；乱写乱画这一行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of writing quickly or carelessly, often producing untidy marks or handwriting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 匆忙或不认真地书写、随意涂写的行为，写出的字迹或笔画通常不整齐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività ta' kitba mgħaġġla jew bla reqqa, li ħafna drabi tipproduċi kliem jew marki mhux ċari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潦草书写或随手乱写乱画的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività ta' kitba jew ta' tqegħid ta' marki fuq il-karta b'mod mgħaġġel jew bla reqqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Scribbling is the activity of writing quickly or carelessly, so that the resulting writing or marks may look untidy.

collocations.zh: 在页边空白处乱写乱画

formal.mt: It-tfaxxar fuq il-formola għamel xi tweġibiet diffiċli biex jinqraw.
formal.en: The scribbling on the form made some answers difficult to read.
formal.zh: 表格上的潦草书写使部分答案难以辨认。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan it-tfaxxar fil-marġni? Ben: Kont qed nikteb xi ideat malajr. Lara: Mela iktibhom aktar ċar qabel tinsiehom.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's all this scribbling in the margin? Ben: I was jotting down some ideas quickly. Lara: Then write them more clearly before you forget them.
colloquial.zh: Lara：页边这些乱写的是什么？Ben：我刚才在匆匆记几个想法。Lara：那趁还没忘，把它们写清楚些。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 页边这些乱写的是什么？
messages.en: What's all this scribbling in the margin?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont qed nikteb xi ideat malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Kont qed nikteb xi ideat malajr.
messages.zh: 我刚才在匆匆记几个想法。
messages.en: I was jotting down some ideas quickly.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela iktibhom aktar ċar qabel tinsiehom.
messages.mt_standard: Mela iktibhom aktar ċar qabel tinsiehom.
messages.zh: 那趁还没忘，把它们写清楚些。
messages.en: Then write them more clearly before you forget them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把tfaxxar配上“急着记想法，纸上字迹乱”的画面；本词条按名词学习，表示潦草涂写这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An injury caused by overstretching or tearing the ligaments around a joint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 关节周围的韧带因过度拉伸或撕裂而造成的损伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġerħa kkawżata minn tiġbid żejjed jew tiċrit tal-ligamenti madwar ġog.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭伤，指关节周围韧带过度拉伸或撕裂造成的损伤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġerħa fil-ligamenti ta' ġog li sseħħ meta dawn jiġġebbdu żżejjed jew jiċċarrtu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sprain is an injury in which the ligaments around a joint are stretched too far or torn.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jindika li l-atleta għandu tfekkika fl-għaksa tal-lemin.
formal.en: The medical report indicates that the athlete has a sprain in his right ankle.
formal.zh: 医疗报告显示，这名运动员的右脚踝扭伤了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed izzappap? Luqa: Għandi tfekkika fl-għaksa minn meta waqajt ilbieraħ. Nina: Tridni nġiblek siġġu?
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you limping? Luqa: I have an ankle sprain from when I fell yesterday. Nina: Shall I bring you a chair?
colloquial.zh: Nina：你怎么一瘸一拐的？Luqa：我昨天摔了一跤，把脚踝扭伤了。Nina：要我给你搬把椅子吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么一瘸一拐的？
messages.en: Why are you limping?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi tfekkika fl-għaksa minn meta waqajt ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi tfekkika fl-għaksa minn meta waqajt ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 我昨天摔了一跤，把脚踝扭伤了。
messages.en: I have an ankle sprain from when I fell yesterday.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 要我给你搬把椅子吗？
messages.en: Shall I bring you a chair?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把tfekkika和“脚下一歪，脚踝扭伤”的画面一起记，再用tfekkika fl-għaksa巩固身体部位搭配。

gloss_zh: 用手指搓揉东西的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of rubbing something between one's fingers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物放在手指之间反复搓动或揉动的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed jogħrok xi ħaġa bejn is-swaba' tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用手指夹着某物并反复搓揉的动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed iżomm xi ħaġa bejn is-swaba' u jogħrokha b'movimenti ripetuti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This is the action of holding something between your fingers and rubbing it with repeated small movements.

collocations.en: rubbing a piece of paper between the fingers

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, ġie rreġistrat tfettil ripetut ta' biċċa karta bejn is-swaba' tal-parteċipant.
formal.en: During the observation, the participant was recorded repeatedly rubbing a piece of paper between their fingers.
formal.zh: 观察过程中，记录到参与者反复用手指搓揉一小片纸的动作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Toni: Huwa t-tfettil ta' din il-biċċa karta bejn subgħajja. Sara: Tista' tieqaf ftit? Qed nipprova naqra.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's that noise? Toni: It's the rubbing of this piece of paper between my fingers. Sara: Could you stop for a moment? I'm trying to read.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那是什么声音？Toni：是我用手指搓这片纸的声音。Sara：你能停一会儿吗？我正在看书。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa t-tfettil ta' din il-biċċa karta bejn subgħajja.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa t-tfettil ta' din il-biċċa karta bejn subgħajja.
messages.zh: 是我用手指搓这片纸的声音。
messages.en: It's the rubbing of this piece of paper between my fingers.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tieqaf ftit? Qed nipprova naqra.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tieqaf ftit? Qed nipprova naqra.
messages.zh: 你能停一会儿吗？我正在看书。
messages.en: Could you stop for a moment? I'm trying to read.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习tfettil时想象拇指和食指夹着纸片来回搓，重点记住“手指之间的搓揉动作”这一名词含义。

gloss_zh: 词义未明（所给英文释义为“brib”）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb supplied with the unclear English gloss 'brib'; its meaning cannot be reliably established from this packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词性标注为动词，但所给英文释义“brib”不明确，无法仅据本资料确定其具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb mogħti bit-tifsira Ingliża mhux ċara 'brib'; l-informazzjoni pprovduta mhijiex biżżejjed biex jiġi stabbilit it-tifsir tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义“brib”含义不明，无法可靠确定对应的中文动词释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija hija 'brib', iżda din mhijiex ċara biżżejjed biex jiġi spjegat x'azzjoni jindika l-verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss is unclear and does not establish which action this verb describes.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, 'tfewaq' huwa mmarkat bħala verb, iżda t-tifsira Ingliża 'brib' teħtieġ kjarifika.
formal.en: In this list, 'tfewaq' is marked as a verb, but the English gloss 'brib' requires clarification.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，“tfewaq”被标注为动词，但英文释义“brib”需要澄清。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'tfewaq'? Pawlu: Hawn miktub 'brib', imma minn hekk biss ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tfewaq' mean? Pawlu: It says 'brib' here, but that alone does not let us be certain of the meaning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：‘tfewaq’是什么意思？Pawlu：这里写的是‘brib’，但仅凭这个还无法确定词义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “tfewaq”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tfewaq' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 'brib', imma minn hekk biss ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'brib', imma minn hekk biss ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira.
messages.zh: 这里写的是“brib”，但仅凭这个还无法确定词义。
messages.en: It says 'brib' here, but that alone does not let us be certain of the meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放在“动词待核实”卡片上：先记原拼写，旁注英文释义不明，避免猜义后记错。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun supplied with the unexplained gloss 'Tfigĥ'; the packet does not establish its meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词性标注为名词，但资料仅提供未解释的“Tfigĥ”，无法据此确定该名词所指的事物或概念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom mogħti bit-tifsira mhux spjegata 'Tfigĥ'; l-informazzjoni pprovduta ma tistabbilixxix għal xiex jirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给“Tfigĥ”未附解释，无法可靠确定中文词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma 'Tfigĥ' tingħata bħala tifsira, iżda mingħajr spjegazzjoni ma nistgħux nidentifikaw il-ħaġa jew il-kunċett indikat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss provides no explanation of the thing or concept this noun denotes.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'Tfigh' hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda l-forma 'Tfigĥ' mogħtija fit-tifsira ma tipprovdix spjegazzjoni tal-użu tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'Tfigh' is marked as a noun, but the form 'Tfigĥ' supplied as its gloss does not explain its usage.
formal.zh: “Tfigh”被标注为名词，但释义栏给出的形式“Tfigĥ”并未解释其用法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif nuża 'Tfigh' f'sentenza? Mark: Għandna biss 'Tfigĥ' bħala tifsira; għandna bżonn spjegazzjoni qabel nużawha.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do I use 'Tfigh' in a sentence? Mark: We only have 'Tfigĥ' as the gloss; we need an explanation before using it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我该怎样用‘Tfigh’造句？Mark：释义只有‘Tfigĥ’；我们需要先弄清解释，再使用这个词。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 我该怎样用“Tfigh”造句？
messages.en: How do I use 'Tfigh' in a sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna biss 'Tfigĥ' bħala tifsira; għandna bżonn spjegazzjoni qabel nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna biss 'Tfigĥ' bħala tifsira; għandna bżonn spjegazzjoni qabel nużawha.
messages.zh: 释义只有“Tfigĥ”；我们需要先弄清解释，再使用这个词。
messages.en: We only have 'Tfigĥ' as the gloss; we need an explanation before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用双栏卡分别抄写词形“Tfigh”和原释义“Tfigĥ”，标注“名词，词义待核实”，不要自行把两种写法等同。

gloss_zh: 市场扰动；市场秩序受到干扰

teaching_sense.en_definition: A disruption of the normal functioning or conditions of a market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 市场正常运行或正常交易状况受到干扰的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni li fiha jkun hemm xkiel għall-funzjonament normali tas-suq jew għall-kummerċ li jsir fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市场扰动，指市场正常运作或交易活动受到干扰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfixkil fil-mod kif is-suq jiffunzjona normalment, li jista' jaffettwa l-attivitajiet tax-xiri u l-bejgħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A market disturbance is a disruption that interferes with normal market activity or conditions.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif id-dewmien fil-provvisti kkawża tfixkil fis-suq tal-ikel.
formal.en: The report explains how delays in supplies caused disruption in the food market.
formal.zh: 报告解释了供应延误如何引起食品市场扰动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex illum m'hemmx daqshekk prodotti? Mark: Il-provvisti waslu tard, u dan ħoloq tfixkil fis-suq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there fewer products today? Mark: The supplies arrived late, and that caused disruption in the market.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天为什么商品少了？Mark：货物到晚了，造成了市场供应和交易的混乱。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天为什么商品少了？
messages.en: Why are there fewer products today?

messages.speaker: Mark (商贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-provvisti waslu tard, u dan ħoloq tfixkil fis-suq.
messages.mt_standard: Il-provvisti waslu tard, u dan ħoloq tfixkil fis-suq.
messages.zh: 货物到晚了，造成了市场供应和交易的混乱。
messages.en: The supplies arrived late, and that caused disruption in the market.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象市场里的正常买卖被迟到的货车打乱，把整个短语和“市场运行受干扰”的场景一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hold someone close in a gentle and affectionate way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 温柔地把某人搂在怀里，以表达亲近、爱意或安慰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħaddan lil xi ħadd bil-ħlewwa u żżommu qrib tiegħek biex turih affezzjoni jew tagħtih faraġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亲昵地搂住某人，或把某人温柔地抱在怀里。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħaddan lil xi ħadd u żżommu qrib tiegħek b'mod ġentili u mimli affezzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you cuddle someone, you hold them close to show affection or give comfort.

formal.mt: Meta tgezzez lit-tarbija, żommha qrib tiegħek b'ġentilezza.
formal.en: When you cuddle the baby, hold the baby close gently.
formal.zh: 搂抱婴儿时，要温柔地把孩子抱在身边。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Trid tgezzez lit-tarbija ftit? Pawlu: Iva, ħa nżommha qrib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Marta: Would you like to cuddle the baby for a while? Pawlu: Yes, let me hold the baby close.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你想搂着宝宝一会儿吗？保罗：想，让我把宝宝抱在怀里。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.zh: 你想搂着宝宝一会儿吗？
messages.en: Would you like to cuddle the baby for a while?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 想，让我把宝宝抱在怀里。
messages.en: Yes, let me hold the baby close.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“轻轻搂住宝宝”的画面一起记，重点是贴近身体、表达温柔与爱意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling or expression of liking or approval.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事物产生的喜爱、好感，或表达出的赞许。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Hija sensazzjoni jew espressjoni ta' għoġba jew approvazzjoni lejn persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人或某事物的喜爱、好感或赞许。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Hija għoġba li persuna tħoss għal xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew espressjoni ta' approvazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A like is a feeling or expression of enjoyment, preference, or approval.

collocations.en: an expression of liking or approval

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, in-nom 'tghogobhom' jindika għoġba jew approvazzjoni għal xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.
formal.en: In this exercise, the noun 'tghogobhom' indicates liking or approval of someone or something.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，名词“tghogobhom”表示对某人或某事物的喜爱或赞许。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'tghogobhom' f'din il-lista? Mark: Għoġba jew approvazzjoni, bħal meta xi kanzunetta togħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'tghogobhom' mean in this list? Mark: Liking or approval, as when you like a song.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这张词表里的“tghogobhom”是什么意思？马克：喜爱或赞许，比如你喜欢一首歌时的那种感觉。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这张词表里的“tghogobhom”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tghogobhom' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoġba jew approvazzjoni, bħal meta xi kanzunetta togħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Għoġba jew approvazzjoni, bħal meta xi kanzunetta togħġbok.
messages.zh: 喜爱或赞许，比如你喜欢一首歌时的那种感觉。
messages.en: Liking or approval, as when you like a song.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条的名词义，想象把“喜欢的感觉”装进一个小盒子，盒子里放着好感与赞许。

gloss_zh: 咬牙；牙齿的磨擦或咬磨

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of pressing and grinding the teeth together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 上下牙齿用力咬合并相互磨擦的动作，常用于描写愤怒或痛苦时的咬牙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huwa l-att li tagħfas u tħokk is-snien ma' xulxin, spiss minħabba rabja jew uġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牙齿用力相互咬磨的动作，尤指愤怒或痛苦时的咬牙。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa tagħfis u tħakkik tas-snien ma' xulxin, speċjalment bħala espressjoni ta' rabja jew uġigħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gnashing is the action of pressing and grinding your teeth together, especially in anger or pain.

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, it-tgħażżiż tas-snien tal-karattru juri kemm kien irrabjat.
formal.en: In the story, the character's gnashing of teeth shows how angry he was.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物咬牙的动作表现出他当时有多愤怒。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex l-awtur isemmi t-tgħażżiż tas-snien hawn? Ġanni: Biex jurina kemm hu rrabjat il-karattru.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does the author mention gnashing of teeth here? Ġanni: To show us how angry the character is.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：作者为什么在这里提到咬牙？詹尼：为了让我们看出这个人物有多生气。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-awtur isemmi t-tgħażżiż tas-snien hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-awtur isemmi t-tgħażżiż tas-snien hawn?
messages.zh: 作者为什么在这里提到咬牙？
messages.en: Why does the author mention gnashing of teeth here?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jurina kemm hu rrabjat il-karattru.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jurina kemm hu rrabjat il-karattru.
messages.zh: 为了让我们看出这个人物有多生气。
messages.en: To show us how angry the character is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事人物气得牙齿咬磨，把“咬牙的动作”作为整体名词来记，并搭配 tas-snien 练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be alive, lead your life, or have your home in a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于活着的状态、过某种生活，或以某个地方为居住地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkun ħaj, tqatta' ħajtek b'ċertu mod, jew ikollok id-dar tiegħek f'post partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 活着；过日子；居住在某个地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tkun ħaj u tkompli l-ħajja tiegħek, jew toqgħod f'post li jkun id-dar tiegħek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you live somewhere, you have your home there; to live also means to be alive.

formal.mt: Marija tgħix f'Malta u taħdem fi skola qrib id-dar tagħha.
formal.en: Marija lives in Malta and works at a school near her home.
formal.zh: 玛丽娅住在马耳他，在离家不远的一所学校工作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn tgħix issa? David: Ngħix f'Malta, qrib il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where do you live now? David: I live in Malta, near the sea.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你现在住在哪里？戴维：我住在马耳他，离海边很近。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live now?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 我住在马耳他，离海边很近。
messages.en: I live in Malta, near the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“活着、生活、居住”串成一幅日常画面：一个人住在海边，每天在那里过日子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To look for something that you want to find.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了找到某件东西而进行寻找或搜寻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fittex xi ħaġa bil-għan li ssibha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寻找；设法找到某件东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fittex xi ħaġa li trid issib.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you look for something, you try to find where it is.

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, Mark tharwex fil-kexxun biex isib id-dokument meħtieġ.
formal.en: Before the meeting, Mark looked through the drawer to find the required document.
formal.zh: 开会前，马克在抽屉里寻找所需的文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark tharwex fil-kexxun? Lara: Kien qed ifittex l-imfietaħ, imma fl-aħħar sabhom fil-basket.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark look through the drawer? Lara: He was looking for the keys, but he eventually found them in the bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么翻找抽屉？拉拉：他在找钥匙，不过最后在包里找到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么翻找抽屉？
messages.en: Why did Mark look through the drawer?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien qed ifittex l-imfietaħ, imma fl-aħħar sabhom fil-basket.
messages.mt_standard: Kien qed ifittex l-imfietaħ, imma fl-aħħar sabhom fil-basket.
messages.zh: 他在找钥匙，不过最后在包里找到了。
messages.en: He was looking for the keys, but he eventually found them in the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“钥匙不见了，打开抽屉寻找”的画面绑定；记住它表达寻找的动作，不表示已经找到。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work or activity of getting ready for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某件事情预先做好安排、备齐所需物品或使自己就绪的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma li ssir minn qabel biex persuna jew xi ħaġa tkun lesta għal attività jew avveniment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准备；为即将发生的事情预先进行的安排和工作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol u l-arranġamenti li jsiru minn qabel sabiex kollox ikun lest għal xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Preparation is the work you do beforehand so that you are ready for an activity or event.

formal.mt: It-thejjija għall-eżami tinkludi r-reviżjoni tan-noti u t-tweġib ta' mistoqsijiet ta' prova.
formal.en: Preparation for the exam includes reviewing notes and answering practice questions.
formal.zh: 备考包括复习笔记和练习答题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sejra t-thejjija għall-festa? Mark: Kważi kollox lest; għad irridu nixtru x-xorb.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is the preparation for the party going? Mark: Almost everything is ready; we still need to buy the drinks.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：聚会准备得怎么样了？马克：差不多都好了，还得买饮料。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 聚会准备得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is the preparation for the party going?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi kollox lest; għad irridu nixtru x-xorb.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi kollox lest; għad irridu nixtru x-xorb.
messages.zh: 差不多都好了，还得买饮料。
messages.en: Almost everything is ready; we still need to buy the drinks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象考试前的待办清单：整理笔记、安排时间、做练习；把这些事前工作整体记作“准备”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling or state of being happy and content.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因生活、经历或与他人的关系而感到快乐、满足或幸福的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' ferħ u kuntentizza li persuna tħoss f'ħajjitha jew f'mument partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幸福；快乐；内心感到愉悦和满足的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sentiment ta' ferħ u sodisfazzjon li tħoss meta tkun kuntent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Happiness is the feeling of pleasure and contentment you have when you are happy.

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tiddeskrivi t-thennija li ġabet magħha l-laqgħa mill-ġdid tal-familja.
formal.en: The author describes the happiness brought by the family's reunion.
formal.zh: 作者描写了家人重聚带来的幸福与喜悦。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tixtieq għal għeluq sninek? Maja: Ftit mistrieħ u ħafna thennija mal-familja!
colloquial.en: Lara: What would you like for your birthday? Maja: A little rest and lots of happiness with my family!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你生日想要什么？玛雅：休息一下，再和家人开开心心地相处！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你生日想要什么？
messages.en: What would you like for your birthday?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit mistrieħ u ħafna thennija mal-familja!
messages.mt_standard: Ftit mistrieħ u ħafna thennija mal-familja!
messages.zh: 休息一下，再和家人开开心心地相处！
messages.en: A little rest and lots of happiness with my family!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一张全家团聚的笑脸照片，记住照片里共同感受到的“幸福与快乐”，而不是某一件礼物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gain an advantage or a positive result from something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某事物中获得好处、帮助或积极效果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikseb vantaġġ, għajnuna jew riżultat tajjeb minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从某事物中受益或获得好处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieħu ġid jew tikseb vantaġġ minn xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you benefit from something, it helps you or improves your situation.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tista' tibbenefika minn taħriġ regolari għall-impjegati tagħha.
formal.en: The company can benefit from regular training for its employees.
formal.zh: 公司可以从为员工提供的定期培训中受益。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li nista' nibbenefika minn dan il-kors? Lara: Iva, tibbenefika ħafna jekk tipprattika kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think I can benefit from this course? Lara: Yes, you'll benefit a lot if you practise every day.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你觉得这门课能让我受益吗？Lara：能，如果你每天练习，就会受益很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li nista' nibbenefika minn dan il-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li nista' nibbenefika minn dan il-kors?
messages.zh: 你觉得这门课能让我受益吗？
messages.en: Do you think I can benefit from this course?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tibbenefika ħafna jekk tipprattika kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tibbenefika ħafna jekk tipprattika kuljum.
messages.zh: 能，如果你每天练习，就会受益很多。
messages.en: Yes, you'll benefit a lot if you practise every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把培训后学会新技能的画面与 tibbenefika 相连；搭配 minn，记成“从某事中受益”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange in advance to reserve a room, ticket, service, or appointment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提前安排并保留房间、票、服务或预约时段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel arranġament minn qabel biex tirriżerva kamra, biljett, servizz jew appuntament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某人提前预订房间、票或服务，或预约时段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna tagħmel prenotazzjoni minn qabel għal kamra, biljett, servizz jew appuntament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone books something, they arrange in advance to reserve it for a particular time.

formal.mt: Meta tibbukja kamra, għandek tispeċifika d-data tal-wasla u n-numru ta' ljieli.
formal.en: When you book a room, you should specify your arrival date and the number of nights.
formal.zh: 预订房间时，应注明抵达日期和住宿晚数。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tibbukja mejda għal tnejn għal għada? Rita: Iva, għal x'ħin? Mark: Għat-tmienja, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you book a table for two for tomorrow? Rita: Yes, for what time? Mark: For eight, please.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你能订一张明天的双人桌吗？Rita：可以，订几点？Mark：请订八点。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tibbukja mejda għal tnejn għal għada?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tibbukja mejda għal tnejn għal għada?
messages.zh: 你能订一张明天的双人桌吗？
messages.en: Can you book a table for two for tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，订几点？
messages.en: Yes, for what time?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 请订八点。
messages.en: For eight, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出发前先在日历上圈定日期，再预订房间或票；用 tibbukja kamra 整组记忆。

gloss_zh: 开展调查；启动调查；立案调查

teaching_sense.en_definition: The commencement of an investigation to establish facts about a matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为查明某件事情的事实而开展或启动调查这一行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bidu ta' investigazzjoni biex jiġu stabbiliti l-fatti dwar kwistjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始开展调查，着重指调查工作的起始。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bidu tax-xogħol ta' investigazzjoni biex jinġabru u jiġu eżaminati l-fatti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: To commence an investigation is to begin examining a matter in order to establish the facts.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发起或启动调查，着重指促使调查程序开始。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tnedija ta' investigazzjoni billi jittieħdu l-ewwel passi biex tiġi eżaminata kwistjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: To initiate an investigation is to take the steps that cause an inquiry into a matter to begin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正式展开调查；在适当的执法语境中可指立案调查。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ftuħ formali ta' investigazzjoni dwar każ jew kwistjoni li teħtieġ eżami.
sense_translations.en_explanation: To open an investigation is to formally begin looking into a case or a particular matter.

collocations.en: open an investigation into the case

formal.mt: Il-kummissjoni ddeċidiet li tibda investigazzjoni dwar l-ilmenti li rċeviet.
formal.en: The commission decided to open an investigation into the complaints it had received.
formal.zh: 委员会决定对收到的投诉展开调查。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se tagħmel il-kumpanija dwar l-ilment? Pawlu: Se tibda investigazzjoni interna biex issir taf x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Nina: What will the company do about the complaint? Pawlu: It will launch an internal investigation to find out what happened.
colloquial.zh: Nina：公司会怎样处理这项投诉？Pawlu：公司会启动内部调查，查清发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 公司会怎样处理这项投诉？
messages.en: What will the company do about the complaint?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tibda investigazzjoni interna biex issir taf x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Se tibda investigazzjoni interna biex issir taf x'ġara.
messages.zh: 公司会启动内部调查，查清发生了什么。
messages.en: It will launch an internal investigation to find out what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成“调查按下启动键”；连接收到投诉、开始查证的连续画面来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proper name used to identify a particular entity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于指称特定对象的专有名称，书写形式为 Tibet。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju miktub Tibet li jintuża biex jidentifika entità partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专名 Tibet；此义项对应的名称为 Tieb。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isem proprju Tibet, li f'dan is-sens jikkorrispondi għall-isem Tieb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this sense, the proper name Tibet corresponds to the name Tieb.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-isem Tibet għandu jinkiteb b'ittra kapitali fil-bidu.
formal.en: In this exercise, the name Tibet should be written with an initial capital letter.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，专名 Tibet 的首字母应大写。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nikteb l-isem Tibet? Mark: B'T kapitali fil-bidu, imbagħad i, b, e, t.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I write the name Tibet? Mark: With a capital T at the start, then i, b, e, t.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Tibet 这个名字怎么写？Mark：开头用大写 T，接着写 i、b、e、t。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: Tibet 这个名字怎么写？
messages.en: How do I write the name Tibet?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: B'T kapitali fil-bidu, imbagħad i, b, e, t.
messages.mt_standard: B'T kapitali fil-bidu, imbagħad i, b, e, t.
messages.zh: 开头用大写 T，接着写 i、b、e、t。
messages.en: With a capital T at the start, then i, b, e, t.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Tibet 当作一张完整的专名标签来记，先记大写 T，再依次拼出其余四个字母。

gloss_zh: 西藏的；藏族的；藏文化的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Tibet, its people, or their language and culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与西藏、藏族人民或其语言和文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-Tibet, mal-poplu tiegħu jew mal-lingwa u l-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西藏的；与藏族人民、藏语或藏文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirreferi għat-Tibet jew għal dak li għandu x'jaqsam mal-poplu, il-lingwa jew il-kultura tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Tibetan relates to Tibet, its people, or their language and culture.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istil Tibetan li jidher fid-dekorazzjoni tal-bini.
formal.en: The report describes the Tibetan style visible in the building's decoration.
formal.zh: 这份报告描述了建筑装饰中呈现的藏式风格。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jogħġbok l-istil Tibetan ta' din il-kamra? Pawlu: Iva, jogħġobni ħafna, speċjalment il-kuluri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like the Tibetan style of this room? Pawlu: Yes, I like it a lot, especially the colours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢这个房间的藏式风格吗？保罗：喜欢，我很喜欢，尤其是这些颜色。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jogħġbok l-istil Tibetan ta' din il-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Jogħġbok l-istil Tibetan ta' din il-kamra?
messages.zh: 你喜欢这个房间的藏式风格吗？
messages.en: Do you like the Tibetan style of this room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 喜欢，我很喜欢，尤其是这些颜色。
messages.en: Yes, I like it a lot, especially the colours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Tibetan 与“西藏、藏族、藏文化”连成一组记忆，再用 l-istil Tibetan“藏式风格”巩固形容词的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To consider an action, idea, or behaviour wrong or unacceptable, or to express that judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为某种行为、想法或做法不妥或不可接受，或表达这种不赞同的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqis azzjoni, idea jew imġiba bħala ħażina jew mhux aċċettabbli, jew tesprimi din il-fehma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不赞同；认为某事不妥或不可接受，也可指表达这种反对态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ma taqbilx ma' xi ħaġa għax tqisha ħażina jew mhux xierqa, jew turi li għandek din il-fehma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you disapprove of something, you think it is wrong or unacceptable and may express that opinion.

formal.mt: L-għalliema tiddiżapprova l-użu tat-telefowns waqt il-lezzjoni għax itellef l-attenzjoni tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The teacher disapproves of using phones during the lesson because it distracts the students.
formal.zh: 这位女教师不赞同在课堂上使用手机，因为这会分散学生的注意力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int tiddiżapprova l-idea li mmorru llejla? Lara: Le, imma naħseb li għandna nispiċċaw ix-xogħol l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you disapprove of the idea of us going tonight? Lara: No, but I think we should finish the work first.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你不赞同我们今晚去的想法吗？拉拉：没有，不过我觉得我们应该先把工作做完。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int tiddiżapprova l-idea li mmorru llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Int tiddiżapprova l-idea li mmorru llejla?
messages.zh: 你不赞同我们今晚去的想法吗？
messages.en: Do you disapprove of the idea of us going tonight?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma naħseb li għandna nispiċċaw ix-xogħol l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma naħseb li għandna nispiċċaw ix-xogħol l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 没有，不过我觉得我们应该先把工作做完。
messages.en: No, but I think we should finish the work first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人听完提议后摇头说“不赞同”，再把画面配上 tiddiżapprova l-proposta；用态度和场景一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 词义未明；所给名词释义为“Disided”

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form listed as a noun with the gloss 'Disided', whose meaning cannot be reliably established from the supplied information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料中列为名词、释义写作“Disided”的词形；所给信息不足以可靠确定其具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma elenkata bħala nom bit-tifsira 'Disided', iżda l-informazzjoni pprovduta mhijiex biżżejjed biex it-tifsira tagħha tiġi stabbilita b'mod affidabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原资料给出的名词释义为“Disided”；该释义不足以明确说明此词的含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija għal dan in-nom hija 'Disided', iżda din ma tagħtix biżżejjed informazzjoni biex wieħed jifhem xi tfisser il-forma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This form is listed as a noun, but the supplied gloss 'Disided' does not establish its meaning.

formal.mt: Il-lista tikklassifika l-forma 'Tidecidi' bħala nom u tagħti t-tifsira 'Disided', iżda din l-informazzjoni ma tiċċarax it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The list classifies the form 'Tidecidi' as a noun and gives the gloss 'Disided', but this information does not clarify its meaning.
formal.zh: 词表将“Tidecidi”列为名词，并给出“Disided”这一释义，但这些信息并未明确说明它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'nikteb ħdejn 'Tidecidi' fin-noti tiegħi? Pawlu: Ikteb li l-lista tagħtih bħala nom bit-tifsira 'Disided', u li t-tifsira għadha mhix ċara.
colloquial.en: Nina: What should I write beside 'Tidecidi' in my notes? Pawlu: Write that the list gives it as a noun with the gloss 'Disided', and that its meaning is still unclear.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我该在笔记里的“Tidecidi”旁边写什么？保罗：写上词表将它列为名词，释义是“Disided”，而且词义仍不明确。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 我该在笔记里的“Tidecidi”旁边写什么？
messages.en: What should I write beside 'Tidecidi' in my notes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb li l-lista tagħtih bħala nom bit-tifsira 'Disided', u li t-tifsira għadha mhix ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb li l-lista tagħtih bħala nom bit-tifsira 'Disided', u li t-tifsira għadha mhix ċara.
messages.zh: 写上词表将它列为名词，释义是“Disided”，而且词义仍不明确。
messages.en: Write that the list gives it as a noun with the gloss 'Disided', and that its meaning is still unclear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Tidecidi 制作三栏记忆卡：“词形、名词标签、原释义 Disided”，再标注“词义待核实”，避免凭拼写联想背错。

exact_key: tidjin konġunt għal finijiet ta' garanzija
gloss_zh: 担保目的的共同负债；为提供担保而共同承担债务

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement in which more than one person assumes a debt obligation for the purpose of providing security.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由两人或多人为了提供担保而共同承担债务的安排或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament li fih żewġ persuni jew aktar jassumu flimkien obbligu ta' dejn sabiex jipprovdu garanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为提供担保而由两人或多人共同承担债务的安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni li fiha aktar minn persuna waħda tkun marbuta ma' obbligu ta' dejn għal skop ta' garanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Co-debtorship for security purposes is an arrangement in which people share a debt obligation in order to provide security.

collocations.mt: ftehim dwar tidjin konġunt għal finijiet ta' garanzija
collocations.en: an agreement on co-debtorship for security purposes
collocations.zh: 关于担保目的共同负债的协议

collocations.mt: klawżola dwar tidjin konġunt għal finijiet ta' garanzija
collocations.en: a clause on co-debtorship for security purposes
collocations.zh: 关于担保目的共同负债的条款

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jinkludi klawżola dwar tidjin konġunt għal finijiet ta' garanzija u jiddeskrivi l-obbligi tal-persuni involuti.
formal.en: The agreement includes a clause on co-debtorship for security purposes and describes the obligations of the people involved.
formal.zh: 该协议包含一项关于担保目的共同负债的条款，并说明了有关人员的义务。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfisser 'tidjin konġunt għal finijiet ta' garanzija' hawn? Rita: Ifisser li aktar minn persuna waħda tassumi obbligu ta' dejn biex tipprovdi garanzija.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does 'co-debtorship for security purposes' mean here? Rita: It means that more than one person assumes a debt obligation to provide security.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这里的“担保目的的共同负债”是什么意思？Rita：意思是由不止一个人承担债务，以提供担保。

messages.speaker: Mark (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'tidjin konġunt għal finijiet ta' garanzija' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'tidjin konġunt għal finijiet ta' garanzija' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的“担保目的的共同负债”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'co-debtorship for security purposes' mean here?

messages.speaker: Rita (顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li aktar minn persuna waħda tassumi obbligu ta' dejn biex tipprovdi garanzija.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li aktar minn persuna waħda tassumi obbligu ta' dejn biex tipprovdi garanzija.
messages.zh: 意思是由不止一个人承担债务，以提供担保。
messages.en: It means that more than one person assumes a debt obligation to provide security.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成三个意义块来记：“承担债务—共同承担—为了担保”，再想象几个人共同在协议上签名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causes you to laugh because you find something funny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使你因为觉得某件事有趣或滑稽而发笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġiegħlek tidħaq għax issib xi ħaġa umoristika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使你觉得好笑并笑起来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tqanqal id-daħk fik minħabba xi ħaġa li ssibha umoristika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something makes you laugh, it causes you to laugh because you find it funny.

collocations.en: a joke that makes you laugh
a scene that makes you laugh

formal.mt: Ir-reviżjoni tiddeskrivi xena li tidħaqlek, iżda li fl-istess ħin tqanqal il-ħsieb.
formal.en: The review describes a scene that makes you laugh but also makes you think.
formal.zh: 这篇评论描述了一个既使你发笑、又引人思考的场景。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din ix-xena tidħaqlek? Leon: Iva, kull darba li naraha nibda nidħaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this scene make you laugh? Leon: Yes, every time I watch it, I start laughing.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个场景会逗你笑吗？Leon：会，我每次看都会笑起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个场景会逗你笑吗？
messages.en: Does this scene make you laugh?

messages.speaker: Leon (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull darba li naraha nibda nidħaq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull darba li naraha nibda nidħaq.
messages.zh: 会，我每次看都会笑起来。
messages.en: Yes, every time I watch it, I start laughing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本条给定义项，想象看到喜剧场景后忍不住笑，把整词与“逗你笑”的画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 我的；属于我的；我自己的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate that something belongs to the speaker; the standard Maltese spelling is 'tiegħi'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物属于说话者，即“我的”或“我自己的”；标准马耳他语拼写为“tiegħi”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika li xi ħaġa tappartjeni lill-persuna li qed titkellem; il-kitba standard hija 'tiegħi'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我的；属于我的；我自己的，表示与说话者的所属关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li oġġett jew xi ħaġa oħra tappartjeni lill-persuna li qed titkellem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to say that something belongs to you or is your own.

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rapport nippreżenta l-analiżi tiegħi u nispjega l-konklużjonijiet li wasalt għalihom.
formal.en: In this report, I present my analysis and explain the conclusions I have reached.
formal.zh: 在这份报告中，我介绍自己的分析，并解释我得出的结论。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ktieb tiegħek? Pawlu: Iva, tiegħi. Tista' tissellfu jekk trid.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this book yours? Pawlu: Yes, it's mine. You can borrow it if you want.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这本书是你的吗？Pawlu：是，是我的。你想看的话可以借走。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这本书是你的吗？
messages.en: Is this book yours?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tiegħi. Tista' tissellfu jekk trid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tiegħi. Tista' tissellfu jekk trid.
messages.zh: 是，是我的。你想看的话可以借走。
messages.en: Yes, it's mine. You can borrow it if you want.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象指着自己的书说“我的”：il-ktieb tiegħi。把给定词形 tieghi 与标准拼写 tiegħi 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small flying insect that may land on food or other surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种会飞的小昆虫，常停落在食物或其他物体表面，即苍蝇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett żgħir li jtir u li jista' jinżel fuq l-ikel jew fuq uċuħ oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苍蝇；一种常在食物附近活动的有翅小昆虫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Insett żgħir bil-ġwienaħ li jtir u li spiss jidher qrib l-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fly is a small insect with wings that often lands on food and other surfaces.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tal-kċina, instab tiert fuq il-ħobż u l-ikel ġie mgħotti minnufih.
formal.en: During the kitchen inspection, a fly was found on the bread, and the food was covered immediately.
formal.zh: 检查厨房时，发现面包上有一只苍蝇，工作人员立即把食物盖好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm tiert fuq il-kejk! Toni: Għatti l-kejk, u jien niftaħ it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a fly on the cake! Toni: Cover the cake, and I'll open the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：蛋糕上有只苍蝇！托尼：把蛋糕盖好，我来开窗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 蛋糕上有只苍蝇！
messages.en: There's a fly on the cake!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għatti l-kejk, u jien niftaħ it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Għatti l-kejk, u jien niftaħ it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 把蛋糕盖好，我来开窗。
messages.en: Cover the cake, and I'll open the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiert 放进“苍蝇落在蛋糕上”的画面中，连同 fuq il-kejk 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Looks after someone or something and gives them the attention or practical help they need.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 照顾某人或照料某物，给予所需的关注、帮助或实际处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti l-attenzjoni u l-għajnuna meħtieġa lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa, jew tieħu r-responsabbiltà għalihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 照顾、照料某人或某物，或负责处理有关事务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħares il-bżonnijiet ta' xi ħadd jew ta' xi ħaġa u tagħmel dak li jkun meħtieġ għalihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone takes care of a person or thing, they look after them and attend to their needs.

formal.mt: L-għalliema tieħu ħsieb it-tfal waqt iż-żjara fil-mużew u tiżgura li kulħadd jibqa' mal-grupp.
formal.en: The teacher takes care of the children during the museum visit and makes sure that everyone stays with the group.
formal.zh: 老师在参观博物馆期间照顾孩子们，并确保每个人都跟着队伍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tieħu ħsieb il-qattus tiegħi għada? Nina: Iva, nagħtih l-ikel u niżgura li jkollu l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you take care of my cat tomorrow? Nina: Yes, I'll feed him and make sure he has water.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你明天能照顾一下我的猫吗？Nina：可以，我会喂它，并确保它有水喝。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tieħu ħsieb il-qattus tiegħi għada?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tieħu ħsieb il-qattus tiegħi għada?
messages.zh: 你明天能照顾一下我的猫吗？
messages.en: Can you take care of my cat tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nagħtih l-ikel u niżgura li jkollu l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nagħtih l-ikel u niżgura li jkollu l-ilma.
messages.zh: 可以，我会喂它，并确保它有水喝。
messages.en: Yes, I'll feed him and make sure he has water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tieħu ħsieb 整体记成“照顾”：想象给猫添粮添水，再替换成孩子、植物，练习不同照料对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A child who is female.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 女性儿童，即女孩或女童。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ta' sess femminili li għadha fl-età tat-tfulija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女孩；尚处于儿童阶段的女性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna ta' sess femminili li għadha żgħira u li għadha ma saritx adulta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A female child is a girl who has not yet reached adulthood.

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tal-attività, tifal ta' sitt snin qrat storja qasira quddiem il-klassi.
formal.en: At the beginning of the activity, a six-year-old girl read a short story to the class.
formal.zh: 活动开始时，一名六岁的女孩向全班朗读了一篇短篇故事。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hi dik it-tifal ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Dik oħti ż-żgħira; għandha sitt snin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that girl by the door? Mark: That's my little sister; she's six.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：门边那个女孩是谁？马克：那是我妹妹，她六岁。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hi dik it-tifal ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hi dik it-tifal ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门边那个女孩是谁？
messages.en: Who is that girl by the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik oħti ż-żgħira; għandha sitt snin.
messages.mt_standard: Dik oħti ż-żgħira; għandha sitt snin.
messages.zh: 那是我妹妹，她六岁。
messages.en: That's my little sister; she's six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifal 与“六岁的小女孩”配成词卡，用年龄和上学场景强化“女童”的含义。

gloss_zh: 少女感十足的；俏皮甜美的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a playful, distinctly feminine style or manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容风格或举止富有少女感，显得俏皮、甜美而女性化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu stil jew imġiba b'dehra femminili, ferrieħa u mimlija ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 少女感十足的；带有俏皮、甜美和鲜明女性化气质的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri stil femminili u ferrieħi permezz tad-dehra, tal-ilbies jew tal-imġiba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a look or manner is girly pop, it has a playful and distinctly feminine character.

formal.mt: Id-disinjatriċi għażlet stil tifla pop għall-kollezzjoni, b'kuluri roża u aċċessorji ferrieħa.
formal.en: The designer chose a girly pop style for the collection, using pink shades and playful accessories.
formal.zh: 设计师为这一系列选择了俏皮甜美的少女风格，采用粉色色调和活泼的配饰。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Irrid dehra tifla pop għall-festa. Sara: Mela ilbes id-dublett roża u żid żigarella ma' xagħrek!
colloquial.en: Nina: I want a girly pop look for the party. Sara: Then wear the pink skirt and put a ribbon in your hair!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我想以甜美少女风的造型去参加派对。萨拉：那就穿粉色裙子，再在头发上系条丝带！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想以甜美少女风的造型去参加派对。
messages.en: I want a girly pop look for the party.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ilbes id-dublett roża u żid żigarella ma' xagħrek!
messages.mt_standard: Mela ilbes id-dublett roża u żid żigarella ma' xagħrek!
messages.zh: 那就穿粉色裙子，再在头发上系条丝带！
messages.en: Then wear the pink skirt and put a ribbon in your hair!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“粉色裙子配丝带”的造型记住 tifla pop，把整个短语作为描述少女风格的形容词来练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A powerful tropical storm in the northwestern Pacific Ocean, with very strong winds and heavy rain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生于西北太平洋的强烈热带风暴，伴有猛烈风力和大量降雨，即台风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maltempata tropikali qawwija fil-Majjistral tal-Oċean Paċifiku, b'riħ vjolenti u xita qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 台风；西北太平洋地区伴有强风和暴雨的强烈热带气旋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċiklun tropikali qawwi li jseħħ fil-Majjistral tal-Oċean Paċifiku u li jġib miegħu riħ vjolenti u ħafna xita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A typhoon is a powerful tropical storm in the northwestern Pacific that brings violent winds and heavy rain.

formal.mt: L-awtoritajiet ħarġu twissija dwar tifun u talbu lir-residenti jibqgħu ġewwa sakemm jgħaddi l-periklu.
formal.en: The authorities issued a typhoon warning and asked residents to remain indoors until the danger had passed.
formal.zh: 当局发布了台风警报，并要求居民留在室内，直到危险解除。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt li ġej tifun? Toni: Iva, ejja ndaħħlu s-siġġijiet tal-gallarija qabel jibda r-riħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you heard that a typhoon is coming? Toni: Yes, let's bring the balcony chairs inside before the wind starts.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听说台风要来了吗？托尼：听说了，趁还没起风，我们把阳台上的椅子搬进来吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你听说台风要来了吗？
messages.en: Have you heard that a typhoon is coming?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja ndaħħlu s-siġġijiet tal-gallarija qabel jibda r-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja ndaħħlu s-siġġijiet tal-gallarija qabel jibda r-riħ.
messages.zh: 听说了，趁还没起风，我们把阳台上的椅子搬进来吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's bring the balcony chairs inside before the wind starts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifun 和英语 typhoon 配对朗读，再联想“台风来前收好阳台椅子”的场景巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Domestic chickens considered as more than one bird or as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 多只家养的鸡，或作为一个群体所说的鸡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasafar domestiċi li jitrabbew għall-bajd jew għal-laħam, meqjusa bħala aktar minn wieħed jew bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸡的复数，指多只通常为获取蛋或肉而饲养的家禽。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aktar minn għasfur domestiku wieħed tat-tip li jitrabba għall-bajd jew għal-laħam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Chickens are domestic birds that people commonly raise for their eggs or meat.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tigieg fir-razzett u rreġistraw kif kienu jfittxu l-ikel.
formal.en: The students observed the chickens on the farm and recorded how they searched for food.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了农场里的鸡，并记录了它们如何觅食。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn huma t-tigieg? Ġużeppi: Qegħdin fil-bitħa. Se nagħtihom l-ilma u l-għalf issa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where are the chickens? Ġużeppi: They're in the yard. I'm going to give them water and feed now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：鸡都在哪里？朱塞佩：它们在院子里。我现在就去给它们添水和饲料。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场主)
messages.zh: 鸡都在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the chickens?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Qegħdin fil-bitħa. Se nagħtihom l-ilma u l-għalf issa.
messages.mt_standard: Qegħdin fil-bitħa. Se nagħtihom l-ilma u l-għalf issa.
messages.zh: 它们在院子里。我现在就去给它们添水和饲料。
messages.en: They're in the yard. I'm going to give them water and feed now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tigieg 对应到院子里多只鸡一起啄食的画面，记住英语要用 chickens；再用“一只鸡”和“一群鸡”的数量对比巩固复数意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Getting or obtaining something that a person wants or needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 取得或获得某人想要或需要的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tikseb xi ħaġa li tkun trid jew li jkollok bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 取得或得到所需的东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tikseb xi ħaġa li tkun trid jew li jkollok bżonn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Getting something means succeeding in acquiring what you want or need.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过行动或安排获得某物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tikseb xi ħaġa permezz ta' azzjoni jew arranġament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you obtain something, you succeed in getting it through some action or arrangement.

formal.mt: Marta tikkapparra post fil-kors ta' filgħodu biex tkun tista' tistudja qabel tmur għax-xogħol.
formal.en: Marta secures a place on the morning course so that she can study before going to work.
formal.zh: 玛尔塔取得了上午课程的一个名额，这样她就能在上班前学习。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se tikkapparra post għall-kors? Mark: Iva, se nċempel illum biex nara jekk għadx hemm post.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you going to secure a place on the course? Mark: Yes, I'll call today to see whether there's still a place available.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你打算争取一个课程名额吗？马克：是的，我今天会打电话，看看还有没有名额。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算争取一个课程名额吗？
messages.en: Are you going to secure a place on the course?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nċempel illum biex nara jekk għadx hemm post.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nċempel illum biex nara jekk għadx hemm post.
messages.zh: 是的，我今天会打电话，看看还有没有名额。
messages.en: Yes, I'll call today to see whether there's still a place available.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“取得课程名额”的画面中记忆：从想参加，到终于得到一个位置，抓住“取得、获得”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of paper, fabric, or other material attached to something to identify it or provide information about it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 附在物品上的纸片、布片或其他材料，用来标明名称、内容或使用说明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa karta, drapp jew materjal ieħor imwaħħla ma' oġġett biex turi x'inhu jew tagħti informazzjoni dwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贴附或缝在物品上、用于识别或提供相关信息的标签。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa materjal imwaħħla ma' oġġett li ġġorr isem, deskrizzjoni jew istruzzjonijiet dwar dak l-oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A label is a piece of material attached to an object that identifies it or gives information about it.

formal.mt: Qabel taħsel il-flokk, aqra t-tikketta biex tkun taf liema temperatura tal-ilma għandek tuża.
formal.en: Before washing the T-shirt, read the label to find out what water temperature to use.
formal.zh: 清洗这件T恤前，请阅读标签，了解应使用的水温。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm jiswa dan il-flokk? Pawlu: Ħares lejn it-tikketta; il-prezz hemm miktub fuqha.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much does this T-shirt cost? Pawlu: Look at the label; the price is written on it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这件T恤多少钱？保罗：看看标签，价格就写在上面。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件T恤多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this T-shirt cost?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn it-tikketta; il-prezz hemm miktub fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn it-tikketta; il-prezz hemm miktub fuqha.
messages.zh: 看看标签，价格就写在上面。
messages.en: Look at the label; the price is written on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象购物时翻看衣服上的小标签，把 tikketta 和“查价格、看洗涤说明”的动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A line or fold left in material, especially fabric or paper, after it has been folded or pressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布料或纸张等材料因折叠、挤压而留下的一道折痕或褶皱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Linja jew tinja li tibqa' f'materjal, speċjalment drapp jew karta, wara li jkun intlewa jew ingħafas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衣物、纸张等被折叠或压挤后留下的折痕或皱褶。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marka f'għamla ta' linja jew tinja fuq drapp, karta jew materjal ieħor minħabba li jkun intlewa jew ingħafas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A crease is a line or fold in material that remains after the material has been folded or pressed.

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, neħħi t-tikmixa mill-qmis bil-ħadida tal-mogħdija.
formal.en: Before the meeting, remove the crease from the shirt with an iron.
formal.zh: 开会前，用熨斗把衬衫上的那道褶皱熨平。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi tikmixa fil-qmis. Tidher ħafna? Lara: Iva, imma bil-mogħdija titlaq.
colloquial.en: Nina: There's a crease in my shirt. Is it very noticeable? Lara: Yes, but ironing will get rid of it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我的衬衫上有一道褶皱，很明显吗？拉拉：是的，不过熨一下就能去掉。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的衬衫上有一道褶皱，很明显吗？
messages.en: There's a crease in my shirt. Is it very noticeable?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，不过熨一下就能去掉。
messages.en: Yes, but ironing will get rid of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把一张纸对折，再展开观察留下的一道线；把这道“折痕”和 tikmixa 联系起来，也可联想衬衫上的褶皱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The power or ability to direct someone's behaviour or determine how something operates.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支配他人行为或决定某事物如何运行的权力或能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-setgħa jew il-ħila li tidderieġi l-imġiba ta' persuna jew tiddetermina kif taħdem xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对人的行为或事物的运作进行支配、指挥或约束的权力或能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-setgħa jew il-kapaċità li tmexxi, tidderieġi jew tillimita l-imġiba ta' persuna jew il-mod kif taħdem xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Control is the power or ability to direct a person's behaviour or determine how something works.

collocations.zh: 控制我做的每一个决定

formal.mt: Meta tipprova tikontrollani f'kull deċiżjoni, tillimita l-ħila tiegħi li naħdem b'mod indipendenti.
formal.en: When you try to control every decision I make, you limit my ability to work independently.
formal.zh: 当你试图控制我做的每一个决定时，你就限制了我独立工作的能力。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex tipprova tikontrollani? Nista' nagħżel waħdi. Sara: Ridt ngħinek, imma għandek raġun. Id-deċiżjoni tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are you trying to control me? I can choose for myself. Sara: I wanted to help, but you're right. It's your decision.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么想控制我？我可以自己选择。萨拉：我本来想帮你，不过你说得对。这件事由你决定。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tipprova tikontrollani? Nista' nagħżel waħdi.
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tipprova tikontrollani? Nista' nagħżel waħdi.
messages.zh: 你为什么想控制我？我可以自己选择。
messages.en: Why are you trying to control me? I can choose for myself.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ridt ngħinek, imma għandek raġun. Id-deċiżjoni tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Ridt ngħinek, imma għandek raġun. Id-deċiżjoni tiegħek.
messages.zh: 我本来想帮你，不过你说得对。这件事由你决定。
messages.en: I wanted to help, but you're right. It's your decision.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“别人替我决定一切”的场景记住控制之意，再把“我可以自己选择”的回应连起来练习，帮助理解人与人之间的支配关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose one's way or stray from the intended route.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去方向，或走离原本应当遵循的路线；所给短语表示“他迷路了”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jibqax jaf minn fejn għandu jgħaddi jew jitbiegħed mir-rotta maħsuba; il-frażi mogħtija tesprimi din l-azzjoni fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迷失方向或偏离原本应走的路线。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jitbiegħed mit-triq li kellu jieħu jew ma jibqax jaf kif jasal fid-destinazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone strays, they move away from the route they intended to follow.

collocations.en: lost his way in the woods

formal.mt: Matul il-mixja, il-grupp tilef it-triq u kellu juża mappa biex jerġa' jsib ir-rotta.
formal.en: During the walk, the group lost its way and had to use a map to find the route again.
formal.zh: 步行途中，队伍迷了路，只好借助地图重新找到路线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark għadu ma wasalx? Lara: Tilef it-triq, imma bgħattlu l-post fejn qegħdin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why hasn't Mark arrived yet? Lara: He lost his way, but I sent him our location.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么还没到？拉拉：他迷路了，不过我已经把我们的位置发给他了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么还没到？
messages.en: Why hasn't Mark arrived yet?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tilef it-triq, imma bgħattlu l-post fejn qegħdin.
messages.mt_standard: Tilef it-triq, imma bgħattlu l-post fejn qegħdin.
messages.zh: 他迷路了，不过我已经把我们的位置发给他了。
messages.en: He lost his way, but I sent him our location.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“走着走着找不到路”的画面绑定记忆：tilef it-triq，就是“他迷路了”。

gloss_zh: 上来；被拉动；上去（依所给义项及语境区分）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move upwards or come up; also supplied with the context-dependent meaning 'drawn'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示向上移动、上来或上去；材料还列出 drawn，其具体所指需要结合语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tesprimi moviment minn post aktar baxx għal wieħed aktar għoli; tingħata wkoll it-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa miġbuda, li trid tinftiehem mill-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上来；被拉动。所给 drawn 缺少具体语境，其确切含义尚不能确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa tkun tielgħa, jew li xi ħaġa tkun miġbuda; it-tifsira preċiża tiddependi mill-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This sense describes something coming up or being drawn, with the precise action depending on its context.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从较低的位置向较高的位置移动；上去。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tmur minn post jew livell aktar baxx għal post jew livell aktar għoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone goes up, they move from a lower position to a higher one.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-verb 'tilgħin' jirreferi għal moviment minn livell aktar baxx għal wieħed aktar għoli.
formal.en: In this exercise, the verb 'tilgħin' refers to movement from a lower level to a higher one.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，动词 tilgħin 指从较低处向较高处移动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'tilgħin' hawn? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser li tmur 'il fuq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tilgħin' mean here? Pawlu: Here it means to go up.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 tilgħin 是什么意思？保罗：这里是“上去”的意思。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 tilgħin 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tilgħin' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 这里是“上去”的意思。
messages.en: Here it means to go up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用一个向上的箭头记住“上去、上来”，再给 drawn 单独留一张语境卡；不要把缺少语境的译义硬合成一个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A worker who repairs damaged metal panels on vehicle bodies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 修复车辆金属车身板件凹陷、弯曲等损伤的工人，即汽车钣金修理工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddiem li jsewwi l-pannelli tal-metall tal-karozzerija ta' vettura meta jkunu mgħawġa jew bil-ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汽车钣金修理工；负责修复受损或变形的车身金属板件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna tas-sengħa li tirranġa pannelli tal-metall bil-ħsara fil-karozzerija ta' karozza jew vettura oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A panel beater is a skilled worker who repairs damaged metal panels on vehicles.

formal.mt: Wara l-ħabta, it-tillgħar irranġa l-pannell tal-bieba li kien mgħawweġ.
formal.en: After the collision, the panel beater repaired the bent door panel.
formal.zh: 碰撞后，钣金修理工修复了变形的车门板件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-bieba tal-karozza għandha daqqa. Lil min nieħuha? Lara: Ħudha għand tillgħar; jista' jirranġalek il-pannell.
colloquial.en: Mark: The car door has a dent. Who should I take it to? Lara: Take it to a panel beater; he can repair the panel for you.
colloquial.zh: 马克：车门凹了一块，我该找谁修？拉拉：找钣金修理工吧，他能帮你修好那块板件。

messages.speaker: Mark (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bieba tal-karozza għandha daqqa. Lil min nieħuha?
messages.mt_standard: Il-bieba tal-karozza għandha daqqa. Lil min nieħuha?
messages.zh: 车门凹了一块，我该找谁修？
messages.en: The car door has a dent. Who should I take it to?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħudha għand tillgħar; jista' jirranġalek il-pannell.
messages.mt_standard: Ħudha għand tillgħar; jista' jirranġalek il-pannell.
messages.zh: 找钣金修理工吧，他能帮你修好那块板件。
messages.en: Take it to a panel beater; he can repair the panel for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tillgħar，就想象一位师傅把凹陷的车门板件修平；用“受损车门加修理师傅”的画面记住职业含义。

gloss_zh: 含义待确认的名词（所给释义为 lov3）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun supplied with the unexplained label 'lov3'; its meaning cannot be established from the packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料将其列为名词，但仅提供未解释的标签 lov3，因此无法据此确定具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li fil-materjal mogħti għandu biss it-tikketta 'lov3', mingħajr spjegazzjoni biżżejjed biex tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原材料仅给出 lov3，含义不明，不能据此确定中文对应词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tikketta 'lov3' mhijiex spjegata fil-materjal mogħti, għalhekk ma tistax tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira ta' dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied label 'lov3' does not provide enough information to establish what this noun means.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'tiloipi' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda t-tikketta 'lov3' ma tippermettix li tiġi stabbilita tifsira preċiża.
formal.en: The word 'tiloipi' is listed as a noun, but the label 'lov3' does not allow a precise meaning to be established.
formal.zh: tiloipi 被列为名词，但标签 lov3 不足以确定其准确含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'tiloipi'? Pawlu: Fil-lista hemm biss 'lov3'; għandna bżonn aktar tagħrif biex inkunu nafu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tiloipi' mean? Pawlu: The list only gives 'lov3'; we need more information to know.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：tiloipi 是什么意思？保罗：词表里只有 lov3；还需要更多信息才能确定。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: tiloipi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tiloipi' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-lista hemm biss 'lov3'; għandna bżonn aktar tagħrif biex inkunu nafu.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-lista hemm biss 'lov3'; għandna bżonn aktar tagħrif biex inkunu nafu.
messages.zh: 词表里只有 lov3；还需要更多信息才能确定。
messages.en: The list only gives 'lov3'; we need more information to know.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tiloipi 的学习卡画一个问号，写上“名词，lov3 待释”；先记住信息边界，不凭标签的字形猜测词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short argument between people, usually about something relatively unimportant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人与人之间通常因小事而发生的口角或争吵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Argument qasir bejn persuni, ġeneralment dwar xi ħaġa ta' ftit importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常因琐事而起的口角或小争吵。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tilwima hija argument bejn persuni li ma jaqblux dwar xi ħaġa, ħafna drabi ta' ftit importanza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A squabble is an argument between people, usually about something that is not very important.

formal.mt: L-għalliema temmet it-tilwima bejn iż-żewġ studenti u talbithom jitkellmu bil-kalma.
formal.en: The teacher ended the squabble between the two students and asked them to speak calmly.
formal.zh: 老师制止了两名学生之间的口角，并请他们平静地交谈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kien hemm tilwima bejnek u bejn Pawlu? Lara: Għax it-tnejn ridna l-istess siġġu, imma issa rranġajna kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was there a squabble between you and Pawlu? Lara: Because we both wanted the same chair, but we have sorted everything out now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你和保罗为什么吵起来了？拉拉：因为我们都想坐同一把椅子，不过现在已经说好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kien hemm tilwima bejnek u bejn Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kien hemm tilwima bejnek u bejn Pawlu?
messages.zh: 你和保罗为什么吵起来了？
messages.en: Why was there a squabble between you and Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax it-tnejn ridna l-istess siġġu, imma issa rranġajna kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Għax it-tnejn ridna l-istess siġġu, imma issa rranġajna kollox.
messages.zh: 因为我们都想坐同一把椅子，不过现在已经说好了。
messages.en: Because we both wanted the same chair, but we have sorted everything out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tilwima 和“两人为一把椅子拌嘴”的画面绑定，记住这里侧重因小事发生的口角。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dispute involving people, organizations, or issues connected with more than one country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及不同国家的个人、组织或相关事项的跨境争议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' qbil li jinvolvi persuni, organizzazzjonijiet jew kwistjonijiet marbuta ma' aktar minn pajjiż wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及国界两侧或不同国家的当事人、活动或事项的争议或纠纷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tilwima transfruntiera hija nuqqas ta' qbil li jinvolvi partijiet jew kwistjonijiet f'pajjiżi differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cross-border dispute is a disagreement involving parties or matters connected with different countries.

collocations.en: a solution to a cross-border dispute
a cross-border dispute between two companies
collocations.zh: 两家公司之间的跨境纠纷

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ kumpaniji, li jinsabu f'pajjiżi differenti, qablu li jippruvaw isolvu t-tilwima transfruntiera permezz ta' medjazzjoni.
formal.en: The two companies, which are based in different countries, agreed to try to resolve the cross-border dispute through mediation.
formal.zh: 这两家位于不同国家的公司同意尝试通过调解解决跨境纠纷。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed isejħulha tilwima transfruntiera? Sara: Għax il-klijent u l-kumpanija jinsabu f'pajjiżi differenti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are they calling it a cross-border dispute? Sara: Because the customer and the company are in different countries.
colloquial.zh: 马克：他们为什么把这叫作跨境纠纷？萨拉：因为客户和公司位于不同的国家。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 他们为什么把这叫作跨境纠纷？
messages.en: Why are they calling it a cross-border dispute?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-klijent u l-kumpanija jinsabu f'pajjiżi differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-klijent u l-kumpanija jinsabu f'pajjiżi differenti.
messages.zh: 因为客户和公司位于不同的国家。
messages.en: Because the customer and the company are in different countries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上两个国家的当事人发生纠纷，把整个短语与“争议跨过国界”的画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people who work together or play a sport together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 共同完成工作或一起参加体育运动的一组人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' persuni li jaħdmu flimkien jew jilagħbu sport flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为共同任务、目标或体育比赛而一起行动的团队或队伍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tim huwa grupp ta' persuni li jikkollaboraw biex iwettqu xogħol jew li jilagħbu flimkien f'attività sportiva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A team is a group of people who work together or take part in a sport together.

formal.mt: It-tim ta' riċerka se jippreżenta r-riżultati tal-istudju waqt il-laqgħa ta' nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The research team will present the study results at Friday's meeting.
formal.zh: 研究团队将在星期五的会议上介绍研究结果。

colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你想加入我们队，参加星期六的比赛吗？保罗：好啊，我来！我们在哪里碰面？

messages.en: Yes, I'll come! Where shall we meet?

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used to put an official mark on a document, or the mark it leaves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在文件上盖出正式标记的印章，也可指盖出的印记。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex titqiegħed marka uffiċjali fuq dokument, jew il-marka li tħalli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于在文件等物品上盖印的印章，或由印章留下的印记。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda li tagħmel marka fuq dokument jew oġġett ieħor, jew il-marka magħmula b'din l-għodda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stamp is a tool that prints a mark on something, or the mark produced by that tool.

collocations.en: put a stamp on the document

formal.mt: Qabel ma jintbagħat id-dokument, għandu jitqiegħed it-timbru tal-kumpanija ħdejn il-firma.
formal.en: Before the document is sent, the company stamp should be placed next to the signature.
formal.zh: 文件寄出之前，应在签名旁盖上公司印章。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu t-timbru? Għandi bżonnu għal din il-formola. Mark: Fil-kexxun, ħdejn il-pinen.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the stamp? I need it for this form. Mark: In the drawer, next to the pens.
colloquial.zh: Lara：印章在哪里？这张表格要用。Mark：在抽屉里，笔的旁边。

gloss_zh: 分时度假使用权；分时共享度假安排

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement giving different people the right to use the same holiday accommodation at different times.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由不同的人在不同时间使用同一度假住所的安排，也可指其中个人拥有的使用权。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament li jagħti lil persuni differenti d-dritt li jużaw l-istess akkomodazzjoni għall-vaganzi fi żminijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多人分别在约定时段使用同一度假住所的制度，或个人在该制度下取得的分时使用权。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li fiha diversi persuni jkollhom id-dritt jużaw l-istess akkomodazzjoni għall-vaganzi matul perjodi differenti, jew id-dritt ta' persuna f'din is-sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A timeshare is an arrangement in which several people have the right to use the same holiday accommodation during different periods.

collocations.zh: 采用分时共享安排的度假住所

formal.mt: Il-ftehim ta' timeshare jispeċifika l-ġimgħat li fihom il-familja tista' tuża l-appartament għall-vaganzi.
formal.en: The timeshare agreement specifies the weeks during which the family may use the holiday apartment.
formal.zh: 分时度假协议列明了该家庭可以使用度假公寓的具体周次。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tmorru fl-istess appartament kull sena? David: Għandna timeshare hemmhekk u nużawh għal ġimagħtejn fis-sajf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you go to the same apartment every year? David: We have a timeshare there and use it for two weeks in summer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们为什么每年都去同一套公寓？David：我们在那里有分时度假使用权，夏天会住两个星期。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tmorru fl-istess appartament kull sena?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tmorru fl-istess appartament kull sena?

teaching_sense.en_definition: Shy or easily frightened, especially when facing unfamiliar people or situations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对不熟悉的人或情境时容易紧张、缺乏自信或不敢主动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħossu mistħi jew jibża' malajr u ma jkollux kunfidenza, speċjalment ma' nies li ma jafx jew f'sitwazzjonijiet ġodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胆怯或羞怯的，常因紧张、害怕或缺乏自信而不敢说话或行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun mistħi jew nieqes mill-kunfidenza u għalhekk joqgħod lura milli jitkellem jew jaġixxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is timid feels shy or nervous and may be afraid to speak or act confidently.

formal.mt: L-istudent kien timidu fil-bidu tas-sena, iżda gradwalment beda jieħu sehem fid-diskussjonijiet tal-klassi.
formal.en: The student was timid at the beginning of the year, but gradually began to take part in class discussions.
formal.zh: 这名学生在学年开始时很羞怯，但后来逐渐开始参与课堂讨论。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma tkellimtx waqt il-laqgħa? Pawlu: Jien xi ftit timidu meta ma nkun naf lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why didn't you speak during the meeting? Pawlu: I'm a little timid when I don't know anyone.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你开会时怎么没说话？Pawlu：周围一个人都不认识的时候，我会有点胆怯。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你开会时怎么没说话？
messages.en: Why didn't you speak during the meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)

messages.mt_standard: Jien xi ftit timidu meta ma nkun naf lil ħadd.
