teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of pouring liquid into a container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把液体倒进容器的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha likwidu jitferra' f'reċipjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倒；使液体流入容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li titfa' likwidu f'reċipjent billi tħallih joħroġ minn reċipjent ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you pour a liquid, you make it flow from one container into another.

collocations.en: pour water into the glass to fill it
collocations.zh: 往杯子里倒水，把它倒满

collocations.en: pour milk into the jug to fill it
collocations.zh: 往壶里倒牛奶，把它倒满

formal.mt: Qabel l-ikla, Marija timla t-tazzi bl-ilma u tqegħedhom fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: Before the meal, Marija pours water into the glasses to fill them and places them on the table.
formal.zh: 用餐前，玛丽娅往杯子里倒满水，再把杯子放到桌上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' timla t-tazza tiegħi bl-ilma? Nina: Iva, nagħmillek issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you fill my glass with water? Nina: Yes, I'll do it for you now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你能给我的杯子倒满水吗？妮娜：可以，我现在就给你倒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aromatic herb whose small leaves are used to flavour food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 百里香，一种叶片细小、常用于给食物调味的芳香草本植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta aromatika b'weraq żgħir li jintuża biex jagħti t-togħma lill-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 百里香；叶片可作烹饪调味料的芳香草本植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta aromatika li l-weraq żgħir tagħha jintuża frisk jew imnixxef biex jagħti t-togħma lill-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Thyme is an aromatic herb whose small leaves are used fresh or dried to flavour food.

formal.mt: Żid ftit timu frisk mas-soppa fl-aħħar tat-tisjir.
formal.en: Add a little fresh thyme to the soup at the end of cooking.
formal.zh: 在烹煮结束时，往汤里加入少许新鲜百里香。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandna timu għas-soppa? Rita: Iva, hemm ftit timu frisk fil-friġġ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do we have thyme for the soup? Rita: Yes, there's some fresh thyme in the fridge.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们有煮汤用的百里香吗？丽塔：有，冰箱里有一些新鲜百里香。

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.zh: 我们有煮汤用的百里香吗？
messages.en: Do we have thyme for the soup?

messages.speaker: Rita (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ftit timu frisk fil-friġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ftit timu frisk fil-friġġ.
messages.zh: 有，冰箱里有一些新鲜百里香。
messages.en: Yes, there's some fresh thyme in the fridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往热汤里撒百里香叶的香气，把 timu 与“百里香调汤”这个厨房画面绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single fig, a soft fruit containing many small seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一颗无花果，果肉柔软，内部含有许多细小的籽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta waħda tat-tin, b'ġewwieni artab u ħafna żrieragħ żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无花果；此处指单个果实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frotta waħda tat-tin li jkollha ġewwieni artab b'ħafna żrieragħ żgħar u li tkun ħelwa meta timmatura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fig is a soft fruit containing many small seeds and usually tasting sweet when ripe.

formal.mt: Aħsel tina misjura, aqtagħha fi tnejn u serviha mal-jogurt.
formal.en: Wash a ripe fig, cut it in half, and serve it with yoghurt.
formal.zh: 洗净一颗熟无花果，把它切成两半，配酸奶食用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tina? Pawlu: Iva, grazzi. Dik tidher misjura ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a fig? Pawlu: Yes, thanks. That one looks very ripe.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想吃一颗无花果吗？保罗：想，谢谢。那颗看起来熟透了。

messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Dik tidher misjura ħafna.
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。那颗看起来熟透了。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. That one looks very ripe.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb form used in a negative construction to say that a seed or plant does not sprout.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于否定结构的动词形式，表示种子或植物不发芽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' verb li tintuża f'kostruzzjoni negattiva biex tgħid li żerriegħa jew pjanta ma tibdiex toħroġ rimja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不发芽；指种子或植物没有长出新芽。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tesprimi li żerriegħa jew pjanta ma tibdiex tikber billi toħroġ rimja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If seeds do not sprout, they do not begin to grow by producing new shoots.

collocations.en: it does not sprout in the cold
collocations.zh: 它在寒冷环境中不发芽

collocations.en: it does not sprout without water

formal.mt: Jekk iż-żerriegħa ma tinbitx, iċċekkja jekk il-ħamrija hijiex niedja biżżejjed.
formal.en: If the seed does not sprout, check whether the soil is moist enough.
formal.zh: 如果种子不发芽，检查土壤是否足够湿润。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din iż-żerriegħa għadha ma nibtitx. X'nagħmel jekk ma tinbitx? Toni: Iċċekkja l-ħamrija. Forsi għandha bżonn ftit ilma.
colloquial.en: Sara: This seed hasn't sprouted yet. What should I do if it doesn't sprout? Toni: Check the soil. Perhaps it needs a little water.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这颗种子还没发芽。如果它不发芽，我该怎么办？托尼：检查一下土壤。它可能需要一点水。

messages.mt_standard: Iċċekkja l-ħamrija. Forsi għandha bżonn ftit ilma.
messages.zh: 检查一下土壤。它可能需要一点水。
messages.en: Check the soil. Perhaps it needs a little water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花盆里迟迟没有冒出小芽，整组记住 ma tinbitx 表示“不发芽”，把否定意思和画面联系起来。

gloss_zh: 词义未明确；材料仅列出对应形式 Tindahhalix

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form classified as a noun in the supplied material, which gives only the corresponding form Tindahhalix without explaining its meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料标为名词的形式；材料仅提供对应形式 Tindahhalix，未说明具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma kklassifikata bħala nom fil-materjal mogħti, li jagħti biss il-forma korrispondenti Tindahhalix mingħajr ma jispjega t-tifsira tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 材料仅给出对应形式 Tindahhalix，未提供可确定的中文词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal jagħti biss il-forma korrispondenti Tindahhalix u ma jipprovdix definizzjoni li tiċċara t-tifsira tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry gives Tindahhalix as a corresponding form but does not explain what it means.

formal.mt: Il-materjal jikklassifika 'tindahallix' bħala nom u jagħti l-forma Tindahhalix, iżda ma jispjegax it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The material classifies 'tindahallix' as a noun and gives the form Tindahhalix, but it does not explain its meaning.
formal.zh: 材料将“tindahallix”归为名词，并列出形式 Tindahhalix，但没有解释其词义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'tindahallix' hawn? Mark: Ma nafux minn dan il-materjal; hemm biss il-forma Tindahhalix.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tindahallix' mean here? Mark: We cannot tell from this material; it only gives the form Tindahhalix.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的“tindahallix”是什么意思？Mark：根据这份材料还无法确定；这里只列出了形式 Tindahhalix。

gloss_zh: 词义未明确；材料仅标注 Maltese（马耳他语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form classified as a verb in the supplied material, whose English field says Maltese without specifying an action or meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料标为动词的形式；其英文释义栏仅写 Maltese（马耳他语），没有说明该动词表示什么动作或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma kklassifikata bħala verb fil-materjal mogħti, iżda l-qasam bl-Ingliż jgħid biss Maltese u ma jispjegax l-azzjoni jew l-istat li tesprimi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义为 Maltese（马耳他语）；这一语言名称未能说明 tinfagar 的具体动词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma Maltese fil-qasam tat-tifsira tindika l-lingwa Maltija, iżda ma tagħtix it-tifsira speċifika tal-verb tinfagar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry identifies Maltese but does not explain which action or state this verb expresses.

formal.mt: Il-forma 'tinfagar' hija mniżżla bħala verb, iżda l-kelma Maltese fil-qasam tat-tifsira ma tispjegax x'azzjoni jew stat tesprimi.
formal.en: The form 'tinfagar' is listed as a verb, but Maltese in the definition field does not explain which action or state it expresses.
formal.zh: “tinfagar”这一形式被列为动词，但释义栏中的 Maltese 没有说明它表示什么动作或状态。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawn miktub Maltese ħdejn 'tinfagar'. Dik hi t-tifsira? Pawlu: Dik tindika l-lingwa; ma tgħidilniex xi jfisser il-verb.
colloquial.en: Lara: It says Maltese next to 'tinfagar' here. Is that the meaning? Pawlu: That identifies the language; it does not tell us what the verb means.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里在“tinfagar”旁边写着 Maltese。这就是词义吗？Pawlu：那表示语言名称，没有告诉我们这个动词是什么意思。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub Maltese ħdejn 'tinfagar'. Dik hi t-tifsira?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub Maltese ħdejn 'tinfagar'. Dik hi t-tifsira?
messages.zh: 这里在“tinfagar”旁边写着 Maltese。这就是词义吗？
messages.en: It says Maltese next to 'tinfagar' here. Is that the meaning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik tindika l-lingwa; ma tgħidilniex xi jfisser il-verb.
messages.mt_standard: Dik tindika l-lingwa; ma tgħidilniex xi jfisser il-verb.
messages.zh: 那表示语言名称，没有告诉我们这个动词是什么意思。
messages.en: That identifies the language; it does not tell us what the verb means.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tinfagar 暂存为“动词、词义待补”；看到 Maltese 时提醒自己：语言标签不能代替动作含义，先不建立猜测性的中文联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given something, with you as the person who receives it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示你是接受者，有人将某物给予你，可根据语境译为“你被给予”或“你获给”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tesprimi li int tirċievi xi ħaġa li xi ħadd jagħtik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你被给予某物；你获给某物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li xi ħadd jagħtik xi ħaġa u li int tkun il-persuna li tirċeviha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are given something, another person provides it to you and you receive it.

formal.mt: Meta tlesti r-reġistrazzjoni, int tingħata kopja tad-dokument biex iżżommha.
formal.en: When you complete registration, you are given a copy of the document to keep.
formal.zh: 完成登记后，你会获给一份文件副本留存。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jekk ma nifhimx l-eżerċizzju, nista' nitlob l-għajnuna? Mark: Iva, tingħata l-għajnuna. Staqsi lill-għalliem.
colloquial.en: Maja: If I do not understand the exercise, can I ask for help? Mark: Yes, you will be given help. Ask the teacher.
colloquial.zh: Maja：如果我不明白这道练习，可以请求帮助吗？Mark：可以，你会得到帮助的。问老师吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk ma nifhimx l-eżerċizzju, nista' nitlob l-għajnuna?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk ma nifhimx l-eżerċizzju, nista' nitlob l-għajnuna?
messages.zh: 如果我不明白这道练习，可以请求帮助吗？
messages.en: If I do not understand the exercise, can I ask for help?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 可以，你会得到帮助的。问老师吧。
messages.en: Yes, you will be given help. Ask the teacher.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师把一份练习副本递到你手里：你站在接收的一端。把 tingħata 与“你获给一份东西”的画面一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 词义未明确；材料仅重复词形 Tinnega

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form classified as a noun in the supplied material, which repeats Tinnega without providing a lexical definition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料标为名词的形式；释义仅重复 Tinnega 这一词形，未说明它指什么。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma kklassifikata bħala nom fil-materjal mogħti, li jirrepeti Tinnega mingħajr ma jagħti definizzjoni tat-tifsira tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 材料仅重复词形 Tinnega，尚不能据此确定其中文词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal jirrepeti biss il-forma Tinnega u ma jispjegax għal xiex tirreferi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry repeats the form Tinnega without explaining what this noun refers to.

formal.mt: Il-materjal jelenka 'tinnega' bħala nom, iżda jirrepeti biss il-forma Tinnega u ma jipprovdix definizzjoni.
formal.en: The material lists 'tinnega' as a noun, but it only repeats the form Tinnega and provides no definition.
formal.zh: 材料将“tinnega”列为名词，但仅重复形式 Tinnega，没有提供定义。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nikteb it-tifsira ta' 'tinnega' minn din l-entrata? Luqa: Għad le. L-entrata tirrepeti biss il-kelma; għandna bżonn definizzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I write down the meaning of 'tinnega' from this entry? Luqa: Not yet. The entry only repeats the word; we need a definition.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Indicates that someone happens to do something or be in a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人碰巧做某事，或恰好处于某种情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika li xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa jew ikun f'ċerta sitwazzjoni b'kumbinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 碰巧做某事；恰好处于某种状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li azzjoni jew sitwazzjoni sseħħ b'kumbinazzjoni, mingħajr ma tkun ippjanata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone happens to do something, they do it by chance rather than as the result of a plan.

formal.mt: Jekk Marija tinserta tkun fil-librerija, tista' tgħin lill-istudenti jsibu l-kotba.
formal.en: If Marija happens to be in the library, she can help the students find the books.
formal.zh: 如果玛丽亚碰巧在图书馆，她可以帮助学生找到所需的书。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min jista' jgħinna b'din il-mistoqsija? Nina: Marija tinserta taf it-tweġiba. Nistaqsu lilha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who can help us with this question? Nina: Marija happens to know the answer. Let's ask her.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁能帮我们解答这个问题？妮娜：玛丽亚恰好知道答案。我们问问她吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 谁能帮我们解答这个问题？
messages.en: Who can help us with this question?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Marija tinserta taf it-tweġiba. Nistaqsu lilha.
messages.mt_standard: Marija tinserta taf it-tweġiba. Nistaqsu lilha.
messages.zh: 玛丽亚恰好知道答案。我们问问她吧。
messages.en: Marija happens to know the answer. Let's ask her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tinserta 放进“她恰好在家、恰好知道答案”的小场景，记住它突出的是碰巧发生。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put software or equipment in place and prepare it for use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将软件或设备安装到位，使其能够使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed programm fuq apparat jew tagħmir f'postu u tħejjih biex ikun jista' jintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安装软件或设备，使其可以使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tqiegħed programm fuq kompjuter jew apparat ieħor, jew tqiegħed tagħmir f'postu, sabiex ikun lest għall-użu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you install software or equipment, you put it in place and make it ready to use.

collocations.en: install an app on a mobile phone

formal.mt: It-teknika tinstilla l-programm fuq il-kompjuters tal-iskola qabel tibda l-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The technician installs the program on the school's computers before the lesson begins.
formal.zh: 技术员在上课前将程序安装到学校的电脑上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'qed tagħmel Sara bil-mowbajl? Lara: Qed tinstilla applikazzjoni biex titgħallem il-Malti.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is Sara doing on her phone? Lara: She's installing an app to learn Maltese.
colloquial.zh: 马克：萨拉在用手机做什么？拉拉：她正在安装一个学习马耳他语的应用。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 萨拉在用手机做什么？
messages.en: What is Sara doing on her phone?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tinstilla applikazzjoni biex titgħallem il-Malti.
messages.mt_standard: Qed tinstilla applikazzjoni biex titgħallem il-Malti.
messages.zh: 她正在安装一个学习马耳他语的应用。
messages.en: She's installing an app to learn Maltese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tinstilla，就想象点击安装后应用图标出现在手机屏幕上，用具体动作记住“安装”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A transfer of a file from the internet to a device, or the file obtained.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把文件从互联网传输到设备上的下载过程，也可指下载得到的文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-trasferiment ta' fajl mill-internet għal apparat, jew il-fajl li jinkiseb b'dan it-trasferiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下载过程；从互联网下载到设备上的文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li bih fajl jiġi trasferit mill-internet għal kompjuter jew apparat ieħor, jew il-fajl miksub b'dan il-mod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A download is the transfer of a file from the internet to your device, or a file obtained in this way.

collocations.zh: 免费下载；可免费下载的文件

formal.mt: It-tinżila tal-fajl trid titlesta qabel ma l-istudent ikun jista' jiftaħ id-dokument.
formal.en: The file download must finish before the student can open the document.
formal.zh: 文件下载必须完成后，学生才能打开文档。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadna ma nistgħux naraw il-filmat? Pawlu: It-tinżila għadha ma tlestietx. Nistennew ftit ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't we watch the video yet? Pawlu: The download hasn't finished yet. Let's wait a little longer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么我们还不能看视频？保罗：下载还没完成。我们再等一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadna ma nistgħux naraw il-filmat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadna ma nistgħux naraw il-filmat?
messages.zh: 为什么我们还不能看视频？
messages.en: Why can't we watch the video yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tinżila għadha ma tlestietx. Nistennew ftit ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: It-tinżila għadha ma tlestietx. Nistennew ftit ieħor.
messages.zh: 下载还没完成。我们再等一会儿吧。
messages.en: The download hasn't finished yet. Let's wait a little longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tinżila 和下载进度条连起来记：进度条走完，文件来到设备里；这里把“下载”当作名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A category of people or things that share particular characteristics.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据共同特点划分出的一类人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kategorija ta' nies jew affarijiet li għandhom ċerti karatteristiċi komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有共同特征的人或事物的类型、种类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp jew kategorija ta' nies jew affarijiet li jitqiegħdu flimkien minħabba karatteristiċi li għandhom komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A type of person or thing is a group whose members share particular features or qualities.

formal.mt: Kull tip ta' materjal għandu karatteristiċi li jiddeterminaw kif jista' jintuża.
formal.en: Each type of material has characteristics that determine how it can be used.
formal.zh: 每种材料都有决定其用途的特性。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tip ta' ikel tixtieq illejla? Mark: Nixtieq xi ħaġa ħafifa, bħal soppa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What type of food would you like tonight? Mark: I'd like something light, such as soup.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你今晚想吃哪类食物？马克：我想吃点清淡的，比如汤。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚想吃哪类食物？
messages.en: What type of food would you like tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq xi ħaġa ħafifa, bħal soppa.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq xi ħaġa ħafifa, bħal soppa.
messages.zh: 我想吃点清淡的，比如汤。
messages.en: I'd like something light, such as soup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tip 想成分类盒上的“种类”标签，再连着记 tip ta' ikel，表示“一种食物”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular design of letters and other characters used in written or printed text.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 文字中字母、数字和其他字符所采用的特定字形设计；也可指用于印刷的活字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stil partikolari ta' ittri, numri u sinjali fit-test; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għall-karattri fiżiċi użati fl-istampar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 字体，即字母、数字和符号所采用的一套特定字形设计。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' ittri, numri u sinjali b'disinn partikolari li jintuża biex jintwera jew jiġi stampat test.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A font is a set of letters and other characters with a particular visual design.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印刷活字，即带有凸起字符、可以着墨并将字符印到纸上的实体字模。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Karattri fiżiċi b'ittri jew sinjali mqabbżin li jieħdu l-linka u jintużaw biex jiġi stampat test fuq il-karta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Printing type consists of physical characters that carry ink to reproduce text on paper.

formal.mt: Għar-rapport, agħżel tipa ċara u żomm l-istess daqs tat-tipa fit-test kollu.
formal.en: For the report, choose a readable font and keep the same font size throughout the text.
formal.zh: 撰写报告时，请选择清晰易读的字体，并在全文中保持字号一致。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din it-tipa żgħira wisq? Mark: Iva, kabbarha ftit biex naqra aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this font too small? Mark: Yes, make it a little bigger so I can read more easily.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个字体是不是太小了？马克：是啊，调大一点，我就能看得更清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个字体是不是太小了？
messages.en: Is this font too small?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kabbarha ftit biex naqra aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kabbarha ftit biex naqra aħjar.
messages.zh: 是啊，调大一点，我就能看得更清楚。
messages.en: Yes, make it a little bigger so I can read more easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tipa 放进排版画面记忆：屏幕上选择的是字体，印刷机里排列的是活字；两个义项都围绕文字的字形。

gloss_zh: 通常；典型地；具有代表性地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that is usual or characteristic of a particular person, thing, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以某人、某事物或某种情形通常具有的方式；也用于说明一般情况下会怎样。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jkun tas-soltu jew karatteristiku ta' persuna, ħaġa jew sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常，一般情况下；或以体现某人、某事物典型特征的方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod li juri dak li hu tas-soltu jew karatteristiku ta' persuna, ħaġa jew sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use typically to describe what usually happens or what shows the characteristic qualities of someone or something.

collocations.zh: 具有典型马耳他特色的

formal.mt: F'din l-iskola, il-laqgħat mal-ġenituri tipikament isiru wara l-ħin tal-lezzjonijiet.
formal.en: At this school, meetings with parents typically take place after lesson hours.
formal.zh: 在这所学校，与家长的会面通常安排在课后。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta jkun hemm l-aktar nies hawn? Mark: Tipikament, is-Sibt filgħodu. Ejja matul il-ġimgħa jekk trid aktar kwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: When is this place busiest? Mark: Typically, on Saturday mornings. Come during the week if you want it to be quieter.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里什么时候人最多？马克：通常是星期六上午。想清静一点的话，就在工作日来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta jkun hemm l-aktar nies hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Meta jkun hemm l-aktar nies hawn?
messages.zh: 这里什么时候人最多？
messages.en: When is this place busiest?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tipikament, is-Sibt filgħodu. Ejja matul il-ġimgħa jekk trid aktar kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Tipikament, is-Sibt filgħodu. Ejja matul il-ġimgħa jekk trid aktar kwiet.
messages.zh: 通常是星期六上午。想清静一点的话，就在工作日来。
messages.en: Typically, on Saturday mornings. Come during the week if you want it to be quieter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“通常会怎样”这个提问来记 tipikament：它描述常见情况或典型方式，不表示每一次都必然如此。

gloss_zh: 典型的；有代表性的；一贯如此的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the usual or characteristic qualities of a particular person, group, thing, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有某人、某类事物或某种情形通常具有的特征，因而具有代表性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-kwalitajiet jew il-karatteristiċi tas-soltu ta' persuna, grupp, ħaġa jew sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 典型的，具有某一类别、人物或情形的常见特征；也可表示符合某人一贯作风的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri l-karatteristiċi komuni ta' tip jew grupp, jew li jaqbel mal-imġiba tas-soltu ta' persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something typical has the qualities you normally expect from a particular person, group, or kind of thing.

collocations.zh: 具有典型马耳他特色的食物

formal.mt: Dan id-djalogu jippreżenta eżempju tipiku ta' kif klijent jitlob l-għajnuna f'ħanut.
formal.en: This dialogue presents a typical example of how a customer asks for help in a shop.
formal.zh: 这段对话展示了顾客在商店里寻求帮助的一种典型情形。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu reġa' wasal qabel kulħadd! Mark: Dan hu tipiku tiegħu; dejjem jasal kmieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu has arrived before everyone else again! Mark: That's typical of him; he always arrives early.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗又比所有人都先到了！马克：这很符合他的一贯作风，他总是早到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗又比所有人都先到了！
messages.en: Pawlu has arrived before everyone else again!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu tipiku tiegħu; dejjem jasal kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu tipiku tiegħu; dejjem jasal kmieni.
messages.zh: 这很符合他的一贯作风，他总是早到。
messages.en: That's typical of him; he always arrives early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tipiku 贴在“典型例子”旁边记：看到一个例子就能认出整类特征；说一个人的表现时，也能表示“他一向如此”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An extra amount of money given to someone as thanks for a service, especially in a restaurant or similar establishment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在餐馆或其他服务场所，为感谢服务而在应付费用之外额外给服务人员的钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma flus li tingħata lil min jagħti servizz, minbarra l-ħlas dovut, bħala apprezzament għas-servizz.

sense_translations.en_definition: tip (in a restaurant or other establishment)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小费，即顾客在餐馆或其他服务场所，在账单或规定费用之外额外给服务人员的钱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Flus żejda li klijent jagħti lil wejter jew lil persuna oħra li tkun tatu servizz, bħala ringrazzjament jew apprezzament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tip is extra money that a customer gives someone to show appreciation for their service.

collocations.en: to give the waiter a tip

formal.mt: Wara li ħallas il-kont, il-klijent ħalla tipp lill-wejter bħala apprezzament għas-servizz.
formal.en: After paying the bill, the customer left the waiter a tip in appreciation of the service.
formal.zh: 付清账单后，顾客给服务员留下了小费，以表示对服务的感谢。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħallejna tipp lill-wejter? Mark: Iva, ħallejt ħames ewro fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did we leave the waiter a tip? Mark: Yes, I left five euros on the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们给服务员留小费了吗？马克：留了，我在桌上放了五欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 我们给服务员留小费了吗？
messages.en: Did we leave the waiter a tip?

messages.speaker: Mark (一同用餐的顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħallejt ħames ewro fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħallejt ħames ewro fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 留了，我在桌上放了五欧元。
messages.en: Yes, I left five euros on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tipp 和付完账后桌上额外留下的钱一起记：账单已经结清，这笔表达谢意的钱就是小费；注意词尾写两个 p。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To distort something or turn it away from its proper purpose or accepted standards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 歪曲某事物，或使其偏离应有的用途、原则或公认标准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tbiddel jew tgħawweġ xi ħaġa b'mod li tbegħedha mill-għan xieraq tagħha jew mill-istandards aċċettati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 歪曲某事物的意义或用途，或使其受到败坏而偏离正当原则。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħawweġ it-tifsira jew l-użu ta' xi ħaġa, jew tħassarha billi tbegħedha minn prinċipji xierqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone perverts something, they distort it or turn it away from its proper purpose or accepted principles.

collocations.en: distort the meaning of a text

formal.mt: Interpretazzjoni li tipperverti t-tifsira tat-test tista' twassal lill-qarrej għal konklużjonijiet żbaljati.
formal.en: An interpretation that distorts the meaning of the text can lead the reader to incorrect conclusions.
formal.zh: 歪曲文本含义的解读可能使读者得出错误结论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex neħħejt l-aħħar sentenza? Lara: Ridt inqassar il-messaġġ. Maja: Imma hekk tipperverti t-tifsira tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you remove the last sentence? Lara: I wanted to shorten the message. Maja: But that way you distort its meaning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么删掉最后一句？Lara：我想把消息缩短一点。Maja：可是这样你就歪曲了它的意思。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么删掉最后一句？
messages.en: Why did you remove the last sentence?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

messages.en: I wanted to shorten the message.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)

messages.en: But that way you distort its meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句话被删改后意思走样，用“把原意扭歪”的画面记住 tipperverti；这是记忆提示，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 词义待确认（材料标注为动词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form identified as a verb in the supplied material, which does not specify its meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料将此形式标注为动词，但释义仅重复词形，无法据此确定具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din il-forma hija mmarkata bħala verb fil-materjal mogħti, iżda t-tifsira tagħha mhijiex spjegata għax l-istess forma hija ripetuta bħala definizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 材料未提供可翻译的具体词义；所给释义只是重复 tippika 这一词形。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal mogħti jirrepeti biss il-forma tippika u ma jagħtix definizzjoni li tispjega x'ifisser dan il-verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry identifies this form as a verb but repeats the headword without explaining its meaning.

collocations.zh: 动词 tippika（讨论词条时的表达）
tippika 的含义（讨论词义时的表达）

formal.mt: Il-materjal jelenka 'tippika' bħala verb, iżda ma jispjegax it-tifsira tiegħu; għalhekk għad ma nistgħux nagħtu traduzzjoni preċiża.
formal.en: The material lists 'tippika' as a verb but does not explain its meaning, so we cannot yet provide a precise translation.
formal.zh: 材料将 tippika 列为动词，却没有解释其含义，因此目前无法给出准确翻译。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ifisser 'tippika' hawn? Mark: Il-lista tirrepeti biss il-kelma. Lara: Mela nħallu t-tifsira miftuħa sakemm ikollna aktar kuntest.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'tippika' mean here? Mark: The list only repeats the word. Lara: Then let's leave the meaning unresolved until we have more context.

teaching_sense.en_definition: To practise a skill or activity, or put a method into practical use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过实际操作练习技能或活动，或把某种方法付诸实践。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel eżerċizzju f'ħila jew attività biex titjieb fiha, jew tapplika metodu fil-prattika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 练习某项技能或活动以提高熟练程度，或实际运用某种方法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Teżerċita ruħek f'ħila jew attività biex issir aktar kapaċi fiha, jew tuża metodu f'sitwazzjoni reali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you practise a skill or activity, you spend time doing it to improve, or apply what you have learned.

formal.mt: L-istudenta tipprattika l-Malti kuljum billi taqra b'leħen għoli u titkellem ma' sħabha.
formal.en: The student practises Maltese every day by reading aloud and speaking with her classmates.
formal.zh: 这名学生每天通过朗读和与同学交谈来练习马耳他语。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif sejjer bil-Malti? Lara: Qed nitgħallem, imma għandi bżonn nitkellem aktar. Mark: Trid tipprattika miegħi għal għaxar minuti?
colloquial.en: Mark: How is your Maltese coming along? Lara: I'm learning, but I need to speak more. Mark: Do you want to practise with me for ten minutes?
colloquial.zh: Mark：你的马耳他语学得怎么样？Lara：正在学，不过我需要多开口。Mark：你想和我一起练十分钟吗？

gloss_zh: 确定优先顺序（依材料按名词处理）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of deciding which tasks or needs should receive attention first, treated here as a noun under the supplied label.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 决定哪些任务或需求应优先得到处理的行为；本条依所给材料的名词标签处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tistabbilixxi liema kompiti jew ħtiġijiet għandhom jingħataw attenzjoni l-ewwel; hawnhekk dan huwa ttrattat bħala nom skont it-tikketta fil-materjal mogħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 确定任务或需求的优先顺序，使较重要或较紧急的事项先得到处理；保留材料所给的名词分类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għażla tal-ordni li fih għandhom jiġu indirizzati kompiti jew ħtiġijiet, sabiex dawk aktar importanti jew urġenti jiġu ttrattati l-ewwel; tinżamm il-klassifikazzjoni bħala nom mogħtija fil-materjal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry refers to deciding what should receive attention first, while classifying the item as a noun.

collocations.zh: Tipprijoritarizza 所表示的概念（词条讨论用语）
清单中的 Tipprijoritarizza 标签（词条讨论用语）

formal.mt: Fil-lista, it-tikketta 'Tipprijoritarizza' hija kklassifikata bħala nom u tirreferi għall-għażla ta' liema kompiti għandhom isiru l-ewwel.
formal.en: In the list, the label 'Tipprijoritarizza' is classified as a noun and refers to choosing which tasks should be done first.
formal.zh: 在这份清单中，Tipprijoritarizza 这一标签被归为名词，指决定哪些任务应先完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jirrappreżenta 'Tipprijoritarizza' f'din il-lista? Mark: Li tagħżel x'għandu jsir l-ewwel. Maja: Mela hawn inżommu l-klassifikazzjoni bħala nom, kif tagħti l-lista.

gloss_zh: 让他闭嘴；叫他停止说话

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression conveying an instruction to make a male person stop speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示要求让某名男性停止说话的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser talba biex raġel jew tifel jitwaqqaf milli jkompli jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 让他闭嘴，即使某名男性停止说话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li titlob li xi ħadd iwaqqaf raġel jew tifel milli jitkellem aktar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression tells someone to make a male person stop speaking.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-espressjoni 'tiqaflu' tfisser talba biex persuna maskili titwaqqaf milli tkompli titkellem.
formal.en: In this exercise, the expression 'tiqaflu' conveys a request to make a male person stop speaking.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“tiqaflu”这一表达表示要求让某名男性停止说话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'tiqaflu' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Tfisser li titlob lil xi ħadd iwaqqfu milli jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tiqaflu' mean in this exercise? Pawlu: It means asking someone to stop him from speaking.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这道练习里的“tiqaflu”是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是叫人让他停止说话。

messages.en: It means asking someone to stop him from speaking.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The purpose of an action or the result that someone intends to achieve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 采取某种行动的目的，或希望通过行动实现的目标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iskop ta' azzjoni jew ir-riżultat li persuna tkun trid tikseb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 目的；进行某项活动或采取某种行动的用意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-iskop li għalih issir azzjoni jew titwettaq attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The purpose of an activity is the reason for doing it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 目标；某人努力争取实现的结果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-riżultat li persuna tfittex li tikseb permezz tal-isforzi tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An aim is a result that someone works towards achieving.

formal.mt: It-tir tal-proġett huwa li jtejjeb l-aċċess għall-edukazzjoni permezz ta' korsijiet b'xejn.
formal.en: The purpose of the project is to improve access to education through free courses.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在通过免费课程，让更多人有机会接受教育。

colloquial.zh: Maja：你这个月的目标是什么？Pawlu：我想读完一本马耳他语书。

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习计划顶端写下 tir，再写“为什么做”和“要达到什么”：前者帮助记住目的，后者帮助记住目标。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ruler who uses power cruelly and unfairly, or a person who controls others in an oppressive way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 残酷、不公地行使权力的统治者，也可指专横地控制他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħakkiem li juża s-setgħa tiegħu b'mod krudili u inġust, jew persuna li tikkontrolla lil ħaddieħor b'mod oppressiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴君；滥用权力、残酷压迫他人的统治者，也可比喻专横霸道的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħakkiem li jabbuża mis-setgħa tiegħu u jaħqar lin-nies, jew persuna li ġġiegħel lil ħaddieħor jagħmel kollox kif trid hi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tyrant is a ruler who uses power cruelly, or someone who controls other people harshly.

collocations.en: under the rule of a tyrant

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, it-tirann juża l-biża' biex iżomm il-poter u jwaqqaf kull oppożizzjoni.
formal.en: In the novel, the tyrant uses fear to maintain power and suppress all opposition.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，暴君利用恐惧维持权力，并压制一切反对力量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex fil-film kulħadd jibża' mir-re? Pawlu: Għax hu tirann u jikkastiga lil kull min ma jaqbilx miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is everyone in the film afraid of the king? Pawlu: Because he is a tyrant and punishes anyone who disagrees with him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电影里为什么人人都怕国王？Pawlu：因为他是个暴君，谁不同意他，他就惩罚谁。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里为什么人人都怕国王？
messages.en: Why is everyone in the film afraid of the king?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu tirann u jikkastiga lil kull min ma jaqbilx miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu tirann u jikkastiga lil kull min ma jaqbilx miegħu.
messages.zh: 因为他是个暴君，谁不同意他，他就惩罚谁。
messages.en: Because he is a tyrant and punishes anyone who disagrees with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说中坐在王座上、惩罚所有反对者的人，把 tirann 标签贴在他身上，记住这个词指“暴君这个人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cruel and unfair rule, or the oppressive use of power to control other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 残酷、不公的统治，或通过滥用权力压迫、控制他人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħakma krudili u inġusta, jew l-użu oppressiv tas-setgħa biex jiġu kkontrollati persuni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴政；凭借权力实施的残酷、不公的统治或专横压迫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod ta' ħakma li fih is-setgħa tintuża biex in-nies jiġu mċaħħda mil-libertà u ttrattati b'mod krudili jew inġust.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tyranny is the cruel or unfair use of power to rule or control people.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, iċ-ċittadini jingħaqdu biex itemmu t-tirannija u jibnu soċjetà aktar ġusta.
formal.en: In the novel, the citizens unite to end tyranny and build a fairer society.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，公民们联合起来，争取结束暴政，建立更加公正的社会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex in-nies f'din l-istorja jridu jaħarbu? Pawlu: Għax jgħixu taħt it-tirannija u ma jistgħux jitkellmu liberament.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do the people in this story want to escape? Pawlu: Because they live under tyranny and cannot speak freely.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个故事里的人为什么想逃走？Pawlu：因为他们生活在暴政之下，不能自由说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex in-nies f'din l-istorja jridu jaħarbu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex in-nies f'din l-istorja jridu jaħarbu?
messages.zh: 这个故事里的人为什么想逃走？
messages.en: Why do the people in this story want to escape?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jgħixu taħt it-tirannija u ma jistgħux jitkellmu liberament.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jgħixu taħt it-tirannija u ma jistgħux jitkellmu liberament.
messages.zh: 因为他们生活在暴政之下，不能自由说话。
messages.en: Because they live under tyranny and cannot speak freely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张图对照记忆：tirann 对应王座上的暴君，tirannija 对应笼罩整座城的压迫统治，帮助区分人物与暴政。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become unwell again after a period of improvement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在身体状况一度好转之后再次生病或出现病情反复。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terġa' timrad jew terġa' tħossok ma tiflaħx wara perjodu ta' titjib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体好转之后再次生病。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Terġa' tkun ma tiflaħx wara li tkun ħassejtek aħjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you become unwell again after feeling better, you suffer a return of your illness.

collocations.en: to become unwell again after a period of improvement
collocations.zh: 在一段时间的好转后再次生病

collocations.en: to begin to become unwell again

formal.mt: Wara perjodu ta' titjib, il-pazjenta bdiet tirkadi.
formal.en: After a period of improvement, the patient began to become unwell again.
formal.zh: 经过一段时间的好转，这位女患者的病情开始反复。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tirkadi? Maja: Iva, erġajt qed inħossni ma niflaħx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you getting ill again? Maja: Yes, I'm feeling unwell again.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你又开始不舒服了吗？玛雅：是的，我又觉得不舒服了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你又开始不舒服了吗？
messages.en: Are you getting ill again?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, erġajt qed inħossni ma niflaħx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, erġajt qed inħossni ma niflaħx.
messages.zh: 是的，我又觉得不舒服了。
messages.en: Yes, I'm feeling unwell again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tirkadi 放进“刚好一些，又不舒服”的情节中记忆，重点记住“再次”这一层意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce new buds as a plant begins to grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物开始长出新芽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toħroġ blanzuni ġodda hekk kif il-pjanta tibda tikber.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指植物萌发新芽。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tibda toħroġ blanzuni ġodda bħala parti mit-tkabbir tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a plant buds, it produces new buds from which leaves or flowers can develop.

formal.mt: Fir-rebbiegħa, id-dielja tibda tirmi u jidhru l-ewwel blanzuni.
formal.en: In spring, the vine begins to bud and the first buds appear.
formal.zh: 春天，葡萄藤开始萌芽，最初的新芽显露出来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara, is-siġra bdiet tirmi! Pawlu: Veru, diġà jidhru xi blanzuni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look, the tree has started to bud! Pawlu: Yes, you can already see some buds.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看，这棵树开始发芽了！保罗：是啊，已经能看见一些新芽了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，这棵树开始发芽了！
messages.en: Look, the tree has started to bud!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，已经能看见一些新芽了。
messages.en: Yes, you can already see some buds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tirmi 就想象春天枝头冒出小芽，并连读 is-siġra tibda tirmi，把词义和植物萌芽的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The need for something as a necessary condition for a task or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项任务或情境对必要条件、资源或能力的需求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħtieġa ta' xi ħaġa bħala kundizzjoni meħtieġa għal xogħol jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需要某种条件、资源或行动；要求具备某物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa teħtieġ kundizzjoni, riżorsa jew azzjoni biex tkun tista' ssir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a task requires something, that thing is necessary for the task to be done.

formal.mt: Din il-proċedura tirrikjedi attenzjoni u preparazzjoni bir-reqqa.
formal.en: This procedure requires attention and careful preparation.
formal.zh: 这项程序需要留心，并做好细致的准备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-biċċa xogħol tirrikjedi ħafna ħin? Mark: Iva, naħseb li għandna bżonn sagħtejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this task require a lot of time? Mark: Yes, I think we need two hours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这项工作需要很多时间吗？马克：是的，我觉得我们需要两个小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-biċċa xogħol tirrikjedi ħafna ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-biċċa xogħol tirrikjedi ħafna ħin?
messages.zh: 这项工作需要很多时间吗？
messages.en: Does this task require a lot of time?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naħseb li għandna bżonn sagħtejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naħseb li għandna bżonn sagħtejn.
messages.zh: 是的，我觉得我们需要两个小时。
messages.en: Yes, I think we need two hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这项工作需要什么”来记 tirrikjedi：后面接注意力、时间等必要条件，把整个搭配当作一个表达学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shake with small, repeated movements, often because of cold, fear, or nervousness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因寒冷、恐惧或紧张等原因，身体或身体部位出现细小而连续的抖动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titheżżeż b'movimenti żgħar u ripetuti, spiss minħabba l-bard, il-biża' jew in-nervożiżmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体或身体部位不由自主地颤抖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel movimenti żgħar ta' theżżiż mingħajr ma tkun trid, bħal meta tħoss il-bard jew il-biża'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you tremble, your body shakes slightly and repeatedly, often because you are cold, frightened, or nervous.

formal.mt: Waqt li kienet tistenna barra fil-kesħa, it-tifla bdiet tirtogħod.
formal.en: While she was waiting outside in the cold, the girl began to tremble.
formal.zh: 那个女孩在寒冷的室外等候时，开始发抖。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tirtogħod? Luqa: Għandi ħafna bard. Tista' tagħlaq it-tieqa?
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you trembling? Luqa: I'm very cold. Can you close the window?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么在发抖？卢卡：我很冷。你能把窗户关上吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在发抖？
messages.en: Why are you trembling?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħafna bard. Tista' tagħlaq it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħafna bard. Tista' tagħlaq it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 我很冷。你能把窗户关上吗？
messages.en: I'm very cold. Can you close the window?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tirtogħod 和冷风中身体轻轻发抖的画面联系起来，再用 bil-bard 与 bil-biża' 分别记住寒冷和害怕两种常见原因。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small correction or finishing change made to improve something's appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为改善外观而作的小幅修改或最后修整。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla żgħira jew korrezzjoni li ssir biex titjieb id-dehra ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对外观或细节所作的小幅修饰、修整。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Korrezzjoni żgħira fid-dehra jew fid-dettalji ta' xi ħaġa biex tidher aħjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A touch-up is a small correction that improves the appearance or finish of something.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'tirtokka' tirreferi għal korrezzjoni żgħira fir-ritratt biex jitneħħa sinjal minn fuq il-ħajt.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'tirtokka' refers to a small correction to the photograph to remove a mark on the wall.
formal.zh: 在这个练习中，tirtokka 指对照片进行小幅修饰，以去掉墙上的一处痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'tirtokka' hawn? Lara: Bidla żgħira fir-ritratt, bħal meta tneħħi tikka.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tirtokka' mean here? Lara: A small change to the photograph, like removing a spot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 tirtokka 是什么意思？拉拉：对照片作一点小修改，比如去掉一个斑点。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 tirtokka 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tirtokka' mean here?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bidla żgħira fir-ritratt, bħal meta tneħħi tikka.
messages.mt_standard: Bidla żgħira fir-ritratt, bħal meta tneħħi tikka.
messages.zh: 对照片作一点小修改，比如去掉一个斑点。
messages.en: A small change to the photograph, like removing a spot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象照片已经完成，只需擦去墙上一点污痕；用这个小修整画面记住本条的名词义。

gloss_zh: 宣泄；通过活动释放积压的情绪或精力

teaching_sense.en_definition: To release pent-up feelings or energy by doing an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过某种活动释放压抑或积累的情绪、精力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toħroġ emozzjonijiet jew enerġija miżmuma ġewwa fik billi tagħmel xi attività.

sense_translations.en_definition: to release suppressed energy by doing something
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过做某件事释放压抑或积蓄的精力与情绪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Teħles minn enerġija jew emozzjonijiet li jkunu nġabru ġewwa fik permezz ta' xi attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you release pent-up energy through an activity, you use that activity to express feelings or energy you have been holding back.

collocations.en: to release pent-up energy by running
collocations.zh: 通过跑步释放积压的精力

formal.mt: Wara ġurnata mimlija tensjoni, Marija tisfoga billi tiġri fil-park u terġa' lura d-dar aktar kalma.
formal.en: After a stressful day, Marija releases her pent-up energy by running in the park and returns home calmer.
formal.zh: 紧张地度过一天后，玛丽亚到公园跑步释放积压的精力，回家时平静了许多。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'tagħmel meta tkun irrabjata? Lara: Noħroġ niġri. Hekk nista' nisfoga u nikkalma.
colloquial.en: Mark: What do you do when you're angry? Lara: I go for a run. That way I can let it out and calm down.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你生气时会做什么？拉拉：我出去跑步。这样可以宣泄一下，让自己平静下来。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你生气时会做什么？
messages.en: What do you do when you're angry?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Noħroġ niġri. Hekk nista' nisfoga u nikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Noħroġ niġri. Hekk nista' nisfoga u nikkalma.
messages.zh: 我出去跑步。这样可以宣泄一下，让自己平静下来。
messages.en: I go for a run. That way I can let it out and calm down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把积压的情绪想成充满气的气球，跑步或写作让它慢慢放气，记住通过活动宣泄的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use an opportunity, resource, or situation to gain a benefit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用机会、资源或形势，使自己获得好处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tuża opportunità, riżorsa jew sitwazzjoni biex tikseb vantaġġ jew benefiċċju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用某种机会或有利条件取得好处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieħu vantaġġ minn opportunità jew minn kundizzjoni favorevoli biex tikseb xi benefiċċju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you take advantage of an opportunity or situation, you use it in a way that benefits you.

collocations.en: to take advantage of an opportunity
to make use of the available resources

formal.mt: L-iskola tisfrutta l-ispazju fil-bitħa biex torganizza lezzjonijiet fil-beraħ meta jkun bnazzi.
formal.en: The school makes use of the space in its courtyard to hold outdoor lessons when the weather is fine.
formal.zh: 天气晴好时，学校利用庭院里的空间开展户外教学。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna siegħa qabel il-lezzjoni. Maja: Mela ejja nisfruttaw dan il-ħin biex nirrevedu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: We've got an hour before the lesson. Maja: Then let's make use of that time to revise together.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：离上课还有一个小时。玛雅：那我们就利用这段时间一起复习吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 离上课还有一个小时。
messages.en: We've got an hour before the lesson.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja nisfruttaw dan il-ħin biex nirrevedu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja nisfruttaw dan il-ħin biex nirrevedu flimkien.
messages.zh: 那我们就利用这段时间一起复习吧。
messages.en: Then let's make use of that time to revise together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课前空出一小时，你马上拿来复习；把现成机会变成实际好处，就是本条的利用义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Friendly expressions of goodwill sent or conveyed to someone, often in a message or through another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向他人传达友好心意的问候或致意，常用于书信结尾或请人代为问候。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem ta' ħbiberija u rieda tajba li jintbagħat jew jitwassal lil xi ħadd, spiss f'messaġġ jew permezz ta' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 问候，致意；尤指在书信中表达或托人转达的友好心意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjonijiet ta' ħbiberija u rieda tajba li wieħed jibgħat lil persuna oħra, speċjalment fi tmiem ittra jew permezz ta' xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You send someone your regards when you want to convey friendly wishes, often through a message or another person.

formal.mt: Nirringrazzjak tal-għajnuna tiegħek u nibgħatlek l-isbaħ tislijiet.
formal.en: Thank you for your help, and I send you my best regards.
formal.zh: 感谢您的帮助，并向您致以最诚挚的问候。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għada se nżur lil ommi. David: Mela wasslilha t-tislijiet tiegħi!
colloquial.en: Anna: I'm going to visit my mother tomorrow. David: Then give her my regards!
colloquial.zh: Anna：我明天要去看我妈妈。David：那替我向她问好！

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我明天要去看我妈妈。
messages.en: I'm going to visit my mother tomorrow.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 那替我向她问好！
messages.en: Then give her my regards!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友临走时，你把一张写着“替我问好”的小卡片交给他；卡片上承载的那份问候就是 tislijiet。

gloss_zh: 喷灌；从上方向作物喷水的灌溉方式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A method of irrigation in which sprinklers distribute water over soil or plants from above.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用喷灌装置从上方将水喷洒到土壤或植物上的灌溉方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Metodu ta' tisqija li fih apparat ixerred l-ilma minn fuq fuq il-ħamrija jew il-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上方喷洒灌溉，即从植物或地面上方向下供水的灌溉方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Metodu ta' tisqija li fih l-ilma jitqassam minn fuq u jaqa' fuq il-pjanti jew il-ħamrija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Overhead irrigation supplies water from above so that it falls onto plants or the soil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷洒灌溉，即将水分散成水滴并喷洒到灌溉区域的方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Metodu ta' tisqija li fih l-ilma jinxtered fi qtar fuq l-art jew il-pjanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Spray irrigation distributes water as droplets over the area that needs watering.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷灌，即通过喷头等装置将水喷洒到作物或土壤上的灌溉方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Metodu ta' tisqija li juża apparat b'żennuni biex ixerred l-ilma fuq il-pjanti jew il-ħamrija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sprinkler irrigation uses devices that spray water over crops or soil to provide the required moisture.

formal.mt: Is-sistema ta' tisqija bil-friefet tqassam l-ilma minn fuq fuq il-pjanti; il-ħin tat-tisqija għandu jiġi aġġustat skont il-ħtiġijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: The sprinkler irrigation system distributes water over the plants from above; watering time should be adjusted to their needs.
formal.zh: 喷灌系统从上方向植物洒水；灌溉时长应根据植物的需要调整。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif se nsaqqu din ir-rokna tal-ġnien? Ġorġ: Nużaw it-tisqija bil-friefet, biex l-ilma jinxtered minn fuq fuq il-pjanti.
colloquial.en: Rita: How are we going to water this corner of the garden? Ġorġ: We'll use sprinkler irrigation so that the water is spread over the plants from above.
colloquial.zh: Rita：花园这个角落要怎么浇水？Ġorġ：我们用喷灌，让水从上方洒到植物上。

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nsaqqu din ir-rokna tal-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nsaqqu din ir-rokna tal-ġnien?
messages.zh: 花园这个角落要怎么浇水？
messages.en: How are we going to water this corner of the garden?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Nużaw it-tisqija bil-friefet, biex l-ilma jinxtered minn fuq fuq il-pjanti.
messages.mt_standard: Nużaw it-tisqija bil-friefet, biex l-ilma jinxtered minn fuq fuq il-pjanti.
messages.zh: 我们用喷灌，让水从上方洒到植物上。
messages.en: We'll use sprinkler irrigation so that the water is spread over the plants from above.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语配上一幅喷头向空中喷水、细小水滴落到菜叶上的画面；用“上方、喷洒、喷头”三个线索串起三个英文义项。

gloss_zh: 别尝试；别冒险（用于否定警告）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A warning, expressed as 'ma tissograx', telling someone not to attempt or dare to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于劝阻或警告对方不要尝试某事的表达，教学时结合否定形式 ma tissograx 理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twissija li, fil-forma 'ma tissograx', tgħid lil xi ħadd biex ma jippruvax jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不要尝试；别试着去做某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tgħid lil persuna biex ma tagħmilx tentattiv biex twettaq xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This warning tells someone not to attempt an action.

formal.mt: Jekk m'intix imħarreġ, ma tissograx tuża dan it-tagħmir mingħajr superviżjoni.
formal.en: If you are not trained, do not attempt to use this equipment without supervision.
formal.zh: 如果你未经培训，请勿尝试在无人监督的情况下使用这套设备。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nista' nmiss dan il-wajer? Pawlu: Le, ma tissograx tmissu! Jista' jkun perikoluż.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can I touch this wire? Pawlu: No, don't dare touch it! It could be dangerous.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我可以碰这根电线吗？Pawlu：不行，千万别碰！可能有危险。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 我可以碰这根电线吗？
messages.en: Can I touch this wire?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ma tissograx tmissu! Jista' jkun perikoluż.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ma tissograx tmissu! Jista' jkun perikoluż.
messages.zh: 不行，千万别碰！可能有危险。
messages.en: No, don't dare touch it! It could be dangerous.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ma tissograx 连同“伸手前被叫停”的画面一起记，理解为“别尝试、别冒险”；不要漏掉表示否定的 ma 和词尾 x。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of formally submitting an offer to supply goods or carry out work under a tender procedure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在招标程序中正式提交承接工作或供应货物的报价及相关投标文件这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tippreżenta formalment offerta biex tipprovdi oġġetti jew twettaq xogħol fi proċess ta' sejħa għall-offerti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正式提交投标书及相应报价。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li tippreżenta offerta formali u d-dokumenti meħtieġa bi tweġiba għal sejħa għall-offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you submit a tender, you formally present your proposed price and terms for supplying goods or doing work.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参与投标，正式提出供应货物或承接工作的报价。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li tieħu sehem fi proċess ta' sejħa għall-offerti billi tippreżenta l-prezz u l-kundizzjonijiet tiegħek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a company tenders for work, it formally offers to do that work at a stated price.

collocations.en: submit a tender before the deadline
collocations.zh: 在截止日期前提交投标书

collocations.en: submit a tender for the work
collocations.zh: 为该项工作提交投标书

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija għandha tissottometti offerta għax-xogħol ta' manutenzjoni sal-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The company must submit a tender for the maintenance work by Friday.
formal.zh: 该公司须在星期五之前提交维护工程的投标书。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se tissottometti offerta għal dan ix-xogħol? Mark: Iva, qed inħejji l-prezzijiet u d-dokumenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you going to submit a tender for this work? Mark: Yes, I'm preparing the prices and documents.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你打算为这项工作投标吗？Mark：是的，我正在准备报价和文件。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tissottometti offerta għal dan ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Se tissottometti offerta għal dan ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 你打算为这项工作投标吗？
messages.en: Are you going to submit a tender for this work?

messages.speaker: Mark (承包商)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed inħejji l-prezzijiet u d-dokumenti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed inħejji l-prezzijiet u d-dokumenti.
messages.zh: 是的，我正在准备报价和文件。
messages.en: Yes, I'm preparing the prices and documents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把“报价加文件”一起交到招标窗口，将 tissottometti offerta 整体记成“提交投标书”，再联想到参与投标的行为。

gloss_zh: 你可以带她一起下来；带她同行

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring a female person down with you, so that she accompanies you to a lower place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示你可以把她一起带下来，让她随你到楼下或较低的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser li tista' ġġib persuna femminili miegħek għal isfel jew għal post aktar baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把她带下来；使她到较低的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li ġġib persuna femminili għal isfel jew tgħinha tinżel għal post aktar baxx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you bring her down, you take her to a lower place or help her get there.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带她同行；让她跟你一起来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li titlob lil xi ħadd iġib persuna femminili miegħu sabiex jiġu flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You say this when you want someone to bring a female person along with them.

collocations.en: you can bring her down to the courtyard with you
collocations.zh: 你可以带她一起下到院子里

collocations.en: you can bring her down to the lower floor with you
collocations.zh: 你可以带她一起到楼下

formal.mt: Meta tinżel għas-sala tal-laqgħat, tista' tniżżilha miegħek sabiex tattendi l-laqgħa.
formal.en: When you go down to the meeting room, you can bring her with you so that she can attend the meeting.
formal.zh: 你下楼去会议室时，可以带她一起下来，让她参加会议。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Jien fil-bitħa. Tista' tniżżilha miegħek? Pawlu: Iva, se ninżlu t-tnejn issa.
colloquial.en: Anna: I'm in the courtyard. Can you bring her down with you? Pawlu: Yes, we're both coming down now.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我在院子里。你能带她一起下来吗？Pawlu：可以，我们俩现在就下来。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 我在院子里。你能带她一起下来吗？
messages.en: I'm in the courtyard. Can you bring her down with you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 可以，我们俩现在就下来。
messages.en: Yes, we're both coming down now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象你下楼时带着她同行：tista' 提示“可以”，miegħek 提示“和你一起”，把整句与“两个人一起下楼”的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally establish an organization, system, procedure, or arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式设立组织、建立制度或创设程序与安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser li twaqqaf formalment organizzazzjoni jew tistabbilixxi sistema, proċedura jew arranġament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正式设立或建立，使某个组织、制度或程序开始存在或实施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li toħloq jew twaqqaf b'mod formali korp, sistema jew proċedura biex jibda jeżisti jew jitħaddem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an authority institutes something, it formally establishes it or brings it into operation.

formal.mt: L-università se tistitwixxi kumitat ġdid biex jeżamina l-proposti tar-riċerka.
formal.en: The university will establish a new committee to examine research proposals.
formal.zh: 该大学将设立一个新的委员会，审议研究提案。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se tagħmel l-għaqda biex torganizza l-attivitajiet? David: Se tistitwixxi kumitat żgħir biex jieħu ħsiebhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: What will the association do to organize the activities? David: It will set up a small committee to take care of them.
colloquial.zh: Sara：协会会怎样组织这些活动？David：协会将成立一个小委员会来负责。

messages.speaker: Sara (协会会员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se tagħmel l-għaqda biex torganizza l-attivitajiet?
messages.mt_standard: X'se tagħmel l-għaqda biex torganizza l-attivitajiet?
messages.zh: 协会会怎样组织这些活动？
messages.en: What will the association do to organize the activities?

messages.speaker: David (协会负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tistitwixxi kumitat żgħir biex jieħu ħsiebhom.
messages.mt_standard: Se tistitwixxi kumitat żgħir biex jieħu ħsiebhom.
messages.zh: 协会将成立一个小委员会来负责。
messages.en: It will set up a small committee to take care of them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tistitwixxi 与“正式宣布成立委员会”的场景一起记；它强调把组织或制度建立起来，可用“设委员会、建程序”两组搭配巩固。

gloss_zh: 词义未明：所给释义仅为“I”，不足以确定该动词的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form listed as a verb whose meaning cannot be established from the supplied fragment "I".
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料中标为动词的形式，但所给英文片段“I”不足以确定其具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma mniżżla bħala verb, iżda l-framment Ingliż "I" mogħti fil-pakkett mhuwiex biżżejjed biex tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原始释义为“I”；该片段无法说明本条动词的具体意思。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pakkett jagħti biss il-framment Ingliż "I", li ma jispjegax x'ifisser il-verb imniżżel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied fragment "I" does not provide enough information to explain the meaning of this verb.

collocations.zh: 动词“tistona”的含义（用于讨论词条）

formal.mt: Il-forma "tistona" hija mniżżla bħala verb, iżda l-framment "I" ma jagħtix definizzjoni biżżejjed ċara.
formal.en: The form "tistona" is listed as a verb, but the fragment "I" does not provide a sufficiently clear definition.
formal.zh: “tistona”这一形式被列为动词，但片段“I”未能提供足够清楚的定义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser il-verb "tistona" hawn? Mark: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti; il-pakkett jagħti biss "I".
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the verb "tistona" mean here? Mark: We cannot be certain; the packet only gives "I".
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的动词“tistona”是什么意思？Mark：还不能确定；资料只给了“I”。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的动词“tistona”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the verb "tistona" mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti; il-pakkett jagħti biss "I".
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti; il-pakkett jagħti biss "I".
messages.zh: 还不能确定；资料只给了“I”。
messages.en: We cannot be certain; the packet only gives "I".

cognitive_memory_aid: 把此条记成“动词标签已知，具体词义待查”；不要把英文片段“I”直接当作这个马耳他语动词的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dizzy and feel that you or your surroundings are moving or spinning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得头晕，感觉自身或周围环境在移动或旋转。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħoss sturdament, bħallikieku int jew l-affarijiet ta' madwarek qed iduru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始感到头晕或眩晕，仿佛自己或周围的东西在转动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tibda tħoss sturdament u jkollok is-sensazzjoni li int jew l-affarijiet ta' madwarek qed iduru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you get dizzy, you feel unsteady, as though you or the things around you are spinning.

collocations.en: get dizzy when reading in the car
collocations.zh: 在车里看书时感到头晕

collocations.en: get dizzy when standing up quickly
collocations.zh: 突然站起来时感到头晕

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġatriċi spjegat li tistordi meta taqra fil-karozza waqt il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The traveller explained that she gets dizzy when reading in the car during a journey.
formal.zh: 这位旅客解释说，她在乘车途中看书会感到头晕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int ukoll tistordi meta taqra fil-karozza? Mark: Iva, għalhekk nippreferi nħares mit-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you also get dizzy when you read in the car? Mark: Yes, so I prefer to look out of the window.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在车里看书也会头晕吗？Mark：会，所以我更喜欢看窗外。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int ukoll tistordi meta taqra fil-karozza?
messages.mt_standard: Int ukoll tistordi meta taqra fil-karozza?
messages.zh: 你在车里看书也会头晕吗？
messages.en: Do you also get dizzy when you read in the car?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 会，所以我更喜欢看窗外。
messages.en: Yes, so I prefer to look out of the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象坐车看书后，纸上的字好像转了起来；把这一“开始头晕”的场景与 tistordi 连在一起记。

gloss_zh: 被认为会带来厄运的人或物；霉运之源

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or thing believed to bring bad luck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被认为会给人带来坏运气的人或物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li titqies li ġġib xorti ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被认为会招来厄运的人或物；所谓的霉运之源。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew oġġett li n-nies jemmnu li jġib xorti ħażina lil min ikun qribu jew ikollu x'jaqsam miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A jinx is a person or thing that people believe causes bad luck.

collocations.en: a person regarded as a jinx
collocations.zh: 被视为会带来厄运的人

collocations.en: an object regarded as a jinx
collocations.zh: 被视为会带来厄运的物品

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'tisħet' tintuża għal ċurkett li l-karattri tal-ħrafa jemmnu li jġib xorti ħażina.
formal.en: In the exercise, the word 'tisħet' is used for a ring that the characters in the tale believe brings bad luck.
formal.zh: 在这个练习中，tisħet 用来指故事人物认为会带来厄运的一枚戒指。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex fil-ħrafa dan iċ-ċurkett jissejjaħ 'tisħet'? Mark: Għax il-karattri jaħsbu li jġib xorti ħażina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this ring called a jinx in the tale? Mark: Because the characters think it brings bad luck.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里为什么把这枚戒指叫作霉运之源？马克：因为故事人物觉得它会带来厄运。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 故事里为什么把这枚戒指叫作霉运之源？
messages.en: Why is this ring called a jinx in the tale?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-karattri jaħsbu li jġib xorti ħażina.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-karattri jaħsbu li jġib xorti ħażina.
messages.zh: 因为故事人物觉得它会带来厄运。
messages.en: Because the characters think it brings bad luck.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事里一枚总被怪罪的戒指，大家把倒霉事归到它身上；记住这里指被认为带来厄运的人或物。

gloss_zh: 消费者赋权；增强消费者的自主选择与维权能力

teaching_sense.en_definition: The strengthening of consumers' ability to make informed choices and protect their interests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过增加信息、知识和行动能力，使消费者更能自主选择商品或服务并维护自身权益。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-konsumaturi jingħataw aktar informazzjoni, għarfien u mezzi biex jagħmlu għażliet infurmati u jħarsu l-interessi tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费者赋权，即增强消费者作出知情选择和维护自身权益的能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tisħiħ tal-kapaċità tal-konsumatur li jagħmel għażliet infurmati u jiddefendi l-interessi tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer empowerment is the process of helping consumers make informed decisions and defend their interests.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向消费者提供必要的信息、知识和行动手段，以增强其选择能力和权益保障能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' informazzjoni, għarfien u mezzi lill-konsumaturi sabiex ikunu jistgħu jagħżlu b'aktar għarfien u jħarsu d-drittijiet tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The empowerment of consumers involves giving people the knowledge and means to exercise their choices and rights.

collocations.zh: 增强消费者能力的措施
通过提供信息增强消费者能力

formal.mt: It-tisħiħ tal-pożizzjoni tal-konsumatur jeħtieġ informazzjoni ċara dwar il-prezzijiet u proċedura sempliċi biex jitressqu lmenti.
formal.en: Consumer empowerment requires clear information about prices and a simple procedure for submitting complaints.
formal.zh: 消费者赋权需要清晰的价格信息和简便的投诉程序。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex għandna nitgħallmu kif inqabblu l-offerti? Pawlu: Għax dan jgħin fit-tisħiħ tal-pożizzjoni tal-konsumatur: inkunu nafu nagħżlu aħjar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why should we learn how to compare offers? Pawlu: Because that helps empower consumers: we can make better choices.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们为什么要学习怎样比较优惠方案？Pawlu：因为这能增强消费者的能力，让我们更懂得如何选择。

messages.speaker: Marija (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandna nitgħallmu kif inqabblu l-offerti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandna nitgħallmu kif inqabblu l-offerti?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要学习怎样比较优惠方案？
messages.en: Why should we learn how to compare offers?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (讲师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dan jgħin fit-tisħiħ tal-pożizzjoni tal-konsumatur: inkunu nafu nagħżlu aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dan jgħin fit-tisħiħ tal-pożizzjoni tal-konsumatur: inkunu nafu nagħżlu aħjar.
messages.zh: 因为这能增强消费者的能力，让我们更懂得如何选择。
messages.en: Because that helps empower consumers: we can make better choices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成消费者手中多了一份清楚的价目表和一条投诉渠道：看得懂、会比较、能维权，就是消费者赋权。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A journey through the air, especially one made by an aircraft.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在空中进行的一次行程，尤指乘飞机进行的飞行或某一航班。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vjaġġ fl-ajru, speċjalment wieħed magħmul b'ajruplan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 飞行；飞机进行的一次航程或航班。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vjaġġ li jsir fl-ajru, speċjalment permezz ta' ajruplan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flight is a journey made through the air, usually in an aircraft.

formal.mt: It-titjira lejn Ruma titlaq fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu, u l-passiġġieri għandhom jaslu l-ajruport sagħtejn qabel.
formal.en: The flight to Rome departs at ten in the morning, and passengers should arrive at the airport two hours beforehand.
formal.zh: 飞往罗马的航班于上午十点起飞，乘客应提前两小时抵达机场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema ħin hi t-titjira tiegħek? Mark: Fit-tmienja ta' filgħodu. Maja: Mela nitilqu kmieni lejn l-ajruport.
colloquial.en: Maja: What time is your flight? Mark: At eight in the morning. Maja: Then let's leave early for the airport.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的航班是几点的？马克：早上八点。玛雅：那我们早点出发去机场。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的航班是几点的？
messages.en: What time is your flight?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅客)
messages.zh: 早上八点。
messages.en: At eight in the morning.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们早点出发去机场。
messages.en: Then let's leave early for the airport.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 titjira 放进一张机票的画面中记忆：一张机票对应一次飞行；再用“飞往罗马的航班”这个搭配巩固意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Journeys through the air, especially journeys made by aircraft; the plural of titjira.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 多次在空中进行的行程，尤指多个飞机航班；是 titjira 的复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vjaġġi fl-ajru, speċjalment dawk magħmula b'ajruplan; il-plural ta' titjira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多次飞行；多个航程或航班。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għadd ta' vjaġġi li jsiru fl-ajru, speċjalment permezz ta' ajruplani.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Flights are journeys made through the air, usually by aircraft.

formal.mt: Minħabba ċ-ċpar, diversi titjiriet ġew ikkanċellati, u l-passiġġieri ntalbu jikkuntattjaw lill-kumpaniji tal-ajru tagħhom.
formal.en: Several flights were cancelled because of fog, and passengers were asked to contact their airlines.
formal.zh: 由于有雾，多个航班被取消，乘客被要求联系各自的航空公司。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm titjiriet lejn Katanja għada? Pawlu: Iva, hemm tnejn filgħodu. Sara: Tajjeb, nagħżel dik li titlaq aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are there flights to Catania tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes, there are two in the morning. Sara: Good, I'll choose the one that leaves later.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：明天有飞往卡塔尼亚的航班吗？保罗：有，上午有两班。萨拉：好，我选起飞较晚的那班。

messages.en: Good, I'll choose the one that leaves later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 titjira 和 titjiriet 配对记忆：前者想成一张机票，后者想成机场屏幕上的一排航班，帮助区分单数与复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cry as an expression of sadness, pain, or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因悲伤、疼痛或难过而哭泣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tibki biex tesprimi dwejjaq, uġigħ jew niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哭泣，以眼泪或哭声表达悲伤、疼痛或难过。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tibki bid-dmugħ jew bil-ħoss biex tesprimi niket, uġigħ jew dwejjaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone cries, they shed tears or make sounds that express sadness, pain, or distress.

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, it-tifla titniegħed meta ssir taf li l-ħabiba tagħha se titlaq, u ommha tipprova tfarraġha.
formal.en: In the story, the girl cries when she learns that her friend is leaving, and her mother tries to comfort her.
formal.zh: 故事中，小女孩得知朋友即将离开时哭了起来，母亲试着安慰她。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex titniegħed, Sara? Sara: Għax tlift il-qattus tiegħi u ma nafx fejn hu. Maja: Ejja nfittxuh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you crying, Sara? Sara: Because I've lost my cat and I don't know where he is. Maja: Let's look for him together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：萨拉，你为什么哭？萨拉：因为我的猫丢了，我不知道它在哪里。玛雅：我们一起找它吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 萨拉，你为什么哭？
messages.en: Why are you crying, Sara?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tlift il-qattus tiegħi u ma nafx fejn hu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tlift il-qattus tiegħi u ma nafx fejn hu.
messages.zh: 因为我的猫丢了，我不知道它在哪里。
messages.en: Because I've lost my cat and I don't know where he is.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们一起找它吧。
messages.en: Let's look for him together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“朋友流泪，我问她为什么哭”的场景记住 titniegħed；把整句 Għaliex titniegħed? 与“你为什么哭？”一起练习。

gloss_zh: 簿记式证券；非实物化证券；无凭证证券

teaching_sense.en_definition: A security whose ownership is recorded in an account or register rather than represented by a physical certificate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过账户或登记簿记录所有权、而非以实物证书表示持有权的证券。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titolu finanzjarju li s-sjieda tiegħu tiġi rreġistrata f'kont jew f'reġistru minflok ma tkun rappreżentata minn ċertifikat fiżiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 簿记式证券，通过账户或登记簿中的记账记录确认所有权的证券。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titolu finanzjarju li s-sjieda tiegħu tinżamm permezz ta' entrati f'kont jew f'reġistru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A book-entry security is a financial security whose ownership is recorded through entries in an account or register.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非实物化证券，以账簿或电子登记形式存在、而非以实物证券证书形式存在的证券。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titolu finanzjarju li jeżisti bħala rekord f'kont jew f'reġistru, mingħajr ċertifikat fiżiku li jirrappreżentah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dematerialised security exists as an account or register record instead of a physical certificate.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无凭证证券，不以实物证书表示持有权、而以登记记录确认所有权的证券。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titolu finanzjarju li għalih ma jkunx hemm ċertifikat fiżiku u li s-sjieda tiegħu tkun imniżżla f'reġistru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An uncertificated security is a financial security for which ownership is registered without a physical certificate.

collocations.en: the registration of a book-entry security
the transfer of a book-entry security
the ownership of a book-entry security

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega li s-sjieda ta' titolu b'entrata fil-kotba tiġi rreġistrata f'kont jew f'reġistru, mingħajr ma jinħareġ ċertifikat fiżiku.
formal.en: The document explains that ownership of a book-entry security is recorded in an account or register without a physical certificate being issued.
formal.zh: 该文件说明，簿记式证券的所有权通过账户或登记簿记录，无须签发实物证书。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan hu titolu b'entrata fil-kotba? Rita: Iva, is-sjieda tidher fir-reġistru u ma jkollokx ċertifikat tal-karta. Mark: Mela nista' niċċekkja r-rekord tal-kont tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this a book-entry security? Rita: Yes, ownership appears in the register, and you won't have a paper certificate. Mark: Then I can check my account record.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这是簿记式证券吗？丽塔：是的，所有权记在登记簿中，你不会持有纸质证书。马克：那我可以查看自己的账户记录。

messages.zh: 这是簿记式证券吗？
messages.en: Is this a book-entry security?

messages.speaker: Rita (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, is-sjieda tidher fir-reġistru u ma jkollokx ċertifikat tal-karta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, is-sjieda tidher fir-reġistru u ma jkollokx ċertifikat tal-karta.
messages.zh: 是的，所有权记在登记簿中，你不会持有纸质证书。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nista' niċċekkja r-rekord tal-kont tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nista' niċċekkja r-rekord tal-kont tiegħi.
messages.zh: 那我可以查看自己的账户记录。
messages.en: Then I can check my account record.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象账户里的一行证券持有记录：记住“持有权登记在账上”这个画面，再把整个短语与“簿记式证券”对应起来。

gloss_zh: 记账式证券；无纸化证券；无实物凭证证券

teaching_sense.en_definition: A security whose ownership is recorded in an account or register rather than represented by a paper certificate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过账户或登记簿记载所有权，而不以纸质证券凭证表示持有权的证券。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titolu finanzjarju li s-sjieda tiegħu tkun irreġistrata f'kont jew f'reġistru minflok ma tkun irrappreżentata b'ċertifikat fuq il-karta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 记账式证券，即通过账户或登记簿中的记录记载持有权的证券。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titolu finanzjarju li s-sjieda u t-trasferimenti tiegħu jiġu rreġistrati permezz ta' entrati f'kont jew f'reġistru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A book-entry security is a financial security whose ownership and transfers are recorded through entries in an account or register.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无纸化证券，即以电子记录存在、无须实物证券凭证的证券。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titolu finanzjarju li jeżisti bħala rekord elettroniku mingħajr il-ħtieġa ta' ċertifikat fiżiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dematerialised security exists as an electronic record without requiring a physical certificate to represent it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无实物凭证证券，即不以纸质证书证明持有权，而以登记记录确认权利的证券。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titolu finanzjarju li għalih ma jinħariġx ċertifikat fuq il-karta u li s-sjieda tiegħu tiġi kkonfermata mir-reġistrazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An uncertificated security has no paper certificate, and the holder's ownership is established by a registration record.

collocations.en: the owner of a book-entry security

formal.mt: Is-sjieda ta' dan it-titolu mniżżel fil-kotba tidher fir-reġistru elettroniku.
formal.en: Ownership of this book-entry security is shown in the electronic register.
formal.zh: 这项记账式证券的所有权记载在电子登记簿中。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għal dan it-titolu mniżżel fil-kotba nirċievi ċertifikat fuq il-karta? Lara: Le, is-sjieda tiegħek tidher fir-reġistru elettroniku.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do I receive a paper certificate for this book-entry security? Lara: No, your ownership is shown in the electronic register.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这项记账式证券会给我纸质凭证吗？Lara：不会，你的所有权记载在电子登记簿中。

messages.mt_standard: Għal dan it-titolu mniżżel fil-kotba nirċievi ċertifikat fuq il-karta?

messages.zh: 不会，你的所有权记载在电子登记簿中。
