teaching_sense.en_definition: Able or suitable to be eaten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以供人食用的，表示所说的东西能够吃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tista' tiġi kkunsmata bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可食用的；适合当作食物吃的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tista' tittiekel u tkun tajba għall-konsum bħala ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is edible, it is suitable for people to eat.

formal.mt: Il-qoxra ta' din il-frotta tittiekel wara li tinħasel sew.
formal.en: The skin of this fruit can be eaten after it has been washed thoroughly.
formal.zh: 这种水果的果皮彻底洗净后可以食用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qoxra ta' din il-frotta tittiekel? Nina: Iva, aħsilha sew l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you eat the skin of this fruit? Nina: Yes, wash it thoroughly first.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这种水果的皮可以吃吗？Nina：可以，先把它洗干净。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这种水果的皮可以吃吗？
messages.en: Can you eat the skin of this fruit?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，先把它洗干净。
messages.en: Yes, wash it thoroughly first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住问句“Il-qoxra tittiekel?”，把果皮和“可以吃吗”连在一起；这个词表达可食用，不表示味道好。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name Titulari, used to identify a particular referent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名称“Titulari”，用于指称其所对应的对象；此处保留原文名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem Titulari, li jintuża biex jidentifika r-referent tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名称“Titulari”；在没有进一步限定所指对象时，保留原文。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isem Titulari, li jirreferi għall-persuna jew għall-ħaġa li ġġorr dan l-isem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Titulari is the name used to identify the person or thing bearing that name.

collocations.en: the spelling of the name Titulari

formal.mt: L-isem Titulari għandu jinkiteb bl-istess mod kull darba li jidher fid-dokument.
formal.en: The name Titulari should be written consistently every time it appears in the document.
formal.zh: 名称 Titulari 在文件中每次出现时都应保持相同的写法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nikteb l-isem Titulari? Mark: Ikteb Titulari, b'T kbira fil-bidu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I write the name Titulari? Mark: Write Titulari, with a capital T at the beginning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Titulari 这个名称怎么写？Mark：写作 Titulari，开头用大写 T。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: Titulari 这个名称怎么写？
messages.en: How do I write the name Titulari?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 写作 Titulari，开头用大写 T。
messages.en: Write Titulari, with a capital T at the beginning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用一张写着 Titulari 的名称卡记住拼写和大写形式；具体所指需要上下文，不凭相似词形猜意思。

gloss_zh: 所给释义指爱卖弄风情、逗引他人的女子；该马耳他语形式的词性未注明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form associated in the packet with a woman who flirts or seeks romantic attention; its part of speech is unspecified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料将该形式与“爱卖弄风情、吸引他人爱慕的女子”这一含义对应，但未注明该形式的词性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pakkett jorbot din il-forma ma' mara li tħobb tiġbed l-attenzjoni romantika ta' ħaddieħor, iżda ma jispeċifikax il-kategorija grammatikali tal-forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱卖弄风情、逗引他人产生爱慕的女子；原条未注明该马耳他语形式的词性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mara li tħobb tiġbed l-attenzjoni romantika ta' ħaddieħor bl-imġiba tagħha; il-pakkett ma jagħtix il-kategorija grammatikali tal-forma Maltija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coquette is a woman who behaves flirtatiously to attract romantic attention, although this packet does not specify the Maltese form's part of speech.

formal.mt: Għall-forma "titħanxel", il-pakkett jagħti l-kelma Ingliża "coquette", iżda ma jispeċifikax il-kategorija grammatikali.
formal.en: For the form "titħanxel", the packet gives the English word "coquette", but does not specify the grammatical category.
formal.zh: 对于“titħanxel”这一形式，资料提供了英文“coquette”，但未注明语法类别。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jagħti l-pakkett għal "titħanxel"? Mark: Jagħti "coquette", jiġifieri mara li tħobb tiġbed l-attenzjoni romantika, imma ma jgħidx il-kategorija grammatikali.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the packet give for "titħanxel"? Mark: It gives "coquette", meaning a woman who likes to attract romantic attention, but it does not state the grammatical category.
colloquial.zh: Maja：资料给“titħanxel”配了什么释义？Mark：给的是“coquette”，指喜欢吸引他人爱慕的女子，但没有写语法类别。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 资料给“titħanxel”配了什么释义？
messages.en: What does the packet give for "titħanxel"?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jagħti "coquette", jiġifieri mara li tħobb tiġbed l-attenzjoni romantika, imma ma jgħidx il-kategorija grammatikali.
messages.mt_standard: Jagħti "coquette", jiġifieri mara li tħobb tiġbed l-attenzjoni romantika, imma ma jgħidx il-kategorija grammatikali.
messages.zh: 给的是“coquette”，指喜欢吸引他人爱慕的女子，但没有写语法类别。
messages.en: It gives "coquette", meaning a woman who likes to attract romantic attention, but it does not state the grammatical category.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“卖弄风情、吸引爱慕”的人物画面记住所给释义，再加一张“词性未注”的便签，避免自行补出语法用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A casual top, usually with short sleeves and no collar, worn on the upper body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在上身的休闲衣物，通常为短袖、无领的T恤衫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies informali għall-parti ta' fuq tal-ġisem, ġeneralment bi kmiem qosra u mingħajr kullar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: T恤衫，通常指短袖、无领的休闲上衣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa lbies informali li tintlibes fuq il-parti ta' fuq tal-ġisem u li ġeneralment ikollha kmiem qosra u ma jkollhiex kullar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A T-shirt is a casual top that usually has short sleeves and no collar.

formal.mt: Għall-attività sportiva, kull parteċipant għandu jilbes tixert abjad u żraben komdi.
formal.en: For the sporting activity, each participant should wear a white T-shirt and comfortable shoes.
formal.zh: 参加这次体育活动时，每位参与者应穿白色T恤和舒适的鞋子。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom dan it-tixert bil-blu? Lara: Iva. Liema daqs trid?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have this T-shirt in blue? Lara: Yes. What size would you like?
colloquial.zh: Mark：这款T恤有蓝色的吗？Lara：有。您想要什么尺码？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这款T恤有蓝色的吗？
messages.en: Do you have this T-shirt in blue?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.zh: 有。您想要什么尺码？
messages.en: Yes. What size would you like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象衣柜里的一件白色T恤，把 tixert abjad 整组记住，再替换颜色练习描述自己的衣服。

gloss_zh: 动词形式，具体词义待确认

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb form whose specific meaning remains to be established.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个具体含义尚未确定的动词形式；学习时应先确认其在完整句子中的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' verb li t-tifsira speċifika tagħha għadha trid tiġi stabbilita f'sentenza sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动词形式 tixtarra；此处无法确定其具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-forma verbali tixtarra, li t-tifsira preċiża tagħha għadha mhix stabbilita hawnhekk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The specific meaning of this verb form remains unconfirmed.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tuża l-verb 'tixtarra' f'test, iċċekkja t-tifsira tiegħu f'sentenza sħiħa.
formal.en: Before using the verb 'tixtarra' in a text, check its meaning in a complete sentence.
formal.zh: 在文章中使用动词 tixtarra 之前，请先结合完整句子确认它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'tixtarra'? Pawlu: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja narawha f'sentenza sħiħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tixtarra' mean? Pawlu: I don't know yet. Let's look at it in a complete sentence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：tixtarra 是什么意思？保罗：我还不知道。我们看看它在完整句子中的用法吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: tixtarra 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tixtarra' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja narawha f'sentenza sħiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja narawha f'sentenza sħiħa.
messages.zh: 我还不知道。我们看看它在完整句子中的用法吧。
messages.en: I don't know yet. Let's look at it in a complete sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 tixtarra 放进“动词待确认”词卡，配完整句子再记意思，避免只凭拼写猜义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: You want something or would like something to happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示你想要某物，或希望某件事情发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' verb li tesprimi li inti trid xi ħaġa jew għandek ix-xewqa li jiġri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你希望、想要或渴望某物或某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tesprimi li inti għandek xewqa għal xi ħaġa jew li trid li sseħħ xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you tixtieq something, you want it or would like it to happen.

collocations.en: you would like a glass of water

formal.mt: Jekk tixtieq aktar informazzjoni dwar il-kors, jekk jogħġbok ikkuntattja lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: If you would like more information about the course, please contact the office.
formal.zh: 如果你希望了解更多课程信息，请联系办公室。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tixtieq tazza te? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Bla zokkor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like a cup of tea? Mark: Yes, please. No sugar.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想喝杯茶吗？马克：好的，谢谢。不加糖。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想喝杯茶吗？
messages.en: Would you like a cup of tea?

messages.speaker: Mark (来访的朋友)
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。不加糖。
messages.en: Yes, please. No sugar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友端着茶问你“想要吗”，把 Tixtieq...? 整句记成“你想要……吗？”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of soft, thin paper used for wiping or cleaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于擦鼻子、擦拭或清洁的一张薄软纸巾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa karta rqiqa u ratba li tintuża biex timsaħ imnieħrek jew tnaddaf xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纸巾，指用于擦拭或清洁的薄软纸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Karta ratba u rqiqa li tużaha biex timsaħ imnieħrek jew tnaddaf wiċċ jew oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tissue is a piece of soft paper that you use for wiping or cleaning.

collocations.en: to wipe your nose with a tissue

formal.mt: Uża tixxju nadif biex timsaħ imnieħrek, imbagħad armih fil-landa taż-żibel.
formal.en: Use a clean tissue to wipe your nose, then put it in the rubbish bin.
formal.zh: 请用干净的纸巾擦鼻子，然后将它扔进垃圾桶。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek tixxju? Għandi bżonn nimsaħ imnieħri. Sara: Iva, ħu dan.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you got a tissue? I need to wipe my nose. Sara: Yes, take this one.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有纸巾吗？我需要擦一下鼻子。萨拉：有，拿这张吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek tixxju? Għandi bżonn nimsaħ imnieħri.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek tixxju? Għandi bżonn nimsaħ imnieħri.
messages.zh: 你有纸巾吗？我需要擦一下鼻子。
messages.en: Have you got a tissue? I need to wipe my nose.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，拿这张吧。
messages.en: Yes, take this one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打完喷嚏伸手找纸巾，把 tixxju 与“拿纸巾、擦鼻子”的动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form supplied with the gloss 'malti', whose lexical meaning and grammatical category are not established by the packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料中释义标为“malti”、词性标为 x 的词形；现有资料不足以确定其具体词义和语法类别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma mogħtija bit-tifsira 'malti' u bil-kategorija x, iżda l-informazzjoni pprovduta mhijiex biżżejjed biex jiġu stabbiliti t-tifsira preċiża u l-kategorija grammatikali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义仅写作“malti”；无法据此可靠确定 tiċċekja 的具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma 'malti' hija l-unika tifsira mogħtija għal din il-forma, u waħedha ma tippermettix li tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira preċiża tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry supplies only the gloss 'malti', which does not establish a clear lexical meaning for the form.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, il-forma 'tiċċekja' għandha biss it-tifsira 'malti'; għalhekk, it-tifsira preċiża tagħha tibqa' mhux ċara.
formal.en: In this list, the form 'tiċċekja' has only the gloss 'malti'; its precise meaning therefore remains unclear.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，“tiċċekja”只有“malti”这一释义，因此其确切含义仍不明确。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'tiċċekja' f'din il-lista? Mark: Hawn miktub biss 'malti'. B'din l-informazzjoni biss, ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'tiċċekja' mean in this list? Mark: It only says 'malti' here. With this information alone, we cannot be certain.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份词表里的“tiċċekja”是什么意思？马克：这里只写了“malti”。仅凭这些信息，我们还不能确定。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这份词表里的“tiċċekja”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tiċċekja' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub biss 'malti'. B'din l-informazzjoni biss, ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub biss 'malti'. B'din l-informazzjoni biss, ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti.
messages.zh: 这里只写了“malti”。仅凭这些信息，我们还不能确定。
messages.en: It only says 'malti' here. With this information alone, we cannot be certain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiċċekja 放进“词义待核实”记忆卡，旁注原释义 malti；先准确记住字形，不凭相似拼写猜义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The continuation of an agreement or arrangement without an express statement that it is being renewed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未明确声明续期，而以默示方式使协议或安排继续有效。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tkomplija ta' ftehim jew arranġament mingħajr dikjarazzjoni espliċita li dan qiegħed jiġġedded.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 没有明确表示延长，而通过默示方式使原有期限继续延伸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-estensjoni taż-żmien ta' ftehim jew arranġament mingħajr ma din tiġi ddikjarata espressament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tacit prolongation occurs when an agreement or arrangement continues without an express declaration extending its duration.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif il-klawżola dwar it-tiġdid taċitu taffettwa t-tul tal-ftehim.
formal.en: The report explains how the clause on tacit renewal affects the duration of the agreement.
formal.zh: 报告解释了默示续期条款如何影响协议的有效期限。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi jfisser 'tiġdid taċitu' hawn? Pawlu: Ifisser li l-ftehim ikompli mingħajr dikjarazzjoni espliċita ta' tiġdid, skont il-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does 'tacit renewal' mean here? Pawlu: It means the agreement continues without an explicit declaration of renewal, according to its terms.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这里的“默示续期”是什么意思？保罗：意思是根据协议条款，无须明确声明续期，协议就继续有效。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 这里的“默示续期”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tacit renewal' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-ftehim ikompli mingħajr dikjarazzjoni espliċita ta' tiġdid, skont il-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-ftehim ikompli mingħajr dikjarazzjoni espliċita ta' tiġdid, skont il-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 意思是根据协议条款，无须明确声明续期，协议就继续有效。
messages.en: It means the agreement continues without an explicit declaration of renewal, according to its terms.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想为“没有明说，期限继续”：tiġdid 提醒你关注续期，taċitu 提醒你关注默示；用协议到期后按约继续的画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A domestic chicken, especially an adult female kept for laying eggs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 家养的鸡，尤指成年母鸡，常用于产蛋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur domestiku, b'mod speċjali l-mara adulta tiegħu, li spiss jinżamm għall-bajd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成年雌性鸡，即母鸡。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mara adulta tat-tiġieġ, li tista' tbid il-bajd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hen is an adult female chicken that can lay eggs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸡，一种通常为获取蛋或肉而饲养的家禽。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasfur domestiku li jitrabba għall-bajd jew għal-laħam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chicken is a domestic bird that people commonly keep for its eggs or meat.

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni fir-razzett, l-istudenti raw tiġieġa tfittex l-ikel ħdejn il-bejta tagħha.
formal.en: During their observation at the farm, the students saw a hen looking for food near her nest.
formal.zh: 在农场观察期间，学生们看到一只母鸡在自己的窝旁觅食。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajtha t-tiġieġa fil-ġnien? Nannu: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn is-siġra. Ejja nagħtuha ftit ikel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the chicken in the garden? Grandad: Yes, she's beside the tree. Let's give her some food.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到花园里的那只鸡了吗？爷爷：看到了，它在树旁边。我们给它喂点食物吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 你看到花园里的那只鸡了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the chicken in the garden?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn is-siġra. Ejja nagħtuha ftit ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn is-siġra. Ejja nagħtuha ftit ikel.
messages.zh: 看到了，它在树旁边。我们给它喂点食物吧。
messages.en: Yes, she's beside the tree. Let's give her some food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只母鸡守着鸡窝：看到 tiġieġa，先记住“母鸡”，再联系较宽泛的“鸡”；用“母鸡下蛋”的完整画面区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 海关债务的产生；承担海关债务

teaching_sense.en_definition: The arising of an obligation to pay customs duties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缴纳关税的义务产生，即海关债务发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħolqien ta' obbligu li jitħallsu dazji doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关债务的发生，即缴纳关税的义务产生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li jinħoloq obbligu li jitħallsu dazji doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The incurrence of a customs debt is the arising of an obligation to pay customs duties.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生海关债务，即开始承担缴纳关税的义务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna ssir obbligata tħallas dazji doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Incurring of a customs debt means becoming responsible for paying customs duties.

collocations.en: the date on which a customs debt is incurred
the conditions for incurring a customs debt

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddistingwi bejn it-tiġrib ta' dejn doganali u l-ħlas tad-dazji dovuti.
formal.en: The report distinguishes between incurring a customs debt and paying the duties owed.
formal.zh: 报告区分了海关债务的产生与所欠关税的缴纳。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfisser 'tiġrib ta' dejn doganali' f'dan id-dokument? Rita: Ifisser li jinħoloq obbligu li jitħallsu dazji doganali. Il-ħlas innifsu huwa pass ieħor.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does 'incurrence of a customs debt' mean in this document? Rita: It means an obligation to pay customs duties arises. The payment itself is a separate step.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这份文件里的“海关债务的产生”是什么意思？丽塔：意思是产生了缴纳关税的义务。实际付款是另外一个步骤。

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'tiġrib ta' dejn doganali' f'dan id-dokument?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'tiġrib ta' dejn doganali' f'dan id-dokument?
messages.zh: 这份文件里的“海关债务的产生”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'incurrence of a customs debt' mean in this document?

messages.speaker: Rita (培训讲师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jinħoloq obbligu li jitħallsu dazji doganali. Il-ħlas innifsu huwa pass ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jinħoloq obbligu li jitħallsu dazji doganali. Il-ħlas innifsu huwa pass ieħor.
messages.zh: 意思是产生了缴纳关税的义务。实际付款是另外一个步骤。
messages.en: It means an obligation to pay customs duties arises. The payment itself is a separate step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“义务产生，然后付款”的两步画面记忆整个短语：看到 dejn doganali 就联想到海关债务，整个词条强调缴税义务开始发生。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rounded fleshy part at the back of the body that you sit on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体后侧、坐下时承托身体的臀部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti mlaħħma fuq wara tal-ġisem li fuqha toqgħod bilqiegħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 臀部；屁股，即身体后侧坐下时着座的部位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-ġisem fuq wara, magħmula miż-żewġ naħat imlaħħma li fuqhom toqgħod bilqiegħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your buttocks are the two rounded fleshy parts at the back of your body that you sit on.

formal.mt: Wara l-waqgħa, il-pazjent ħass uġigħ fit-tiż meta pprova joqgħod bilqiegħda.
formal.en: After the fall, the patient felt pain in his buttocks when he tried to sit down.
formal.zh: 跌倒后，患者尝试坐下时感到臀部疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Waqajt fuq it-tiż! Lara: Weġġajt? Mark: Ftit, imma nista' nimxi.
colloquial.en: Mark: I landed on my backside! Lara: Did you hurt yourself? Mark: A little, but I can walk.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我摔了个屁股着地！拉拉：摔伤了吗？马克：有点疼，不过还能走。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我摔了个屁股着地！
messages.en: I landed on my backside!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 摔伤了吗？
messages.en: Did you hurt yourself?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有点疼，不过还能走。
messages.en: A little, but I can walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象坐到椅子上时接触椅面的臀部，把 tiż 与“坐下”和“屁股着地”两个画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Birds kept on farms or at home for their meat or eggs, considered collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为获取肉或蛋而饲养的鸟类的统称，如鸡、鸭等家禽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasafar, bħat-tiġieġ u l-papri, li jitrabbew għal-laħam jew għall-bajd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家禽；为生产肉或蛋而饲养的鸟类的统称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasafar li jinżammu u jitrabbew biex jipproduċu l-laħam jew il-bajd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Poultry are birds such as chickens and ducks that people keep for their meat or eggs.

formal.mt: It-tjur għandhom jinżammu f'post nadif u jkollhom ilma frisk kuljum.
formal.en: Poultry should be kept in a clean place and provided with fresh water every day.
formal.zh: 家禽应饲养在清洁的地方，并且每天都应有新鲜饮水。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tajt l-għalf lit-tjur? Pawlu: Iva, u mlejtilhom l-ilma wkoll.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have you fed the poultry? Pawlu: Yes, and I've filled up their water too.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你给家禽喂食了吗？Pawlu：喂了，也给它们添水了。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场主)
messages.zh: 你给家禽喂食了吗？
messages.en: Have you fed the poultry?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场助手)
messages.zh: 喂了，也给它们添水了。
messages.en: Yes, and I've filled up their water too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tjur 放进农场画面：一群鸡鸭围着饲料槽吃食，记住它表示家禽这一类。

gloss_zh: 闲荡；逗留不走（暂定释义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Provisionally, the activity of lingering or spending time somewhere without a clear purpose; the supplied gloss marks this interpretation as uncertain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂指没有明确目的地在某处闲荡或逗留的行为；所给释义带有问号，因此这一解释尚不确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod proviżorju, l-attività li wieħed idum f'post jew jiġġerra bla skop ċar; it-tifsira mogħtija għandha sinjal ta' mistoqsija u għalhekk mhijiex ċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能指闲荡、无明确目的地逗留；原释义中的问号表示这一对应关系不确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Possibbilment l-attività li wieħed jibqa' f'post jew jiġġerra mingħajr skop ċar, iżda din it-tifsira għadha mhix ikkonfermata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This may refer to lingering somewhere without a clear purpose, although the supplied meaning is uncertain.

collocations.en: loitering in the street, under the provisional interpretation
collocations.zh: 在街上闲荡（按暂定释义构造）

collocations.en: loitering outside the shop, under the provisional interpretation
collocations.zh: 在商店门前逗留（按暂定释义构造）

formal.mt: Jekk 'tlajjar' hawn ifisser li wieħed idum f'post bla skop ċar, it-tlajjar quddiem id-daħla jista' jfixkel il-passaġġ.
formal.en: If 'tlajjar' here means lingering somewhere without a clear purpose, loitering in front of the entrance may obstruct passage.
formal.zh: 如果这里的 tlajjar 指没有明确目的地逗留，那么在入口前逗留可能会妨碍通行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn 'tlajjar' ifisser li tibqa' ddur bla skop? Mark: Jista' jkun, imma t-tifsira għadha mhix ċerta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'tlajjar' here mean hanging around without a purpose? Mark: It might, but the meaning is still uncertain.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 tlajjar 是指漫无目的地闲荡吗？Mark：有可能，但这个释义还不确定。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn 'tlajjar' ifisser li tibqa' ddur bla skop?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn 'tlajjar' ifisser li tibqa' ddur bla skop?
messages.zh: 这里的 tlajjar 是指漫无目的地闲荡吗？
messages.en: Does 'tlajjar' here mean hanging around without a purpose?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun, imma t-tifsira għadha mhix ċerta.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun, imma t-tifsira għadha mhix ċerta.
messages.zh: 有可能，但这个释义还不确定。
messages.en: It might, but the meaning is still uncertain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 暂把 tlajjar 连到街边闲荡的画面，同时在词卡上保留问号，提醒自己这一释义尚待确认。

gloss_zh: 优惠侵蚀；关税优惠优势的削弱

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction in the relative advantage provided by trade preferences, especially when tariff cuts for other suppliers narrow an existing preferential margin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贸易优惠带来的相对优势减弱，尤其指其他供应方的关税降低后，原有优惠税率所形成的优势缩小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-vantaġġ relattiv li jagħtu l-preferenzi kummerċjali, speċjalment meta tnaqqis fit-tariffi għal fornituri oħra jċekken id-differenza favorevoli fit-tariffi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 优惠侵蚀；贸易优惠所赋予的相对利益逐渐减弱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-benefiċċju relattiv li pajjiż jew fornitur jikseb minn trattament kummerċjali preferenzjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Erosion of preferences occurs when preferential trade treatment gives its beneficiaries a smaller advantage than before.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贸易优惠优势的削弱；优惠待遇相对于其他供应方普通待遇的优势缩小。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li fih jonqos il-vantaġġ tat-trattament preferenzjali meta mqabbel mat-trattament mogħti lil fornituri oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Preference erosion is the weakening of a trading advantage as the difference between preferential and other trading conditions narrows.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关税优惠侵蚀；优惠税率与其他适用税率之间的差距缩小，导致优惠受益方的相对优势下降。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-vantaġġ ta' tariffa preferenzjali meta tiċkien id-differenza bejnha u t-tariffa applikata lil fornituri oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tariff preference erosion occurs when a preferential tariff provides less advantage because the tariff charged to other suppliers falls.

formal.mt: It-tnaqqis fit-tariffi applikati lill-fornituri l-oħra jista' jwassal għal tnaqqir tal-preferenzi, anki jekk it-tariffa preferenzjali tibqa' l-istess.
formal.en: Reducing the tariffs applied to other suppliers can lead to preference erosion, even if the preferential tariff remains unchanged.
formal.zh: 降低对其他供应方适用的关税可能导致优惠侵蚀，即使优惠税率本身保持不变。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għad għandna t-tariffa preferenzjali; allura għaliex qed jitkellmu dwar tnaqqir tal-preferenzi? David: Għax naqsu t-tariffi għall-fornituri l-oħra, u l-vantaġġ tagħna ċkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: We still have the preferential tariff, so why are they talking about preference erosion? David: Because tariffs for the other suppliers have fallen, and our advantage has shrunk.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们仍然享有优惠税率，那为什么还说出现了优惠侵蚀？David：因为其他供应方的关税降低了，我们的优势也就缩小了。

messages.speaker: Sara (出口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandna t-tariffa preferenzjali; allura għaliex qed jitkellmu dwar tnaqqir tal-preferenzi?
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandna t-tariffa preferenzjali; allura għaliex qed jitkellmu dwar tnaqqir tal-preferenzi?
messages.zh: 我们仍然享有优惠税率，那为什么还说出现了优惠侵蚀？
messages.en: We still have the preferential tariff, so why are they talking about preference erosion?

messages.speaker: David (贸易顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax naqsu t-tariffi għall-fornituri l-oħra, u l-vantaġġ tagħna ċkien.
messages.mt_standard: Għax naqsu t-tariffi għall-fornituri l-oħra, u l-vantaġġ tagħna ċkien.
messages.zh: 因为其他供应方的关税降低了，我们的优势也就缩小了。
messages.en: Because tariffs for the other suppliers have fallen, and our advantage has shrunk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两条税率线记整句：自己的优惠线不动，别人的税率线下降，两线距离缩小，就是优惠优势被侵蚀。

gloss_zh: 竞争力下降；竞争力削弱

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decline in the ability of a business, industry, or economy to compete successfully with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 企业、行业或经济体在价格、质量、效率等方面与其他竞争者竞争的能力下降。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-kapaċità ta' negozju, settur jew ekonomija li jikkompetu b'suċċess ma' oħrajn, pereżempju fil-prezz, fil-kwalità jew fl-effiċjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 竞争力削弱；企业、行业或经济体相对于竞争者的竞争能力减弱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dgħufija li tiżdied fil-kapaċità ta' negozju, settur jew ekonomija li jżommu pożizzjoni b'saħħitha meta mqabbla mal-kompetituri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Erosion of competitiveness occurs when a business, industry, or economy becomes less able to compete successfully with its rivals.

collocations.en: a decline in the industry's competitiveness

formal.mt: Iż-żieda fl-ispejjeż tal-produzzjoni, mingħajr titjib fil-produttività, tista' twassal għal tnaqqis tal-kompetittività tal-industrija.
formal.en: An increase in production costs without an improvement in productivity can lead to a decline in the industry's competitiveness.
formal.zh: 生产成本上升而生产率没有提高，可能导致该行业的竞争力下降。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed nitilfu l-klijenti? Ġorġ: Il-prezzijiet tagħna għolew aktar minn dawk tal-kompetituri; dan jista' juri tnaqqis tal-kompetittività.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are we losing customers? Ġorġ: Our prices have risen more than our competitors' prices; that may indicate declining competitiveness.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们为什么在流失客户？Ġorġ：我们的价格涨得比竞争对手更多，这可能说明竞争力正在下降。

messages.speaker: Nina (店主)
messages.zh: 我们为什么在流失客户？
messages.en: Why are we losing customers?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (业务顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prezzijiet tagħna għolew aktar minn dawk tal-kompetituri; dan jista' juri tnaqqis tal-kompetittività.
messages.mt_standard: Il-prezzijiet tagħna għolew aktar minn dawk tal-kompetituri; dan jista' juri tnaqqis tal-kompetittività.
messages.zh: 我们的价格涨得比竞争对手更多，这可能说明竞争力正在下降。
messages.en: Our prices have risen more than our competitors' prices; that may indicate declining competitiveness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句配成商店比较图：成本上涨、价格变高、客户转向对手，借这个场景记住竞争力下降。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of starting a project or formally introducing a new product, service, or initiative.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使项目或行动开始，或正式向公众推出新产品、服务或计划的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih jinbeda proġett jew tiġi introdotta uffiċjalment xi ħaġa ġdida, bħal prodott, servizz jew inizjattiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 项目、行动等的启动，或新产品、服务等的正式推出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bidu ta' proġett jew attività, jew l-introduzzjoni uffiċjali ta' prodott, servizz jew inizjattiva ġdida.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The launch of something is the act of starting it or formally introducing it to the public.

collocations.en: the launch of a new project
the launch of a new product

formal.mt: It-tnedija tas-servizz il-ġdid se ssir nhar it-Tnejn, u r-residenti se jkunu jistgħu jużawh minn dakinhar.
formal.en: The new service will launch on Monday, and residents will be able to use it from that day.
formal.zh: 新服务将于星期一正式推出，居民从当天起即可使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tiġi għat-tnedija tal-ktieb illejla? Mark: Iva, niġi miegħek. Nixtieq niltaqa' mal-awtriċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you coming to the book launch tonight? Mark: Yes, I'll come with you. I'd like to meet the author.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今晚来参加新书发布会吗？Mark：来，我跟你一起去。我想见见那位女作家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚来参加新书发布会吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to the book launch tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niġi miegħek. Nixtieq niltaqa' mal-awtriċi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niġi miegħek. Nixtieq niltaqa' mal-awtriċi.
messages.zh: 来，我跟你一起去。我想见见那位女作家。
messages.en: Yes, I'll come with you. I'd like to meet the author.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tnedija 联想成按下启动按钮：项目开始、新品推出、新书发布，都可以围绕“正式开始”来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of fitting horseshoes to a horse's hooves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将蹄铁安装并固定在马蹄上的工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li fih jitwaħħal in-nagħal mal-qwieqeb taż-żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给马安装、固定蹄铁的工作或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih jitwaħħal in-nagħal mal-qwieqeb taż-żwiemel biex jgħin fil-protezzjoni tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Horse-shoeing is the work of fitting and securing horseshoes to a horse's hooves.

formal.mt: It-tnegħil taż-żwiemel għandu jsir minn persuna mħarrġa, b'attenzjoni għall-qagħda u s-saħħa tal-qwieqeb.
formal.en: The shoeing of horses should be carried out by a trained person, with attention to the condition and health of the hooves.
formal.zh: 给马匹装蹄铁应由受过训练的人员进行，并注意马蹄的状况与健康。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta se jsir it-tnegħil taż-żiemel? Pawlu: Nhar il-Ħamis filgħodu. Se nkun hemm biex inżomm iż-żiemel kalm.
colloquial.en: Lara: When will the horse be shod? Pawlu: On Thursday morning. I'll be there to keep the horse calm.
colloquial.zh: Lara：什么时候给这匹马装蹄铁？Pawlu：星期四早上。我会在场，让马保持平静。

messages.speaker: Lara (马主)
messages.zh: 什么时候给这匹马装蹄铁？
messages.en: When will the horse be shod?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (马厩管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nhar il-Ħamis filgħodu. Se nkun hemm biex inżomm iż-żiemel kalm.
messages.mt_standard: Nhar il-Ħamis filgħodu. Se nkun hemm biex inżomm iż-żiemel kalm.
messages.zh: 星期四早上。我会在场，让马保持平静。
messages.en: On Thursday morning. I'll be there to keep the horse calm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tnegħil 记成一项马厩工作：抬起马蹄、贴合蹄铁、固定完成，整套动作就是“给马装蹄铁”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The removal of the outer shell, husk, or leafy covering from food such as oysters or corn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去除牡蛎等食物的外壳，或剥去玉米等食物外层包覆物的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija tal-qoxra jew tal-weraq ta' barra minn ikel bħall-gajdri jew il-qamħirrum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥去食物的壳、外皮或苞叶，尤指给牡蛎去壳或剥玉米苞叶。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih titneħħa l-qoxra minn ikel bħall-gajdri, jew jitneħħa l-weraq li jgħatti l-qamħirrum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Shucking is the process of removing the outer shell or covering from food, especially oysters or corn.

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tat-tisjir, l-għalliema wriet it-tneħħija tal-qoxra tal-gajdri qabel ma ħejjiethom biex jittieklu.
formal.en: During the cooking lesson, the teacher demonstrated oyster shucking before preparing the oysters to be eaten.
formal.zh: 烹饪课上，老师先演示了如何给牡蛎去壳，再将它们处理好供食用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tgħinni bit-tneħħija tal-qoxra tal-qamħirrum? Toni: Żgur. Int neħħi l-weraq, u jien niġbor kollox f'din il-borża.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you help me shuck the corn? Toni: Sure. You remove the leaves, and I'll collect everything in this bag.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你能帮我剥玉米苞叶吗？Toni：当然。你把叶子剥下来，我把它们都收进这个袋子里。

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你能帮我剥玉米苞叶吗？
messages.en: Can you help me shuck the corn?

messages.speaker: Toni (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Int neħħi l-weraq, u jien niġbor kollox f'din il-borża.

messages.zh: 当然。你把叶子剥下来，我把它们都收进这个袋子里。
messages.en: Sure. You remove the leaves, and I'll collect everything in this bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用厨房画面记整条短语：牡蛎打开硬壳、玉米剥掉苞叶，共同动作都是“去掉外层包覆物”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which a seed begins to grow and develop into a new plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 种子开始生长，长出最初的根和芽并逐渐形成新植株的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih żerriegħa tibda tikber u toħroġ l-ewwel għerq u rimja biex tiżviluppa f'xitla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 种子在适宜条件下开始生长并长出根和芽的萌发过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bidu tal-iżvilupp ta' żerriegħa f'xitla, meta joħorġu l-ewwel għerq u rimja f'kundizzjonijiet xierqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Germination is the process in which a seed begins to grow and produces its first root and shoot.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tnibbit taż-żrieragħ tal-fażola u rreġistraw meta deher l-ewwel għerq f'kull waħda.
formal.en: The students observed the germination of bean seeds and recorded when the first root appeared in each one.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了菜豆种子的萌发，并记录了每粒种子最初长出根的时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Beda t-tnibbit taż-żrieragħ li poġġejna fuq il-qoton? Ben: Iva, ara din! Diġà ħarġilha għerq żgħir.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have the seeds we put on the cotton started germinating? Ben: Yes, look at this one! It already has a little root.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们放在棉花上的种子开始发芽了吗？Ben：开始了，看这粒！它已经长出一条小根了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Beda t-tnibbit taż-żrieragħ li poġġejna fuq il-qoton?
messages.mt_standard: Beda t-tnibbit taż-żrieragħ li poġġejna fuq il-qoton?
messages.zh: 我们放在棉花上的种子开始发芽了吗？
messages.en: Have the seeds we put on the cotton started germinating?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara din! Diġà ħarġilha għerq żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara din! Diġà ħarġilha għerq żgħir.
messages.zh: 开始了，看这粒！它已经长出一条小根了。
messages.en: Yes, look at this one! It already has a little root.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tnibbit 配上湿棉花上的豆子图：先伸出小根，再冒出嫩芽，记住它描述“种子开始生长”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sob or sigh, expressing emotion through crying or an audible breath.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因情绪而抽泣，或通过一声呼气表达悲伤、疲倦、无奈或宽慰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibki b'nifs imqatta' jew joħroġ nifs li jinstema' biex jesprimi emozzjoni bħal niket, għeja jew serħan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽泣；哭泣时呼吸断续，发出哽咽声。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibki b'nifs imqatta' u b'ħsejjes li juru niket qawwi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone sobs, they cry with broken breaths and sounds of distress.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叹气；发出一声较长且可听见的呼气，以表达情绪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Joħroġ nifs twil li jinstema', bħala espressjoni ta' niket, għeja, diżappunt jew serħan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone sighs, they breathe out audibly to express an emotion such as sadness or relief.

formal.mt: Meta sar jaf li l-familja tiegħu kienet kollha f'post sigur, tniegħed bis-serħan.
formal.en: When he learned that his whole family was somewhere safe, he sighed with relief.
formal.zh: 得知全家人都已身处安全的地方后，他宽慰地叹了一口气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tniegħed hekk? Mark: Kelli ġurnata twila u għad fadalli ħafna xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you sigh like that? Mark: I've had a long day, and I still have a lot of work left.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么那样叹气？马克：今天忙了一整天，还有很多工作没做完。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么那样叹气？
messages.en: Why did you sigh like that?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli ġurnata twila u għad fadalli ħafna xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli ġurnata twila u għad fadalli ħafna xogħol.
messages.zh: 今天忙了一整天，还有很多工作没做完。
messages.en: I've had a long day, and I still have a lot of work left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和两种呼吸画面一起记：哭得一抽一抽是“抽泣”，长长呼出一口气是“叹息”；具体意思由语境判断。

gloss_zh: （太阳）落下；（烛焰）渐弱；（临终者的健康状况）逐渐衰退

teaching_sense.en_definition: To set or gradually fade, as the sun, a candle flame, or a dying person's health does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指太阳落下，或烛焰、临终者的健康状况逐渐减弱、衰退。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi x-xemx meta tinżel u tgħib, fjamma ta' xemgħa meta tiddgħajjef qabel tintefa, jew is-saħħa ta' persuna li tkun qed tmut meta tonqos bil-mod.

sense_translations.en_definition: to set(the sun) the flame of a candle before it goes out ... the health of a dying person is fading away...
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指太阳落下；也指蜡烛熄灭前火焰渐弱，或临终者的健康状况逐渐衰退。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tirreferi għax-xemx li tkun qed tinżel, għall-fjamma ta' xemgħa li tkun qed tiddgħajjef qabel tintefa, jew għas-saħħa ta' persuna li tkun qed tmut u li tkun qed tonqos bil-mod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When the sun sets, a candle flame weakens before going out, or a dying person's health fades, its light or strength gradually diminishes.

formal.mt: Hekk kif ix-xemx tnin, id-dawl fuq l-għelieqi jonqos bil-mod.
formal.en: As the sun sets, the light over the fields gradually fades.
formal.zh: 随着太阳落下，田野上的光线逐渐暗淡。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tara kif il-fjamma tnin? Pawlu: Iva, ix-xemgħa waslet biex tintefa. Se nġib oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you see how the flame is fading? Pawlu: Yes, the candle is about to go out. I'll get another one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到火焰正在变弱吗？保罗：看到了，蜡烛快熄灭了。我去拿另一支。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到火焰正在变弱吗？
messages.en: Can you see how the flame is fading?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ix-xemgħa waslet biex tintefa. Se nġib oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ix-xemgħa waslet biex tintefa. Se nġib oħra.
messages.zh: 看到了，蜡烛快熄灭了。我去拿另一支。
messages.en: Yes, the candle is about to go out. I'll get another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个渐弱的画面串联记忆：夕阳落下、烛火将熄、临终者健康衰退；这些是所给词义的记忆场景，不是词源解释。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义尚未确定；所给材料仅以问号标示。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhijiex mogħtija; fil-materjal hemm biss marka ta' mistoqsija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry marks this noun's meaning as unknown and provides no definition.

formal.mt: Fil-materjal mogħti, il-kelma 'Tobaiba' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda t-tifsira tagħha mhijiex speċifikata.

formal.zh: 在所给材料中，“Tobaiba”被列为名词，但未注明其含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move upwards or increase to a higher level or amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向上移动，或在水平、程度、数值等方面升高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titla' 'l fuq jew tiżdied fil-livell, fil-grad jew fl-ammont.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上升；升高；增加到更高的水平或数值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Timxi lejn pożizzjoni ogħla jew tiżdied minn livell jew ammont aktar baxx għal wieħed ogħla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something rises, it moves upwards or increases to a higher level or amount.

formal.mt: It-tabella turi li t-temperatura togħla gradwalment matul l-ewwel siegħa tal-esperiment.
formal.en: The table shows that the temperature rises gradually during the first hour of the experiment.
formal.zh: 表格显示，在实验的第一个小时内，温度逐渐升高。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed togħla t-temperatura fil-kamra? Mark: Għax ix-xemx dieħla mit-tieqa. Ejja nagħlqu l-purtieri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the temperature in the room rising? Mark: Because the sun is coming through the window. Let's close the curtains.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：房间里的温度为什么在升高？马克：因为阳光从窗户照进来了。我们把窗帘拉上吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 房间里的温度为什么在升高？
messages.en: Why is the temperature in the room rising?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ix-xemx dieħla mit-tieqa. Ejja nagħlqu l-purtieri.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ix-xemx dieħla mit-tieqa. Ejja nagħlqu l-purtieri.
messages.zh: 因为阳光从窗户照进来了。我们把窗帘拉上吧。
messages.en: Because the sun is coming through the window. Let's close the curtains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象温度计上的液柱向上爬，把 togħla 和“上升箭头”一起记；温度升高、费用增加都可以借这个画面理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rise or become higher in position, level, or amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指位置、水平或数值向上变化，变得更高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titla' għal pożizzjoni jew livell ogħla, jew tiżdied fl-ammont.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上升；升高；指位置、水平或数量增加。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Timxi 'l fuq jew issir ogħla fil-livell, fil-pożizzjoni jew fl-ammont.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When something rises, its position, level, or amount becomes higher than it was before.

formal.mt: Meta t-temperatura tal-ilma togħla, it-termometru juri valur ogħla.
formal.en: When the water temperature rises, the thermometer shows a higher reading.
formal.zh: 水温升高时，温度计显示的读数也会升高。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-temperatura fil-kamra qed togħla. Pawlu: Iva, ejja niftħu t-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Nina: The temperature in the room is rising. Pawlu: Yes, let's open the window.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：房间里的温度越来越高了。保罗：是啊，我们把窗户打开吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)

messages.en: The temperature in the room is rising.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们把窗户打开吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's open the window.

gloss_zh: 把东西塞进你肛门再取出来（粗俗）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vulgar expression meaning to shove something into your anus and then take it out again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 粗俗表达，指把某物塞进你的肛门，然后再取出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni vulgari li tfisser li ddaħħal xi ħaġa f'sormok b'forza u mbagħad terġa' toħroġha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to shove up your ass and take back out
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物塞进你的肛门，再把它取出来；属于粗俗说法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li ddaħħal oġġett f'sormok b'forza u wara terġa' tiġbdu 'l barra; hija espressjoni vulgari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This vulgar expression describes shoving something into your anus and then pulling it back out.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'togħotroġ' hija espressjoni vulgari li tiddeskrivi d-dħul ta' oġġett fl-anus u t-tneħħija tiegħu wara.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'togħotroġ' is a vulgar expression describing the insertion of an object into the anus and its subsequent removal.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，'togħotroġ' 是一个粗俗表达，描述把物体塞入肛门后再取出的动作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'togħotroġ'? Lara: Tfisser li ddaħħal xi ħaġa f'sormok u mbagħad terġa' toħroġha. Hija espressjoni vulgari.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'togħotroġ' mean? Lara: It means shoving something up your ass and then taking it out again. It's a vulgar expression.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：'togħotroġ' 是什么意思？拉拉：意思是把东西塞进你的屁眼，再取出来。这是个粗俗表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to ask whether something appeals to you or gives you pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问某个事物是否让你喜欢、满意或觉得合心意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tistaqsi jekk xi ħaġa tagħtikx gost jew tkunx għall-gosti tiegħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你喜欢这个吗；用于询问对方是否喜欢正在谈论或展示的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mistoqsija biex tkun taf jekk il-ħaġa li qed turi jew issemmi tkunx għall-gosti tal-persuna li qed tkellem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to ask whether someone likes the thing you are showing or discussing.

formal.mt: Jekk togħġbok din il-proposta, jekk jogħġbok ibgħat il-kummenti tiegħek bil-miktub.
formal.en: If you like this proposal, please send your comments in writing.
formal.zh: 如果你喜欢这项提议，请以书面形式提交意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Togħġbok din il-kanzunetta? Lara: Iva, ħafna! Erġa' semmagħhieli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like this song? Lara: Yes, very much! Play it for me again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢这首歌吗？拉拉：喜欢，非常喜欢！再放一遍给我听。

gloss_zh: 学习（所给英文释义为动词，词性标注为名词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of gaining knowledge or skills through study or experience, interpreted nominally to retain the supplied noun label.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过学习或经验获得知识、技能的活动；此处依照资料保留名词标注，但所给英文释义为动词“to learn”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li biha persuna tikseb għarfien jew ħiliet permezz tal-istudju jew tal-esperjenza; hawn tinżamm il-kategorija ta' nom mogħtija fid-data, għalkemm it-tifsira Ingliża hija verb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学习；通过学习或经验获得知识或技能。资料将其标注为名词，但英文释义本身是动词不定式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li persuna tikseb għarfien jew ħiliet permezz tal-istudju jew tal-esperjenza; it-tifsira tindika azzjoni, għalkemm il-kategorija mogħtija hija nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you learn, you gain knowledge or skills through study or experience; the supplied noun label does not match this verbal gloss.

formal.mt: Fil-lista, 'tġhallem' għandu t-tifsira Ingliża 'to learn', iżda l-kategorija mogħtija hija nom; din id-differenza teħtieġ kjarifika qabel ma l-kelma tintuża bħala mudell grammatikali.
formal.en: In the list, 'tġhallem' has the English gloss 'to learn', but its supplied category is noun; this discrepancy requires clarification before the word is used as a grammatical model.
formal.zh: 词表给“tġhallem”的英文释义是“to learn”，但词性标注为名词；在将其作为语法示例使用之前，需要澄清这一差异。

colloquial.mt: Lara: 'Tġhallem' hawn ifisser 'to learn'? Pawlu: Iva, dik hija t-tifsira mogħtija, imma l-lista timmarkah bħala nom. Irridu niċċaraw il-kategorija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does 'tġhallem' mean 'to learn' here? Pawlu: Yes, that is the supplied meaning, but the list marks it as a noun. We need to clarify the category.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的‘tġhallem’是‘学习’的意思吗？Pawlu：是的，这是所给释义，但词表把它标成了名词。我们需要弄清词性。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“tġhallem”是“学习”的意思吗？
messages.en: Does 'tġhallem' mean 'to learn' here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik hija t-tifsira mogħtija, imma l-lista timmarkah bħala nom. Irridu niċċaraw il-kategorija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik hija t-tifsira mogħtija, imma l-lista timmarkah bħala nom. Irridu niċċaraw il-kategorija.
messages.zh: 是的，这是所给释义，但词表把它标成了名词。我们需要弄清词性。
messages.en: Yes, that is the supplied meaning, but the list marks it as a noun. We need to clarify the category.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“读书获得新知识”的画面记住学习义，再在卡片旁写“名词标注与英文动词释义待核对”，避免直接套用语法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel angry or bitter about something that seems unfair or hurtful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因认为某事不公平、令人受伤或冒犯自己而心怀不满或怨恨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħass rabja jew riżentiment minħabba xi ħaġa li dehritlu inġusta jew li weġġgħetu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事心怀不满或怨恨，尤其因为觉得自己受到不公平的对待。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħass dispjaċir u rabja dwar xi ħaġa għax qiesha inġusta jew offensiva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you resent something, you feel angry or bitter because you think it is unfair or hurtful.

collocations.zh: 因受到批评而心怀不满
因被排除在外而感到不满

formal.mt: L-impjegat tħanfas meta sar jaf li l-kontribut tiegħu ma kienx issemma fir-rapport.
formal.en: The employee resented the omission of his contribution when he learned that it had not been mentioned in the report.
formal.zh: 这名员工得知报告没有提及自己的贡献后，对这一遗漏心怀不满。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark tħanfas wara l-laqgħa? Lara: Għax ma stidnuhx jieħu sehem fid-diskussjoni u ħass li ma kienx ġust.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark feel resentful after the meeting? Lara: Because they did not invite him to join the discussion, and he felt that was unfair.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克开完会为什么心里不满？拉拉：因为他们没邀请他参加讨论，他觉得这样不公平。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克开完会为什么心里不满？
messages.en: Why did Mark feel resentful after the meeting?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma stidnuhx jieħu sehem fid-diskussjoni u ħass li ma kienx ġust.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma stidnuhx jieħu sehem fid-diskussjoni u ħass li ma kienx ġust.
messages.zh: 因为他们没邀请他参加讨论，他觉得这样不公平。
messages.en: Because they did not invite him to join the discussion, and he felt that was unfair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己出了力却没被提到，心里一直想着“这不公平”；把这种带着委屈的怨怼感与这个动词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of plants being put into the soil to grow, or an area where crops or trees are cultivated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物被栽入土壤以便生长的过程；也可指集中栽培作物或树木的种植园。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih il-pjanti jitqiegħdu fil-ħamrija biex jikbru, jew medda art fejn jitkabbru siġar jew għelejjel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物被栽入土壤、开始在其中生长的过程或状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-istat ta' pjanta li titqiegħed fil-ħamrija biex tikber.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The planting of a plant is the process in which it is placed in soil so that it can grow.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 集中种植树木或农作物的一片土地；种植园。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medda art fejn jitkabbru ħafna siġar jew pjanti, ġeneralment biex jagħtu prodott agrikolu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plantation is an area of land where trees or crops are grown together, usually for agricultural production.

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat attività ta' tħawwil ta' siġar fil-ġnien tagħha.
formal.en: The school organized a tree-planting activity in its garden.
formal.zh: 学校在自己的花园里组织了一次植树活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se nibdew it-tħawwil tal-fjuri? Pawlu: Għada filgħodu; illum inħejju l-ħamrija.
colloquial.en: Maja: When are we going to start planting the flowers? Pawlu: Tomorrow morning; today we'll prepare the soil.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们什么时候开始栽花？保罗：明天早上；今天先把土准备好。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺伙伴)
messages.zh: 我们什么时候开始栽花？
messages.en: When are we going to start planting the flowers?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺伙伴)
messages.zh: 明天早上；今天先把土准备好。
messages.en: Tomorrow morning; today we'll prepare the soil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上一幅把幼苗放进土里的图，先记“栽种”；再把画面拉远成整片栽培地，联记“种植园”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft, dry sound made when things such as leaves or paper move or rub against one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 树叶、纸张等移动或相互摩擦时发出的轻微沙沙声或窸窣声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss ħafif u niexef li jinstema' meta affarijiet bħall-weraq jew il-karti jiċċaqalqu jew jitħokku ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 树叶、纸张等因移动或摩擦而发出的轻微、连续的沙沙声。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħoss ħafif li jagħmlu l-weraq, il-karti jew affarijiet simili meta jiċċaqalqu jew jitħokku ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rustling is a soft, dry sound that you hear when leaves, paper, or similar materials move against one another.

formal.mt: Fis-skiet tal-ġnien, kien jinstema' biss it-tħaxwix tal-weraq fir-riħ.
formal.en: In the quiet garden, only the rustling of leaves in the wind could be heard.
formal.zh: 寂静的花园里，只听得见树叶在风中的沙沙声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tisma' dak it-tħaxwix ħdejn it-tieqa? Mark: Iva, huma l-weraq li qed iċaqlaq ir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear that rustling near the window? Mark: Yes, it's the leaves moving in the wind.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你听见窗边那阵沙沙声了吗？马克：听见了，是风吹动树叶的声音。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' dak it-tħaxwix ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' dak it-tħaxwix ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 你听见窗边那阵沙沙声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that rustling near the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma l-weraq li qed iċaqlaq ir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma l-weraq li qed iċaqlaq ir-riħ.
messages.zh: 听见了，是风吹动树叶的声音。
messages.en: Yes, it's the leaves moving in the wind.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记词时轻轻揉一张纸，再想象风吹树叶；把两种“沙沙、窸窣”的声音一起贴到这个词上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making someone unable to move, or a feeling of having little energy or strength.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人失去活动能力、陷入瘫痪的过程；也指缺乏精力或力气的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna ma tibqax kapaċi tiċċaqlaq, jew sensazzjoni ta' nuqqas ta' enerġija jew saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或身体某部分失去活动能力、造成瘫痪的过程或作用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-effett li bih persuna jew parti minn ġisimha titlef il-ħila li tiċċaqlaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Paralyzing is the process of making a person or part of their body unable to move.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到精力不足、身体无力或提不起劲的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni li persuna għandha ftit enerġija jew saħħa u ma tħossx li għandha ħila tagħmel l-affarijiet tas-soltu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A feeling of lack of energy is a state in which you feel weak and have little strength for your usual activities.

collocations.en: a feeling of weakness in the body

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tħeddil bħala telf tal-ħila li wieħed iċaqlaq parti minn ġismu.
formal.en: The report describes paralyzing as the loss of the ability to move part of one's body.
formal.zh: 报告将使身体瘫痪的作用描述为导致人失去移动某一身体部位的能力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Illum qed inħoss tħeddil fil-ġisem u ma għandi enerġija għal xejn. David: Mela nħallu l-ħarġa għal għada u nieħduha bil-mod illum.
colloquial.en: Sara: Today I feel weak all over and have no energy for anything. David: Then let's leave the outing until tomorrow and take things slowly today.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天我浑身没劲，什么都不想做。戴维：那就明天再出去吧，今天慢慢来。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum qed inħoss tħeddil fil-ġisem u ma għandi enerġija għal xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Illum qed inħoss tħeddil fil-ġisem u ma għandi enerġija għal xejn.
messages.zh: 今天我浑身没劲，什么都不想做。
messages.en: Today I feel weak all over and have no energy for anything.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nħallu l-ħarġa għal għada u nieħduha bil-mod illum.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nħallu l-ħarġa għal għada u nieħduha bil-mod illum.
messages.zh: 那就明天再出去吧，今天慢慢来。
messages.en: Then let's leave the outing until tomorrow and take things slowly today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张分开的学习卡记忆：一张画肢体无法活动，提示“使瘫痪”；另一张画电量不足，提示“乏力感”，注意区分程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join, make, or repair something with stitches using a needle and thread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用针和线缝合材料、制作衣物或修补物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tgħaqqad biċċiet tad-drapp, tagħmel ħwejjeġ jew issewwi xi ħaġa bil-ponti, billi tuża labra u ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用针线缝合布料等材料，或以此制作、修补衣物等物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tuża labra u ħajt biex tgħaqqad materjal bil-ponti jew biex tagħmel jew issewwi ħwejjeġ u oġġetti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you sew, you use a needle and thread to join pieces of material or to make or repair something.

formal.mt: Matul il-lezzjoni, l-għalliema tħit żewġ biċċiet tad-drapp flimkien biex turi kif isiru l-ponti.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher sews two pieces of fabric together to demonstrate how stitches are made.
formal.zh: 上课时，老师把两块布缝在一起，示范如何走针。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Int tħit bil-magna jew bl-idejn? Rita: Bil-magna, imma din it-toqba żgħira nsewwiha bl-idejn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you sew with a machine or by hand? Rita: With a machine, but I'll mend this small hole by hand.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你用缝纫机缝，还是用手缝？丽塔：用缝纫机，不过这个小洞我会用手补。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你用缝纫机缝，还是用手缝？
messages.en: Do you sew with a machine or by hand?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-magna, imma din it-toqba żgħira nsewwiha bl-idejn.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-magna, imma din it-toqba żgħira nsewwiha bl-idejn.
messages.zh: 用缝纫机，不过这个小洞我会用手补。
messages.en: With a machine, but I'll mend this small hole by hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到这个词就想象一根针带着线穿过两块布；再配读“tħit libsa”，把动作“缝”和成品“连衣裙”连起来记。
